jobs.title: Head of Group External Communications 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

As Head of Group External Communications, you are a senior leader responsible for protecting and enhancing the Bank’s reputation and valuation through active engagement with the media and providing advice and support around developing themes and issues that could affect its reputation. This includes developing and executing a proactive media strategy in line with the Bank’s strategic positioning, building and nurturing journalist relationships with top-tier Swiss and international media outlets, financial calendar communications and other external news events, issues response, and leading and developing an international team of media professionals. This role reports to the Head of Group Communications.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Strategy Development: Create and execute a comprehensive media strategy, including proactive media engagement and corporate messaging, aligned with the Bank’s strategy and positioning

• Media Relations: Cultivate and maintain relationships with top-tier Swiss and international journalists, influencers, and national/regional press

• Financial Communications: Actively support financial calendar events, including full- and half-year results, interim management statements, AGM and ad hoc announcements

• Issues Management: Prepared for and advise on response strategies, which support the Bank’s reputation for doing the right thing, and act as a primary spokesperson

• Content Creation: Oversee the writing, editing, and approval of press releases, media advisories, talking points, position papers, and pitches

• Team Leadership: Partner with and advise the Head of Group Communications as part of developing and executing the Group’s Communications strategy and plan; connect, mentor, and lead an international team, collaborating closely with internal stakeholders, including Investor Relations, Finance, Legal and Regulatory, among others

• Monitoring & Analysis: Oversee media monitoring and establish meaningful data analysis to gauge sentiment and inform strategies accordingly

YOUR PROFILE

• Experience: 10+ years proven experience in public relations or media relations, preferably in Wealth Management or Banking, with a demonstrated history of securing high-impact coverage and issues management

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Public Relations, Communications, Journalism, or a related field, preferred

• Analytical Skills: Strong judgment and analytical skills for assessing risk and opportunity

• Communications Skills: Exceptional communication (written and verbal), strategic thinking, and strong interpersonal skills

• Media Relationships: Existing, strong relationships with key financial media contacts.

• Media Savvy: Demonstrable understanding of how media works, and the intersection of digital channels and LLMs

• Leadership: Ability to work with senior leaders in a fast-paced environment and handle pressure, particularly in crisis scenarios

• Collaborative, team player: Understands the value of working collaboratively across teams, functions and regions

• Networking: Ability to build and maintain strong external and internal relationships

• Fast-paced Environment: Ability to work under pressure and manage tight deadlines

• Language: Fluent German and English required

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Julius Baer, celebriamo e valorizziamo le qualità individuali che portate, permettendovi di essere impeccabili, di essere imprenditoriali, di essere potenziati e di creare valore al di là della ricchezza. Formiamo insieme il futuro della gestione della ricchezza.

In qualità di responsabile delle comunicazioni esterne del gruppo, sei un leader senior responsabile della protezione e del miglioramento della reputazione e della valutazione della Banca attraverso un impegno attivo con i media e fornendo consigli e supporto per lo sviluppo di temi e questioni che potrebbero influenzare la sua reputazione. Ciò include lo sviluppo e l’esecuzione di una strategia di media proattiva in linea con il posizionamento strategico della Banca, la costruzione e la cura dei rapporti giornalistici con i media svizzeri e internazionali di alto livello, le comunicazioni del calendario finanziario e altri eventi di notizie esterne, la risposta dei problemi, e la guida e lo sviluppo di un team internazionale di professionisti dei media. Questo ruolo riporta al Capo delle Comunicazioni del Gruppo.

LA TUA SICUREZZA

• Sviluppo della strategia: Creare ed eseguire una strategia multimediale completa, tra cui l'impegno dei media proattivi e la messaggistica aziendale, allineati con la strategia e il posizionamento della Banca

• Media Relations: Coltivare e mantenere relazioni con giornalisti, influencer svizzeri e internazionali di alto livello e stampa nazionale/regionale

• Comunicazioni finanziarie: sostenere attivamente gli eventi del calendario finanziario, compresi i risultati completi e semestrali, i rendiconti intermedi, gli annunci AGM e ad hoc

• Gestione dei problemi: preparata e consigliata sulle strategie di risposta, che sostengono la reputazione della Banca per fare la cosa giusta, e agire come portavoce primario

• Creazione dei contenuti: supervisionare la scrittura, la modifica e l'approvazione dei comunicati stampa, dei media, dei punti di conversazione, dei documenti di posizione e delle piazzole

• Leadership di gruppo: Partner e consigliare il responsabile delle comunicazioni di gruppo nell’ambito dello sviluppo e dell’esecuzione della strategia e del piano di comunicazione del Gruppo; collegare, mentore e guidare un team internazionale, collaborando a stretto contatto con gli stakeholder interni, tra cui Investor Relations, Finance, Legal and Regulatory, tra gli altri

• Monitoraggio e analisi: supervisionare il monitoraggio dei media e stabilire analisi dei dati significative per misurare il sentimento e informare le strategie di conseguenza

Il tuo progetto

• Esperienza: 10+ anni comprovata esperienza nelle relazioni pubbliche o nei rapporti con i media, preferibilmente in Wealth Management o Banking, con una storia dimostrata di garantire la copertura ad alto impatto e la gestione dei problemi

• Istruzione: Corso di laurea in Relazioni Pubbliche, Comunicazioni, Giornalismo, o un campo correlato, preferito

• Competenze analitiche: forte giudizio e capacità analitiche per la valutazione del rischio e delle opportunità

• Comunicazioni competenze: comunicazione eccezionale (scritta e verbale), pensiero strategico e forti competenze interpersonali

• Media Relationships: esistere, relazioni forti con i principali contatti dei media finanziari.

• Media Savvy: comprensione dimostrabile di come funziona i media, e l'intersezione dei canali digitali e LLM

• Leadership: Capacità di lavorare con i leader senior in un ambiente frenetico e gestire la pressione, in particolare negli scenari di crisi

• Collaborativo, team player: Comprende il valore del lavoro in collaborazione tra team, funzioni e regioni

• Networking: Capacità di costruire e mantenere forti relazioni esterne e interne

• Ambiente veloce: Capacità di lavorare sotto pressione e gestire scadenze strette

• Lingua: Tedesco fluente e inglese richiesto

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Julius Bär feiern und schätzen wir die individuellen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen, damit Sie wirkungsvoll sein, unternehmerisch handeln, gestärkt werden und Werte jenseits von Wohlstand schaffen können. Gestalten wir gemeinsam die Zukunft des Wealth Managements.

Als Head of Group External Communications sind Sie als Führungskraft dafür verantwortlich, den Ruf und die Bewertung der Bank zu schützen und zu verbessern, indem Sie sich aktiv mit den Medien beschäftigen und Beratung und Unterstützung bei der Entwicklung von Themen und Themen anbieten, die ihren Ruf beeinträchtigen könnten. Dazu gehören die Entwicklung und Umsetzung einer proaktiven Medienstrategie im Einklang mit der strategischen Positionierung der Bank, der Aufbau und die Pflege von Journalistenbeziehungen zu erstklassigen Schweizer und internationalen Medien, die Kommunikation über Finanzkalender und andere externe Nachrichtenveranstaltungen, die Reaktion auf Themen sowie die Leitung und Entwicklung eines internationalen Teams von Medienexperten. Diese Rolle berichtet an den Leiter der Gruppenkommunikation.

IHRE HERAUSFORDERUNG

• Strategieentwicklung: Erstellung und Umsetzung einer umfassenden Medienstrategie, einschließlich proaktivem Medienengagement und Corporate Messaging, ausgerichtet auf die Strategie und Positionierung der Bank

• Medienbeziehungen: Pflege und Pflege von Beziehungen zu erstklassigen Schweizer und internationalen Journalisten, Influencern und nationaler/regionaler Presse

• Finanzkommunikation: Aktive Unterstützung von Finanzkalenderereignissen, einschließlich Voll- und Halbjahresergebnissen, Zwischenmitteilungen des Managements, Hauptversammlung und Ad-hoc-Ankündigungen

• Issues Management: Vorbereitung und Beratung zu Reaktionsstrategien, die den Ruf der Bank unterstützen, das Richtige zu tun, und als Hauptsprecher fungieren

• Content Creation: Überwachen Sie das Verfassen, Bearbeiten und Genehmigen von Pressemitteilungen, Medienberatungen, Gesprächsthemen, Positionspapieren und Pitches

• Teamführung: Partnerschaft mit und Beratung des Leiters der Gruppenkommunikation im Rahmen der Entwicklung und Umsetzung der Kommunikationsstrategie und des Kommunikationsplans der Gruppe; Vernetzung, Betreuung und Leitung eines internationalen Teams, eng mit internen Stakeholdern, unter anderem Investor Relations, Finanzen, Recht und Regulierung, zusammenarbeiten

• Monitoring & Analyse: Überwachen Sie die Medienüberwachung und erstellen Sie eine aussagekräftige Datenanalyse, um die Stimmung zu messen und Strategien entsprechend zu informieren

IHR PROFIL

• Erfahrung: 10+ Jahre nachgewiesene Erfahrung in Public Relations oder Media Relations, vorzugsweise im Wealth Management oder Banking, mit einer nachgewiesenen Geschichte der Sicherung von High-Impact-Berichterstattung und Issues Management

• Ausbildung: Bachelor-Abschluss in Public Relations, Kommunikation, Journalismus oder einem verwandten Bereich, bevorzugt

• Analytische Fähigkeiten: Starkes Urteilsvermögen und analytische Fähigkeiten zur Bewertung von Risiko und Chancen

• Kommunikationsfähigkeiten: Außergewöhnliche Kommunikation (schriftlich und mündlich), strategisches Denken und starke zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten

• Medienbeziehungen: Bestehende, starke Beziehungen zu wichtigen Finanzmedienkontakten.

• Media Savvy: Demonstrierbares Verständnis der Funktionsweise von Medien und der Schnittstelle von digitalen Kanälen und LLMs

• Führung: Fähigkeit, mit Führungskräften in einem schnelllebigen Umfeld zu arbeiten und Druck zu bewältigen, insbesondere in Krisenszenarien

• Collaborative, Teamplayer: Versteht den Wert der Zusammenarbeit zwischen Teams, Funktionen und Regionen

• Networking: Fähigkeit, starke externe und interne Beziehungen aufzubauen und zu pflegen

• Schnelllebige Umgebung: Fähigkeit, unter Druck zu arbeiten und enge Fristen zu bewältigen

• Sprache: fließend Deutsch und Englisch erforderlich

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Julius Baer, nous célébrons et valorisons les qualités individuelles que vous apportez, vous permettant d'avoir un impact, d'être entrepreneur, d'être autonomisé et de créer une valeur au-delà de la richesse. C'est l'avenir de la gestion des richesses.

En tant que chef du groupe Communications externes, vous êtes un chef de file responsable de la protection et de l'amélioration de la réputation et de l'évaluation de la Banque grâce à un engagement actif auprès des médias et à la prestation de conseils et de soutien en matière de développement de thèmes et de questions susceptibles d'affecter sa réputation. Il s'agit notamment d'élaborer et de mettre en œuvre une stratégie médiatique proactive conforme au positionnement stratégique de la Banque, d'établir et d'entretenir des relations entre les journalistes et les médias suisses et internationaux de premier plan, de communiquer avec le calendrier financier et d'autres événements d'actualité externes, de répondre aux problèmes et de diriger et de développer une équipe internationale de professionnels des médias. Ce rôle relève du chef du groupe Communications.

Votre défi

• Élaboration de la stratégie : Créer et exécuter une stratégie médiatique globale, comprenant un engagement proactif des médias et des messages d'entreprise, alignée sur la stratégie et le positionnement de la Banque

• Relations avec les médias: Cultiver et entretenir des relations avec des journalistes, des influenceurs et des journalistes suisses et internationaux de haut niveau, et avec la presse nationale/régionale

• Communications financières : Appuyer activement les événements du calendrier financier, y compris les résultats de l'exercice complet et de la demi-année, les états de gestion provisoires, l'AGA et les annonces ponctuelles

• Gestion des enjeux : Préparé pour et conseiller sur les stratégies d'intervention, qui appuient la réputation de la Banque de faire la bonne chose, et agir comme porte-parole principal

• Création du contenu : Superviser l'écriture, l'édition et l'approbation des communiqués de presse, des avis aux médias, des points de discussion, des notes de position et des emplacements

• Leadership de l'équipe : Associé et conseiller le chef de la communication de groupe dans le cadre de l'élaboration et de l'exécution de la stratégie et du plan de communication du Groupe; mettre en relation, encadrer et diriger une équipe internationale, en collaborant étroitement avec les intervenants internes, notamment les relations avec les investisseurs, les finances, le droit et la réglementation.

• Surveillance et analyse : Superviser la surveillance des médias et établir une analyse de données significative pour évaluer le sentiment et éclairer les stratégies en conséquence

VOTRE PROFIL

• Expérience : 10+ années d'expérience prouvée dans les relations publiques ou les relations avec les médias, de préférence dans la gestion de patrimoine ou les banques, avec une histoire démontrée d'assurer une couverture à impact élevé et la gestion des problèmes

• Éducation: Baccalauréat en relations publiques, communication, journalisme, ou un domaine connexe, préféré

• Compétences analytiques : Fort jugement et compétences analytiques pour évaluer les risques et les possibilités

• Compétences en communication : Communication exceptionnelle (écrite et verbale), pensée stratégique et compétences interpersonnelles fortes

• Relations avec les médias : Relations solides et existantes avec les principaux contacts des médias financiers.

• Media Savvy: Compréhension manifeste du fonctionnement des médias et de l'intersection des canaux numériques et des LLM

• Leadership : Capacité de travailler avec les cadres supérieurs dans un environnement rapide et de gérer la pression, en particulier dans les scénarios de crise

• Collaborateur, joueur d'équipe : comprend la valeur de la collaboration entre les équipes, les fonctions et les régions

• Réseautage : Capacité de bâtir et de maintenir de solides relations externes et internes

• Environnement accéléré : Capacité de travailler sous pression et de gérer des délais serrés

• Langue: Allemand et anglais requis

jobs.title: Financial Analyst, Performance- & Initiative Manager 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.
We are looking for a highly motivated Financial Analyst, Performance- & Initiative Manager who is passionate about driving finance related projects and create impact on profitability, performance and cost management topics for Julius Baer’s private banking business in Western Markets & Switzerland.
You will be joining a dynamic and experienced team of Finance experts who act as sparring partners to the regional senior management, supporting them in achieving their objectives and anticipating trends in the financial performance at an early stage.
In this challenging and exciting role, you will be part of the CFO Western Markets & Switzerland team, and report to the Head of Performance Management, Business Partnering & Initiatives

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Drive & perform in-depth quantitative analyses (using Management Information System) to identify Front Office trends & insights at an early stage with respect to P&L impact and the use of Balance Sheet products and define actionable measures to drive & improve respective performance

• Lead & coordinate initiatives that trigger improvement of front office P&L performance – incl. conceptualization, implementation and rollout with reporting & progress tracking (e.g. revenue / profitability initiatives etc.), for the biggest Region within the Bank’s global business

• Prepare concise, insightful & visually appealing presentations on various finance topics for management meetings

• Act as a sparring partner to the Front in the context of Finance topics, with direct exposure to senior management and key stakeholders across the bank (e.g. Accounting, Treasury, Capital Management, Credit)

• Run business case assessments and market strategy reviews on a regular basis and derive conclusions for decision-making

• Enhance Performance Management and reporting landscape to enable tracking of Julius Baer's long term business strategy execution

YOUR PROFILE

• Strong academic record: University degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or comparable field of study with above-average grades

• At least 2-3 years of experience in a comparable finance or related function within banking / financial industry or in management consulting with focus on banking

• Good knowledge and understanding of the Private Banking business and global financial markets

• Excellent slide writing skills with ability to prepare ‘target audience specific’ communication

• Advanced Excel and data handling skills paired with affinity to derive in-depth quantitative analyses

• Further knowledge of data analytics & visualization applications (e.g. Tableau) are an advantage

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with multiple senior stakeholders

• Strong analytical, conceptual skills, fast thinker and outstanding team player

• Capital / balance sheet management knowledge (incl. implications of interest rate development) is a plus

• Strong personal drive with good organizational and multi-tasking skills as well as ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines

• Highly motivated, independent, pro-active and meticulous work method with a results-oriented mindset and problem-solving attitude

• Fluent in German & English (spoken and written), other languages are an advantage

• Eligibility to work in the country where you apply for the position

Siamo alla ricerca di un Analista Finanziario altamente motivato, Performance- & Initiative Manager che è appassionato di progetti relativi alla finanza di guida e creare impatto sulla redditività, sulle prestazioni e sui temi di gestione dei costi per l’attività bancaria privata di Julius Baer nei mercati occidentali e in Svizzera.
Ti unirai a un team dinamico ed esperto di esperti di finanza che agiscono come partner risparmiatore per la gestione senior regionale, supportandoli nel raggiungimento dei loro obiettivi e anticipando le tendenze delle prestazioni finanziarie in una fase iniziale.
In questo ruolo stimolante ed emozionante, sarete parte del team CFO Western Markets & Switzerland e riferirete al responsabile della gestione delle prestazioni, Business Partnering & Initiatives

LA TUA SICUREZZA

• Drive & esegue analisi quantitative approfondite (utilizzando Management Information System) per identificare le tendenze e le intuizioni di Front Office in una fase iniziale rispetto all'impatto P&L e all'uso dei prodotti Balance Sheet e definire misure attuabili per guidare e migliorare le rispettive prestazioni

• Lead & coordinate iniziative che innescano il miglioramento delle prestazioni P&L di front office – incl. concettualizzazione, implementazione e rollout con reporting & progress tracking (ad esempio entrate / iniziative di redditività ecc), per la più grande Regione all’interno del business globale della Banca

• Preparare presentazioni concise, intuitive e visivamente accattivanti su vari argomenti di finanza per riunioni di gestione

• Agire come partner sparring al fronte nel contesto di argomenti di finanza, con esposizione diretta a senior management e stakeholder chiave in tutta la banca (ad esempio contabilità, tesoreria, gestione del capitale, credito)

• Eseguire le valutazioni dei casi aziendali e le recensioni di strategia di mercato regolarmente e trarre conclusioni per il processo decisionale

• Migliorare la gestione delle prestazioni e il paesaggio di reportistica per consentire il tracciamento dell'esecuzione di strategia aziendale a lungo termine di Julius Baer

Il tuo progetto

• Forte record accademico: laurea in Finanza, Contabilità, Economia o campo di studio comparabile con gradi superiori alla media

• Almeno 2-3 anni di esperienza in una finanza comparabile o funzione correlata all'interno del settore bancario / finanziario o in consulenza di gestione con attenzione al settore bancario

• Buona conoscenza e comprensione del business Private Banking e dei mercati finanziari globali

• Eccellente capacità di scrittura dello slide con la capacità di preparare la comunicazione 'target audience specific'

• Avanzate Excel e capacità di gestione dei dati abbinate all'affinità per ricavare approfondite analisi quantitative

• Ulteriori conoscenze sulle applicazioni di analisi e visualizzazione dei dati (ad esempio Tableau) sono un vantaggio

• Forte comunicazione e competenze interpersonali per collaborare con più stakeholder senior

• Forte capacità analitiche, concettuali, pensiero veloce e giocatore di squadra eccezionale

• La conoscenza della gestione del bilancio (incluse le implicazioni dello sviluppo dei tassi di interesse) è un plus

• Forte unità personale con buone capacità organizzative e multi-tasking così come la capacità di lavorare sotto pressione e soddisfare scadenze strette

• Metodo di lavoro altamente motivato, indipendente, proattivo e meticoloso con una mentalità orientata ai risultati e un atteggiamento di problem solving

• Fluente in tedesco e inglese (spoken e scritto), altre lingue sono un vantaggio

• Ammissibilità di lavorare nel paese in cui si applica per la posizione

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

Join Julius Baer as a Business Risk Manager in the Division “Global Products and Solutions”, where you will play a critical role in managing non-financial risks. As a key member of our team, you will have the opportunity to make a significant impact, drive innovation, and shape the future of wealth management.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Develop, maintain, and assess the risk framework to meet business and regulatory expectations

• Embed risk management standards and principles in related business processes

• Collaborate with stakeholders to identify and mitigate operational risks and contribute to their timely and sustainable resolution

• Remediation of business risk topics arising from operational risk including analysis and solution finding

YOUR PROFILE

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent higher education, preferably in Banking & Finance, Business Administration, or Law

• Further education in risk management is a strong plus (e.g., FRM, PRM)

• 5-7 years of relevant working experience in a non-financial risk management role within the Investment and Wealth Management environment

• Strong interest in non-financial risk management, sound knowledge of the banking business, related audit principles, financial products, front to back knowledge of trading and execution processes, and the middle office. Trade reporting knowhow is an advantage

• Strong understanding of operational processes associated with the creation and distribution of financial products

• Ability to write and review policies and manuals

What we are looking for

• Diligent, accurate, and reliable personality, critical and conceptual problem-solver with a growth mindset and ability to find innovative solutions

• Strong analytical, presentation, and communication skills

• Team player, hands-on personality, comfortable in taking ownership and driving change, and ability to work independently and across units and international locations

• Committed to high standards of quality and performance in all deliverables

• Fluency in English, German is a strong plus

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

As an IT Infrastructure Solution Architect at Julius Baer, you will translate business and technical requirements into resilient, secure, and innovative IT architectures, ensuring alignment with enterprise standards while driving end-to-end delivery across cross-functional teams. With a strong foundation in infrastructure, security, and solution architecture, you will act as a trusted advisor—bridging business needs with technological excellence in a dynamic, regulated environment.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Turn ideas into architecture: Translate infrastructure requirements from projects or products into clear, actionable architecture and design documents — the blueprint for successful delivery

• Ensure compliance: Make sure every solution aligns with internal architectural standards and guidelines, ensuring consistency and reliability

• Be the trusted advisor: Act as the first point of contact for projects and ARTs on infrastructure and middleware topics

• Coordinate seamlessly: Oversee the end-to-end flow of infrastructure tasks across teams and departments, keeping everything on track

• Collaborate with suppliers: Understand the technical details of supplier-delivered capabilities and integrate them smoothly into the overall architecture

• Work hand-in-hand: Partner closely with IT infrastructure architects and engineering teams to deliver robust solutions

• Bridge the gap: Connect business units, technical specialists, project managers, application owners, and infrastructure teams — translating needs into practical solutions

• Enable innovation: Support the setup of new technology stacks and help shape future-ready infrastructure environments

YOUR PROFILE

• Architecture & Infrastructure Expertise: Solid experience in IT infrastructure across medium to large-scale projects. Familiar with the main infrastructure layers and experienced in one or more areas such as security, performance, or capacity management

• Structured and proactive: You work independently, with a clear, goal-oriented approach and a strong sense of ownership

• Security & Resilience: Operational resilience, IT security, risk management, and quality assurance are part of your professional mindset

• Future-focused: You stay ahead of emerging technologies and innovation trends that impact IT environments

• Business-aware: You understand business analysis and requirements engineering processes and can bridge technical solutions with business needs

• Automation & Integration: You know how automation, infrastructure operations, modernization, and technology integration fit together to create efficient environments. Strong knowledge of application integration architecture, technologies, patterns, and security architecture

• Solution-driven: You have a strong grasp of solution architecture and are comfortable navigating concepts like service design and software development best practices

• Architect at heart: You have a solid foundation in architecture principles, methodologies, and modeling techniques — and you’re hands-on with industry-standard practices like Agile, DevOps, and CI/CD

• Higher education (e.g., University or Fachhochschule) in a relevant field

• 5–10 years of IT architecture experience; financial services experience is an advantage

• Training in IT infrastructure architecture and project management (waterfall and agile)

• Excellent communication skills and a collaborative, team-oriented mindset

• English business fluent (verbal and written); German is an advantage

• Future-focused: Stai davanti alle tecnologie emergenti e alle tendenze dell'innovazione che influiscono sugli ambienti IT

• Architetto a cuore: Hai una solida base in principi di architettura, metodologie e tecniche di modellazione - e sei pratico con pratiche standard del settore come Agile, DevOps, e CI/CD

• 5-10 anni di esperienza nell'architettura IT; l'esperienza dei servizi finanziari è un vantaggio

• Formazione in infrastrutture IT architettura e gestione dei progetti (caduta e agile)

• Continuous learning mindset, with a passion for staying up-to-date with the latest advancements in machine learning and artificial intelligence

• Attention to detail and commitment to producing high-quality, reliable, and maintainable code

• Strong programming skills in Python with experience in machine learning libraries and deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

At Julius Baer, we are committed to empowering our teams through a DevOps-driven approach. To achieve this, we are focused on developing scalable platforms that enable our product teams to self-serve their infrastructure and resource needs. As our application landscape evolves, we're investing in the expansion of our infrastructure automation capabilities - with Crossplane and Kubernetes-native control planes at the core of that strategy.

Join our team as a Platform Engineer and play a key role in designing and delivering automation solutions that drive efficiency across the organization by replacing manual processes with automated self-service offerings.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Lead the design, development, and implementation of Kubernetes-native control planes using Crossplane, building providers and functions in Golang following the Kubernetes Operator pattern

• Design and extend self-service infrastructure offerings that let product teams provision and manage their own resources reliably and at scale

• Build and maintain workflow automation on our orchestration platform, including writing and reviewing the underlying business logic in JavaScript and other scripting languages (we're also evaluating and migrating toward a new automation tooling stack, so adaptability here matters)

• Enable and coach product teams on how to build and extend their own automations on top of the platform, through documentation, workshops, and hands-on guidance - supporting our self-service strategy beyond just building the platform itself

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment with business objectives and technical strategies

• Contribute technical expertise to the team and help shape technical roadmaps and strategic direction for our automation platforms

• Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues across the control plane and automation tooling, and recommend improvements

• Stay up to date with the latest trends in cloud-native computing, Kubernetes, and infrastructure automation, and apply this knowledge to continuously improve our solutions

• Contribute to technical documentation, including design documents, implementation guides, and operational procedures

• Ensure compliance with industry standards, best practices, and organisational policies

YOUR PROFILE

• Minimum 3 years of experience developing and operating Kubernetes Operators, ideally using Golang and the Crossplane framework, to provision and continuously reconcile resources

• Experience building or extending workflow automation tooling including writing business logic in JavaScript, Python, PowerShell, or similar - deep expertise in any specific vendor tool is not required, as we understand tools change over time

• Expert knowledge of Kubernetes and the cloud-native computing ecosystem

• Strong understanding of software development processes, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps tooling

• Experience with Golang and at least one scripting language such as JavaScript, PowerShell, or Python

• Experience with Git and agile development methodologies

• Understanding of enterprise IT infrastructure (Windows, Linux, networking, virtualisation, cloud) is a big plus

• Proven experience delivering technical projects independently, and collaborating effectively with multiple technical and non-technical stakeholders

• Experience teaching, coaching, or enabling other teams or engineers to adopt new tools and ways of working (e.g. through workshops, documentation, or pairing), even without formal people-management responsibility

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

• Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and adapt to changing priorities and deadlines

• Ability to quickly grasp complex requirements, fast learner, highly proactive

• Proven track record in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field

• Fluent in English, German is a plus

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.
Is this not quite what you are looking for? Set up a job alert by creating a candidate account here.

jobs.title: Junior Transformational Change Management Specialist 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

Are you interested in shaping the future of work and supporting meaningful change across a global financial institution?

At Julius Baer, we are not only transforming technology — we are transforming how people work, collaborate, and create value. Join the newly established Transformational Change Management (TCM) team, a dedicated unit at the heart of the bank’s Digital Business Transformation (DBT).

In this junior role, you will support strategic transformation initiatives across the
organisation — from AI integration to changes in operating models and enterprise-
wide platform rollouts. Working closely with experienced change professionals and project leads, you will provide project management support, prepare high-quality presentations and maintain the tracking and reporting needed to keep initiatives moving forward.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Provide day-to-day PMO and coordination support to the TCM team and its strategic change initiatives

• Prepare high-quality PowerPoint presentations for project meetings, training materials, workshops, steering committees and senior management updates.

• Project progress, stakeholder engagement and adoption activities

• Coordinate meetings and workshops, including agendas, materials, minutes, action tracking and follow-up

• Support the development of change and enablement materials, including communications, presentations, training assets and toolkits

• Collect and consolidate project information, highlighting deadlines, dependencies, risks and potential delivery issues

• Contribute to stakeholder engagement, change readiness and adoption tracking, as well as the continuous improvement of TCM methods and templates

YOUR PROFILE

• Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Communications, Psychology, Human Resources, Organisational Development or a related field; alternatively, a completed banking apprenticeship with relevant further education

• First professional experience through an internship, graduate programme, apprenticeship or entry-level role in project management, transformation, change, consulting, communications or HR

• Experience in financial services, wealth management, private banking or another regulated environment is an advantage; a banking apprenticeship is a strong plus

• Strong proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel, with the ability to create professional presentations and maintain structured trackers and reports

• Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and reliably follow through on actions

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to structure complex information in a clear and audience-appropriate way

• Analytical, proactive and delivery-oriented mindset, combined with curiosity and a willingness to learn

• Collaborative team player with a genuine interest in people-centric transformation and new ways of working

• Fluency in English is required; German or additional languages are an advantage

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

Do you aspire to be part of a high performing Analytics and Transformation team within a global Compliance organisation at the forefront of the wealth management industry? In this diverse role you will implement new technologies, manage change initiatives, develop predictive models, and perform financial and economic analysis to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of risk management. Working alongside Risk, Compliance, Analytics and Legal SMEs in highly skilled, fast-paced teams you will drive business value through collaboratively solving complex analytical problems.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Product Ownership of a dedicated and global solution to ensure that process independent controls are uniformly sourced, managed, executed and reported on a control case level

• Owning reporting services, application design, process, data, testing, and user documentation

• Collaborate with and coordinate the application responsible, IT service owner and business team to on roadmap, day-to-day priorities of change requests, bugs and incidents, deliverables (incl. dashboards) and budgets

• Ensure business requirements gathering and prioritization, coordinate & plan IT delivery, ensure business testing,  provide communication to the end-users

• Acts as first point of contact for business user queries, support onboarding, develop product roadmap and ensure management change requests, bugs and incidents

YOUR PROFILE

• Master’s degree in STEM (science, technology, engineering, mathematics) fields or Business/Economics with IT/Analytics flavour

• At least 5 years of Banking experience with focus on Compliance, Risk Management and Legal

• Strong track record in managing timelines and delivering results in fast-paced, dynamic environments, consistently turning challenges into successful outcomes

• Ability to quickly grasp complex concepts and communicate them clearly to diverse stakeholders across IT, business, and varying levels of seniority

• Experience as scrum-master, IT project manager, business analyst or product owner, working with all other roles for an application, preferable with project management certification ex. IPMA or SAFE

• Curious to learn new things and apply out-of-the-box thinking to challenge the status quo and proactively propose new solutions

• Demonstrates flexibility and role adaptability to ensure continuity of application and business processes, readily stepping in to support colleagues and address emerging needs across teams

• Team-oriented and enjoy collaborating with diverse experts, listening to different ideas and voicing your own, to deliver the best possible outcome

• Experience with Altassian suite (Confluence, Jira) and with devops activities (tests, deployments, releases, environments , dependencies, freezes, global IT roadmaps)

• Hands-on experience in data modelling and engineering, with expertise in structuring, cleansing, and standardising data using SQL and Python

• Exposure to UX/UI design, has an eye for detail, can translate user interactions into design components

• Good in translating the requirements in feasible features and breaking them down in actionable items an assign them to correct role (developer, tester, architect, business analyst, business user)

• Fluent in English (main business language), any further language is an advantage

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Julius Baer, celebriamo e valorizziamo le qualità individuali che portate, permettendovi di essere impeccabili, di essere imprenditoriali, di essere potenziati e di creare valore al di là della ricchezza. Formiamo insieme il futuro della gestione della ricchezza.

Aspiri a far parte di un team di analisi e trasformazione ad alte prestazioni all'interno di un'organizzazione globale di Compliance in prima linea nel settore della gestione della ricchezza? In questo ruolo diversificato potrete implementare nuove tecnologie, gestire le iniziative di cambiamento, sviluppare modelli predittivi e eseguire analisi finanziarie ed economiche per aumentare l'efficienza e l'efficacia della gestione del rischio. Lavorando a fianco di Risk, Compliance, Analytics e PMI giuridiche in team altamente qualificati e veloci, guiderai il valore aziendale risolvendo in modo collaborativo complessi problemi analitici.

LA TUA SICUREZZA

• Proprietario del prodotto di una soluzione dedicata e globale per garantire che i controlli indipendenti di processo siano in modo uniforme, gestiti, eseguiti e segnalati a livello di controllo

• Servizi di reporting di proprietà, progettazione di applicazioni, processo, dati, test e documentazione dell'utente

• Collaborare con e coordinare l'applicazione responsabile, il proprietario del servizio IT e il team di affari su roadmap, priorità giorno per giorno di cambiamento richieste, bug e incidenti, consegnabili (incl. dashboard) e budget

• Assicurare la raccolta e la priorità dei requisiti aziendali, coordinare e pianificare la consegna IT, garantire i test aziendali, fornire comunicazione agli utenti finali

• Agisce come primo punto di contatto per le domande degli utenti aziendali, supporto onboarding, sviluppare la roadmap del prodotto e garantire le richieste di cambiamento di gestione, bug e incidenti

Il tuo progetto

• Laurea magistrale in STEM (scienza, tecnologia, ingegneria, matematica) campi o Business/Economia con gusto IT/Analitica

• Almeno 5 anni di esperienza bancaria con focus su Compliance, Risk Management e Legal

• Forte record di traccia nella gestione dei tempi e nella fornitura di risultati in ambienti veloci e dinamici, trasformando costantemente le sfide in risultati di successo

• Capacità di afferrare rapidamente concetti complessi e di comunicarli chiaramente a diversi stakeholder attraverso IT, business e livelli di anzianità variabili

• Esperienza come scrum-master, responsabile del progetto IT, analista aziendale o proprietario del prodotto, lavorando con tutti gli altri ruoli per un'applicazione, preferibile con la certificazione di gestione del progetto ex. IPMA o SAFE

• Curioso per imparare cose nuove e applicare il pensiero out-of-the-box per sfidare lo status quo e proattivamente proporre nuove soluzioni

• Dimostra la flessibilità e l'adattabilità del ruolo per garantire la continuità dei processi applicativi e aziendali, prontamente passo per supportare i colleghi e affrontare le esigenze emergenti di team

• Team-oriented e godere di collaborare con diversi esperti, ascoltando diverse idee e svuotando il proprio, per offrire il miglior risultato possibile

• Esperienza con suite Altassian (Confluenza, Jira) e con attività devote (test, distribuzioni, release, ambienti , dipendenze, congelamenti, roadmap IT globali)

• Esperienza pratica nella modellazione e nell'ingegneria dei dati, con competenza nella strutturazione, pulizia e standardizzazione dei dati utilizzando SQL e Python

• L'esposizione al design UX/UI, ha un occhio per i dettagli, può tradurre le interazioni degli utenti in componenti di progettazione

• Buono a tradurre i requisiti in caratteristiche fattibili e abbatterli in oggetti attuabili un assegnarli a un ruolo corretto (sviluppatore, tester, architetto, analista di affari, utente di affari)

• Fluente in inglese (lingua aziendale principale), qualsiasi altra lingua è un vantaggio

jobs.title: Operational Excellence Officer for Mortgages 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

At Julius Baer, we pride ourselves on delivering exceptional private banking services to our clients worldwide. We foster a culture of excellence, innovation, and continuous development, creating opportunities for talented professionals to grow and make a meaningful impact.

To further strengthen our leading Swiss mortgage franchise, we are looking for a proactive and results-driven Operational Excellence Officer to join our newly established COO Real Estate Team. This pivotal role offers the opportunity to shape the future of our national mortgage operations, drive process improvements, and deliver high-quality services across the entire mortgage lifecycle.

Your Role – Driving Efficiency, Quality & Innovation
As a key member of the Real Estate operations unit, you will ensure the smooth and compliant administration of Julius Baer’s Swiss mortgage portfolio from origination to maturity. Combining precision with strategic thinking, you’ll manage critical operational workflows, uphold rigorous control standards, and provide actionable insights that empower informed decision-making across the organisation. You will balance hands-on execution with forward-looking contributions to transformational initiatives — helping us raise the bar in operational resilience, digitisation, and client service excellence.

YOUR CHALLENGE
End-to-End Mortgage Operations & Lifecycle Management

• Oversee the complete administrative journey of mortgage facilities — from initial booking and amendments to renewal, early repayment, and final settlement.

• Execute transactional activities with accuracy and timeliness, including new loans, modifications, refinancing, and system updates.

• Ensure consistent data integrity across core banking and real estate systems, serving as a trusted source of truth.

• Collaborate closely with Front Office, Mortgage Advisory, Credit Risk, Legal, and external partners to guarantee seamless client experiences and operational agility.

Controls, Compliance & Process Integrity

• Conduct daily operational checks, reconciliations, and exception monitoring to safeguard data accuracy and process reliability.

• Support adherence to internal policies and evolving regulatory requirements (including FINMA oversight, SNB initiatives).

• Proactively identify, escalate, and resolve operational risks and pending items to maintain audit readiness.

• Contribute to refining SOPs, control frameworks, and risk mitigation measures.

Strategic Initiatives & Business Transformation

• Act as an operational partner in cross-functional projects focused on automation, digitalisation, and customer journey enhancement.

• Identify inefficiencies and co-design scalable solutions that elevate both productivity and service quality.

• Assist in shaping future-state processes, technology integrations, and change management rollouts.

YOUR PROFILE

• Completed tertiary education — either a university Bachelor’s degree or a commercial qualification (EFZ) with relevant further training

• 3–5 years of solid experience in Swiss mortgage operations or loan administration, ideally within private banking or retail financial institutions

• In-depth knowledge of the Swiss mortgage lifecycle, product types, collateral handling, and related operational workflows

• Demonstrated experience in data management, reporting, and operational controls — familiarity with regulatory expectations is a distinct advantage

• Strong analytical abilities and a natural interest in process optimisation, whether in daily tasks or large-scale transformations

• Enjoys project-based work; self-motivated to take initiative and see efforts through to successful completion

• Comfortable operating autonomously while building effective relationships across departments and hierarchies

• Fluent in German and English (written and spoken); proficiency in French or Italian is a significant asset

• Advanced user of Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint); prior experience with core banking platforms or CRM/loan systems is beneficial

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.
Is this not quite what you are looking for? Set up a job alert by creating a candidate account here.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Julius Baer, celebriamo e valorizziamo le qualità individuali che portate, permettendovi di essere impeccabili, di essere imprenditoriali, di essere potenziati e di creare valore al di là della ricchezza. Formiamo insieme il futuro della gestione della ricchezza.

A Julius Baer, siamo orgogliosi di fornire servizi bancari privati eccezionali ai nostri clienti in tutto il mondo. Promuoviamo una cultura di eccellenza, innovazione e sviluppo continuo, creando opportunità per professionisti di talento per crescere e fare un impatto significativo.

Per rafforzare ulteriormente il nostro principale franchising mutuo svizzero, stiamo cercando un responsabile di eccellenza operativa proattivo e guidato dai risultati per unirsi al nostro nuovo COO Real Estate Team. Questo ruolo fondamentale offre l'opportunità di modellare il futuro delle nostre operazioni ipotecarie nazionali, migliorare il processo di guida e fornire servizi di alta qualità in tutto il ciclo di vita del mutuo.

Il vostro ruolo – Efficienza di guida, Qualità & innovazione
Come membro chiave dell'unità operativa di Real Estate, vi assicurerete l'amministrazione liscia e conforme del portafoglio mutuo svizzero di Julius Baer dall'origine alla maturità. Combinando la precisione con il pensiero strategico, gestirai flussi di lavoro operativi critici, mantieni rigorosi standard di controllo e fornisci informazioni attuabili che consentano il processo decisionale informato in tutta l'organizzazione. Equilibrete l'esecuzione pratica con i contributi previsionali alle iniziative di trasformazione, aiutandoci ad alzare la barra nella resilienza operativa, nella digitalizzazione e nell'eccellenza del servizio clienti.

LA TUA SICUREZZA
Gestione del ciclo di vita

• Controllare il percorso amministrativo completo delle strutture ipotecarie — dalla prenotazione iniziale e modifiche al rinnovo, il rimborso anticipato, e la risoluzione finale.

• Eseguire attività transazionali con precisione e tempestività, inclusi nuovi prestiti, modifiche, rifinanziamento e aggiornamenti di sistema.

• Assicurare l'integrità dei dati coerente attraverso il core banking e sistemi immobiliari, servendo come fonte attendibile di verità.

• Collabora a stretto contatto con Front Office, Mortgage Advisory, Credit Risk, Legal e partner esterni per garantire esperienze client senza soluzione di continuità e agilità operativa.

Controlli, conformità e integrità del processo

• Condurre controlli operativi giornalieri, riconciliazione e monitoraggio delle eccezioni per salvaguardare l'accuratezza dei dati e l'affidabilità del processo.

• Sostenere l'adesione alle politiche interne e i requisiti normativi in evoluzione (comprese le iniziative FINMA oversight, SNB).

• Identificare, escalare e risolvere i rischi operativi e gli elementi in sospeso per mantenere la disponibilità di audit.

• Contribuire a raffinare le SOP, i quadri di controllo e le misure di mitigazione dei rischi.

Iniziative strategiche e trasformazione aziendale

• Agire come partner operativo in progetti multifunzionali focalizzati sull'automazione, la digitalizzazione e il miglioramento del customer journey.

• Identificare inefficienze e soluzioni scalabili co-design che elevano produttività e qualità dei servizi.

• Assistere nella definizione di processi futuri-stato, integrazioni tecnologiche e rollout di gestione dei cambiamenti.

Il tuo progetto

• Completata l'istruzione terziaria — una laurea universitaria o una qualifica commerciale (EFZ) con relativa formazione ulteriore

• 3-5 anni di solida esperienza nelle operazioni ipotecarie svizzere o nell'amministrazione dei prestiti, idealmente all'interno di istituti finanziari privati o al dettaglio

• Conoscenza approfondita del ciclo di vita mutuo svizzero, tipi di prodotto, gestione collaterale e relativi flussi di lavoro operativi

• Esperienza dimostrata nella gestione dei dati, nel reporting e nei controlli operativi — la familiarità con le aspettative normative è un vantaggio distinto

• Forte capacità analitiche e un interesse naturale per l'ottimizzazione dei processi, sia nei compiti quotidiani che nelle trasformazioni su larga scala

• Gode di lavoro basato sul progetto; automotivato per prendere l'iniziativa e vedere gli sforzi attraverso il completamento di successo

• Confortevole funzionamento autonomo mentre la costruzione di relazioni efficaci tra dipartimenti e gerarchie

• Fluente in tedesco e inglese (scritto e parlato); la competenza in francese o italiano è un bene significativo

• Avanzato utente di Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint); esperienza precedente con piattaforme di core banking o sistemi CRM/loan è vantaggioso

Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la vostra applicazione di lavoro completa attraverso il nostro strumento di applicazione online. Ulteriori interessanti opportunità di lavoro si possono trovare sul nostro sito Career.
Non è questo che stai cercando? Impostare un avviso di lavoro creando un account candidato qui.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Julius Bär feiern und schätzen wir die individuellen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen, damit Sie wirkungsvoll sein, unternehmerisch handeln, gestärkt werden und Werte jenseits von Wohlstand schaffen können. Gestalten wir gemeinsam die Zukunft des Wealth Managements.

Bei Julius Bär sind wir stolz darauf, unseren Kunden weltweit außergewöhnliche Private-Banking-Dienstleistungen zu bieten. Wir fördern eine Kultur der Exzellenz, Innovation und kontinuierlicher Entwicklung und schaffen Möglichkeiten für talentierte Fachleute, zu wachsen und eine sinnvolle Wirkung zu erzielen.

Um unser führendes Schweizer Hypotheken-Franchise weiter zu stärken, suchen wir einen proaktiven und ergebnisorientierten Operational Excellence Officer, der sich unserem neu gegründeten COO Real Estate Team anschließt. Diese zentrale Rolle bietet die Möglichkeit, die Zukunft unserer nationalen Hypothekengeschäfte zu gestalten, Prozessverbesserungen voranzutreiben und qualitativ hochwertige Dienstleistungen über den gesamten Hypothekenlebenszyklus zu erbringen.

Ihre Rolle – Effizienz, Qualität & Innovation vorantreiben
Als wichtiges Mitglied der Real Estate Operations Unit sorgen Sie für eine reibungslose und konforme Verwaltung des Schweizer Hypothekenportfolios von Julius Bär von der Entstehung bis zur Fälligkeit. Durch die Kombination von Präzision und strategischem Denken verwalten Sie kritische operative Workflows, halten strenge Kontrollstandards ein und liefern umsetzbare Erkenntnisse, die eine fundierte Entscheidungsfindung im gesamten Unternehmen ermöglichen. Sie werden die praktische Umsetzung mit zukunftsweisenden Beiträgen zu transformativen Initiativen in Einklang bringen - und uns dabei helfen, die Messlatte für operative Widerstandsfähigkeit, Digitalisierung und Exzellenz im Kundenservice zu erhöhen.

IHRE HERAUSFORDERUNG
End-to-End Mortgage Operations & Lifecycle Management

• Beaufsichtigen Sie den gesamten Verwaltungsweg der Hypothekarkreditfazilitäten - von der Erstbuchung und den Änderungen bis hin zur Erneuerung, vorzeitigen Rückzahlung und endgültigen Abwicklung.

• Führen Sie Transaktionsaktivitäten mit Genauigkeit und Pünktlichkeit aus, einschließlich neuer Kredite, Änderungen, Refinanzierung und Systemaktualisierungen.

• Gewährleistung einer konsistenten Datenintegrität in allen Kernbanken- und Immobiliensystemen, die als vertrauenswürdige Quelle der Wahrheit dienen.

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Front Office, Mortgage Advisory, Credit Risk, Legal und externen Partnern, um eine nahtlose Kundenerfahrung und operative Agilität zu gewährleisten.

Kontrollen, Compliance & Prozessintegrität

• Tägliche Betriebsprüfungen, Abgleiche und Ausnahmeüberwachung durchführen, um die Datengenauigkeit und Prozesszuverlässigkeit zu gewährleisten.

• Unterstützung der Einhaltung interner Richtlinien und sich entwickelnder regulatorischer Anforderungen (einschließlich der Aufsicht der FINMA, Initiativen der SNB).

• Proaktive Identifizierung, Eskalation und Auflösung von Betriebsrisiken und ausstehenden Punkten, um die Prüfungsbereitschaft aufrechtzuerhalten.

• Beitrag zur Verfeinerung von SOPs, Kontrollrahmen und Risikominderungsmaßnahmen.

Strategische Initiativen & Business Transformation

• Handeln Sie als operativer Partner in funktionsübergreifenden Projekten mit Fokus auf Automatisierung, Digitalisierung und Customer Journey Enhancement.

• Identifizieren Sie Ineffizienzen und gestalten Sie gemeinsam skalierbare Lösungen, die sowohl die Produktivität als auch die Servicequalität erhöhen.

• Unterstützung bei der Gestaltung von Zukunftsprozessen, Technologieintegrationen und Rollouts für das Change Management.

IHR PROFIL

• Abgeschlossene tertiäre Ausbildung — entweder Hochschulabschluss oder kaufmännische Qualifikation (EFZ) mit entsprechender Weiterbildung

• 3-5 Jahre solide Erfahrung im Schweizer Hypothekengeschäft oder in der Kreditverwaltung, idealerweise im Private Banking oder bei Privatkundenfinanzinstituten

• Tiefe Kenntnisse des Schweizer Hypothekenlebenszyklus, der Produkttypen, des Collateral Handlings und der damit verbundenen operativen Workflows

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung im Datenmanagement, in der Berichterstattung und in den betrieblichen Kontrollen - die Vertrautheit mit den regulatorischen Erwartungen ist ein deutlicher Vorteil

• Starke analytische Fähigkeiten und ein natürliches Interesse an Prozessoptimierung, ob bei täglichen Aufgaben oder groß angelegten Transformationen

• Genießt projektbasierte Arbeit; selbstmotiviert, Initiative zu ergreifen und die Bemühungen bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss zu sehen

• Komfortables autonomes Arbeiten beim Aufbau effektiver Beziehungen zwischen Abteilungen und Hierarchien

• Fließend in Deutsch und Englisch (schriftlich und gesprochen); Kenntnisse in Französisch oder Italienisch sind ein wichtiges Gut

• Fortgeschrittener Benutzer der Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint); Vorkenntnisse mit Core-Banking-Plattformen oder CRM / Darlehenssystemen sind von Vorteil

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Julius Baer, nous célébrons et valorisons les qualités individuelles que vous apportez, vous permettant d'avoir un impact, d'être entrepreneur, d'être autonomisé et de créer une valeur au-delà de la richesse. C'est l'avenir de la gestion des richesses.

Chez Julius Baer, nous sommes fiers de fournir des services bancaires privés exceptionnels à nos clients dans le monde entier. Nous favorisons une culture d'excellence, d'innovation et de développement continu, créant des occasions pour les professionnels talentueux de croître et d'avoir un impact significatif.

Pour renforcer encore notre franchise hypothécaire suisse, nous cherchons un agent d'excellence opérationnelle proactif et axé sur les résultats pour rejoindre notre équipe immobilière COO nouvellement créée. Ce rôle central offre l'occasion de façonner l'avenir de nos opérations hypothécaires nationales, d'améliorer les processus et de fournir des services de haute qualité tout au long du cycle de vie des prêts hypothécaires.

Votre rôle – Diriger l'efficacité, la qualité et l'innovation
En tant que membre clé de l'unité d'opérations immobilières, vous assurerez la bonne administration et la conformité du portefeuille hypothécaire suisse Julius Baer. Combinant précision et pensée stratégique, vous gérerez les flux de travail opérationnels critiques, respecterez des normes de contrôle rigoureuses et fournirez des informations pratiques qui permettent une prise de décision éclairée dans toute l'organisation. Vous équilibrerez l'exécution pratique avec des contributions tournées vers l'avenir à des initiatives de transformation, nous aidant à relever la barre dans la résilience opérationnelle, la numérisation et l'excellence du service à la clientèle.

Votre défi
Opérations hypothécaires de bout en bout et gestion du cycle de vie

• Surveiller le parcours administratif complet des établissements hypothécaires — de la réservation initiale et des modifications au renouvellement, remboursement anticipé et règlement final.

• Exécuter les activités transactionnelles avec exactitude et rapidité, y compris les nouveaux prêts, les modifications, le refinancement et les mises à jour du système.

• Assurer l'intégrité des données dans les systèmes bancaires et immobiliers de base, en servant de source de vérité fiable.

• Collaborez étroitement avec les partenaires du Front Office, des Services de conseils en hypothèques, du risque de crédit, du secteur juridique et de l'extérieur afin de garantir une expérience client transparente et une agilité opérationnelle.

Contrôles, conformité et intégrité des processus

• Effectuer des vérifications opérationnelles quotidiennes, des rapprochements et une surveillance des exceptions afin de préserver l'exactitude des données et la fiabilité des processus.

• Appuyer le respect des politiques internes et l'évolution des exigences réglementaires (y compris la surveillance de la FINMA, les initiatives de la BNS).

• Déterminer, intensifier et résoudre les risques opérationnels et les éléments en attente afin de maintenir la capacité de vérification.

• Contribuer à raffiner les PNE, les cadres de contrôle et les mesures d'atténuation des risques.

Initiatives stratégiques et transformation opérationnelle

• Agir en tant que partenaire opérationnel dans les projets interfonctionnels axés sur l'automatisation, la numérisation et l'amélioration du parcours client.

• Identifier les inefficacités et co-concevoir des solutions évolutives qui augmentent la productivité et la qualité du service.

• Aider à façonner les processus futurs, les intégrations technologiques et les déploiements de gestion du changement.

VOTRE PROFIL

• Études supérieures terminées — soit un baccalauréat universitaire, soit une qualification commerciale (EFZ) avec formation complémentaire pertinente

• 3–5 ans d'expérience solide dans les opérations hypothécaires suisses ou l'administration de prêts, idéalement au sein de banques privées ou d'institutions financières de détail

• Connaissance approfondie du cycle de vie des prêts hypothécaires suisses, des types de produits, du traitement des garanties et des flux de travail opérationnels connexes

• Expérience démontrée en matière de gestion des données, de rapports et de contrôles opérationnels — la connaissance des attentes réglementaires constitue un avantage distinct

• Fortes capacités d'analyse et un intérêt naturel pour l'optimisation des processus, que ce soit dans les tâches quotidiennes ou les transformations à grande échelle

• Apprécie le travail basé sur les projets; automotivé pour prendre des initiatives et voir les efforts jusqu'à la réussite

• Confortable fonctionnant de manière autonome tout en établissant des relations efficaces entre les départements et les hiérarchies

• La maîtrise de l'allemand et de l'anglais (écrit et parlé); la maîtrise du français ou de l'italien est un atout important.

• Utilisateur avancé de Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint); expérience préalable avec les plateformes bancaires de base ou les systèmes CRM/prêt est bénéfique

Nous sommes impatients de recevoir votre candidature complète par l'intermédiaire de notre outil d'application en ligne. D'autres possibilités d'emploi intéressantes se trouvent sur notre site de carrière.
Ce n'est pas tout à fait ce que vous cherchez ? Configurez une alerte d'emploi en créant un compte candidat ici.

jobs.title: Senior Java Engineer – HPC Cluster Development & Maintenance, 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

We are seeking a strong Java engineer to develop and maintain a High-Performance Computing (HPC) cluster comprising hundreds of servers (on-premises and augmented by Microsoft Azure). This cluster provides critical computing power to a modern trading floor.

The cluster scheduling and control systems are primarily built in Java, with Apache Ignite as the clustering layer. Jobs are received from internal clients via legacy HTTP and ActiveMQ interfaces, while modern clients use an in-house API developed in Java and Python. System statistics are collected in MongoDB and Elastic/Kibana.

This role requires ensuring high availability for a mission-critical resource, developing a deep understanding of a large existing codebase, and proposing improvements. You will also maintain and enhance multiple monitoring systems for both infrastructure and client job submissions.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Future-proof and maintain Java-based cluster scheduling and control systems

• Ensure high availability and reliability of HPC resources

• Maintain and improve monitoring systems for infrastructure and client submissions

• Collaborate with internal stakeholders to balance resource allocation with business requirements

• Troubleshoot and optimize performance across on-prem and Azure-augmented environments

• Ensure compliance with banking regulatory requirements

YOUR PROFILE

• Strong Java multithreaded development expertise ​(core and enterprise-level)

Experience with:

• Distributed Execution Engines.

• NoSQL Databases

• ActiveMQ (messaging)

• Front-end Web Technologies (legacy UI maintenance)

• Python (for API and tooling)

Familiarity with:

• Azure Portal and Azure SDK for Java

• Red Hat Linux

• Understanding of banking systems and regulatory requirements

• Language: Fluent English; German is a plus

Bonus Skills:

• Scala and C++

• Kubernetes (container orchestration)

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

We are seeking a strong Java engineer to develop and maintain a High-Performance Computing (HPC) cluster comprising hundreds of servers (on-premises and augmented by Microsoft Azure). This cluster provides critical computing power to a modern trading floor.

The cluster scheduling and control systems are primarily built in Java, with Apache Ignite as the clustering layer. Jobs are received from internal clients via legacy HTTP and ActiveMQ interfaces, while modern clients use an in-house API developed in Java and Python. System statistics are collected in MongoDB and Elastic/Kibana.

This role requires ensuring high availability for a mission-critical resource, developing a deep understanding of a large existing codebase, and proposing improvements. You will also maintain and enhance multiple monitoring systems for both infrastructure and client job submissions.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Future-proof and maintain Java-based cluster scheduling and control systems

• Ensure high availability and reliability of HPC resources

• Maintain and improve monitoring systems for infrastructure and client submissions

• Collaborate with internal stakeholders to balance resource allocation with business requirements

• Troubleshoot and optimize performance across on-prem and Azure-augmented environments

• Ensure compliance with banking regulatory requirements

YOUR PROFILE

• Strong Java multithreaded development expertise ​(core and enterprise-level)

Experience with:

• Distributed Execution Engines.

• NoSQL Databases

• ActiveMQ (messaging)

• Front-end Web Technologies (legacy UI maintenance)

• Python (for API and tooling)

Familiarity with:

• Azure Portal and Azure SDK for Java

• Red Hat Linux

• Understanding of banking systems and regulatory requirements

• Language: Fluent English; German is a plus

Bonus Skills:

• Scala and C++

• Kubernetes (container orchestration)

jobs.title: Account Manager Privat Banking - Nordics Zurich 100%
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

In addition to the Assistant Relationship Manager (ARM) Private Banking role profile, the Account Manager Private Banking (AM PB) takes ownership of the account administration, documentation formalities and tasks in daily operations and projects impacting the account administration. In contrast to the Relationship Manager (RM), the AM PB does not have an own client book. The AM PB reaches out to clients where appropriate in close collaboration with the RM. He/she demonstrates excellent professional, personal as well as social skills when liaising with clients and the RM. The AM PB ensures the operational client account management and interacts with internal as well as external stakeholders independently, provides clients with relevant in- formation and supports the RM in implementing customized solutions. Furthermore, the AM PB acts as role model in bringing the best service quality to clients, RMs and Team Heads (THs) in a fast, professional and friendly manner, always living the Julius Baer values (Care, Passion, and Excellence) and thus, helping the team to manage and grow its current client base. He/she channels client feedback to the relevant individuals and departments within the Bank to foster continuous improvement and fast adaptation of processes. The AM PB shows professional commitment to ensuring excellent administration of the account, to clients as well as to the Bank and is willing to go the extra mile.

YOUR CHALLENGE
Client Administration & Management

• Ensures that accurate and high-quality client relationship documentation formalities are met and maintained to a high standard at all times including client identification documentation (CDB), account opening forms and other relevant legal forms

• Actively ensures that operational account management is undertaken professionally, with all tasks/system alerts cleared directly where possible or via RM if investment-related advice is needed

• Where appropriate is part of client meetings and even leads parts of the meeting (e.g. documentation formalities, compliance, other requests of the client) if case allows

• Actively maintains client key data in liaison with the RM to ensure CRM and other data sets are correct for good maintenance of the relationship

• Interacts with clients in an independent and professional manner in all aspects of account management

• Proactively takes the lead in supporting the RMs/TH in client relationship and all related tasks (systems, applications, processes, documents etc.), with high-quality, precision and timely responsiveness

• Ensures operational coverage and client interaction (not advice) within the team during absences.

• Compiles presentations, independently drafts investment proposals and supports in marketing activities

• Creates and provides clients with customized information, reports and statistics, etc.

• Manages the RM/TH’s calendar, prepares client meetings, organizes business trips, completes the post processing of client calls, client meetings or business trips for RMs/THs on his/her own

Business Management

• Manages the internal projects which impact the account relationships of an RM, directly solving the administrative issues that arise and ensuring that all relevant systems are maintained and updated and all documentation collected as necessary

• Collects and shares relevant information, ideas, findings and researchwith colleagues to improve pro- cesses and to increase productivity and quality

• Organises himself/herself in an efficient and compliant manner and ensures timely and appropriate information of the superior

• Conducts reviews, plans ahead and documents his/her own work at all times

• Provides professional input proposals for improvements based on experience, incident occurrence or observation

• Manages the expense claim process for RMs/TH proactively.

Risk Management & Controls

• Actively helps managing risk (support first line of defence), i.e. in client documentation, by raising concerns, following up on issues independently and by escalating when in doubt

• Ensures adherence to local regulations and compliance with internal policies and standards (e.g. new account openings, payment instructions, reviewing client phone calls or signing off at own level of competence etc.) in collaboration with the respective RMs and TH

• Ensures timely clearance of pending items and escalated deficiencies

• Ensures appropriate ethical and compliant behaviour in his/her area of responsibility

• Ensures correct, meaningful and understandable documentation of client interaction/client orders in the corresponding tools (e.g. CRM, DiAS)

YOUR PROFILE
Personal & Social Skills

• Excellent situational adaptability (able to work with RMs and clients from diverse backgrounds)

• Friendly, trustworthy and discreet personality with a high level of risk awareness

• Proactive and independent work approach

• Positive “can do” attitude and approaches challenges with an open mind

• Takes on extra responsibilities at own initiative

• Highly service oriented and passionate about client servicing

• Exceptional communication skills and always communicates in a friendly, competent and professional manner

• Aims for excellence by finding ways to do things smarter, faster, better and is also not afraid to question a status quo

• Systematic, precise and diligent working style and the ability to perform exceedingly well under pressure

• Team player

• High personal integrity and ethical behaviour

• Is a go-to person by e.g. helping colleagues, training other assistants, participating in the “Buddy Programme”

Professional Skills

• Sound affinity with the geographic market(s) covered, i.e. familiar with the legal and regulatory environment as well as cultural awareness

• Profound understanding of relevant products, services as well as tools in Private Banking

• Advanced knowledge of global financial markets and current developments in the industry

Education & Experience

• Either at least 5 years of experience as ARM or 3 years of experience as ARM and job related higher degree (e.g. Bachelor, CFA/AZEK/CAIA), without counting the apprenticeship period

• Excellent language skills (verbal and written) in English is a must, other languages like German, Finnish and Swedish would be a plus

• Proven track record in servicing banking clients with complex needs (on boarding of new clients, maintaining and extending current relationships)

• Successful completion of the internal AM PB training programme
