At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

In addition to the Assistant Relationship Manager (ARM) Private Banking role profile, the Account Manager Private Banking (AM PB) takes ownership of the account administration, documentation formalities and tasks in daily operations and projects impacting the account administration. In contrast to the Relationship Manager (RM), the AM PB does not have an own client book. The AM PB reaches out to clients where appropriate in close collaboration with the RM. He/she demonstrates excellent professional, personal as well as social skills when liaising with clients and the RM. The AM PB ensures the operational client account management and interacts with internal as well as external stakeholders independently, provides clients with relevant in- formation and supports the RM in implementing customized solutions. Furthermore, the AM PB acts as role model in bringing the best service quality to clients, RMs and Team Heads (THs) in a fast, professional and friendly manner, always living the Julius Baer values (Care, Passion, and Excellence) and thus, helping the team to manage and grow its current client base. He/she channels client feedback to the relevant individuals and departments within the Bank to foster continuous improvement and fast adaptation of processes. The AM PB shows professional commitment to ensuring excellent administration of the account, to clients as well as to the Bank and is willing to go the extra mile.

YOUR CHALLENGE
Client Administration & Management

• Ensures that accurate and high-quality client relationship documentation formalities are met and maintained to a high standard at all times including client identification documentation (CDB), account opening forms and other relevant legal forms

• Actively ensures that operational account management is undertaken professionally, with all tasks/system alerts cleared directly where possible or via RM if investment-related advice is needed

• Where appropriate is part of client meetings and even leads parts of the meeting (e.g. documentation formalities, compliance, other requests of the client) if case allows

• Actively maintains client key data in liaison with the RM to ensure CRM and other data sets are correct for good maintenance of the relationship

• Interacts with clients in an independent and professional manner in all aspects of account management

• Proactively takes the lead in supporting the RMs/TH in client relationship and all related tasks (systems, applications, processes, documents etc.), with high-quality, precision and timely responsiveness

• Ensures operational coverage and client interaction (not advice) within the team during absences.

• Compiles presentations, independently drafts investment proposals and supports in marketing activities

• Creates and provides clients with customized information, reports and statistics, etc.

• Manages the RM/TH’s calendar, prepares client meetings, organizes business trips, completes the post processing of client calls, client meetings or business trips for RMs/THs on his/her own

Business Management

• Manages the internal projects which impact the account relationships of an RM, directly solving the administrative issues that arise and ensuring that all relevant systems are maintained and updated and all documentation collected as necessary

• Collects and shares relevant information, ideas, findings and researchwith colleagues to improve pro- cesses and to increase productivity and quality

• Organises himself/herself in an efficient and compliant manner and ensures timely and appropriate information of the superior

• Conducts reviews, plans ahead and documents his/her own work at all times

• Provides professional input proposals for improvements based on experience, incident occurrence or observation

• Manages the expense claim process for RMs/TH proactively.

Risk Management & Controls

• Actively helps managing risk (support first line of defence), i.e. in client documentation, by raising concerns, following up on issues independently and by escalating when in doubt

• Ensures adherence to local regulations and compliance with internal policies and standards (e.g. new account openings, payment instructions, reviewing client phone calls or signing off at own level of competence etc.) in collaboration with the respective RMs and TH

• Ensures timely clearance of pending items and escalated deficiencies

• Ensures appropriate ethical and compliant behaviour in his/her area of responsibility

• Ensures correct, meaningful and understandable documentation of client interaction/client orders in the corresponding tools (e.g. CRM, DiAS)

YOUR PROFILE
Personal & Social Skills

• Excellent situational adaptability (able to work with RMs and clients from diverse backgrounds)

• Friendly, trustworthy and discreet personality with a high level of risk awareness

• Proactive and independent work approach

• Positive “can do” attitude and approaches challenges with an open mind

• Takes on extra responsibilities at own initiative

• Highly service oriented and passionate about client servicing

• Exceptional communication skills and always communicates in a friendly, competent and professional manner

• Aims for excellence by finding ways to do things smarter, faster, better and is also not afraid to question a status quo

• Systematic, precise and diligent working style and the ability to perform exceedingly well under pressure

• Team player

• High personal integrity and ethical behaviour

• Is a go-to person by e.g. helping colleagues, training other assistants, participating in the “Buddy Programme”

Professional Skills

• Sound affinity with the geographic market(s) covered, i.e. familiar with the legal and regulatory environment as well as cultural awareness

• Profound understanding of relevant products, services as well as tools in Private Banking

• Advanced knowledge of global financial markets and current developments in the industry

Education & Experience

• Either at least 5 years of experience as ARM or 3 years of experience as ARM and job related higher degree (e.g. Bachelor, CFA/AZEK/CAIA), without counting the apprenticeship period

• Excellent language skills (verbal and written) in English is a must, other languages like German, Finnish and Swedish would be a plus

• Proven track record in servicing banking clients with complex needs (on boarding of new clients, maintaining and extending current relationships)

• Successful completion of the internal AM PB training programme

Titel des Jobs: Account Manager Private Banking (AM PB)

Beschreibung Bei Julius Baer feiern und schätzen wir die individuellen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen, damit Sie sich einbringen, unternehmerisch sind, gestärkt werden und Wert jenseits des Reichtums schaffen können. Lassen Sie uns gemeinsam die Zukunft des Vermögensmanagements gestalten.

Neben dem Rollenprofil Assistant Relationship Manager (ARM) Private Banking übernimmt der Account Manager Private Banking (AM PB) die Verantwortung für die Kontoverwaltung, die Dokumentationsformalitäten und die Aufgaben im täglichen Betrieb und Projekte, die die Kontoverwaltung beeinflussen. Im Gegensatz zum Relationship Manager (RM) verfügt das AM PB über kein eigenes Kundenbuch. Das AM PB wendet sich bei Bedarf an Kunden in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem RM. Er/sie demonstriert hervorragende fachliche, persönliche sowie soziale Fähigkeiten bei der Verbindung mit Kunden und dem RM.

Die AM PB sorgt für das operative Kundenkontomanagement und interagiert unabhängig mit internen und externen Stakeholdern, stellt Kunden relevante Informationen zur Verfügung und unterstützt die RM bei der Umsetzung maßgeschneiderter Lösungen. Darüber hinaus fungiert die AM PB als Vorbild, um Kunden, RMs und Team Heads (THs) die beste Servicequalität schnell, professionell und freundlich zu bringen, immer die Julius Baer Werte (Care, Passion und Excellence) zu leben und damit dem Team dabei zu helfen, seine aktuelle Kundenbasis zu verwalten und zu erweitern.

Er leitet die Kundenfeedbacks an die zuständigen Personen und Abteilungen innerhalb der Bank weiter, um eine kontinuierliche Verbesserung und schnelle Anpassung der Prozesse zu fördern. Die AM PB zeigt professionelles Engagement, um eine ausgezeichnete Verwaltung des Kontos zu gewährleisten, sowohl für Kunden als auch für die Bank und ist bereit, die zusätzliche Meile zu gehen.

Verantwortung Kundenverwaltung & Management - Stellt sicher, dass genaue und qualitativ hochwertige Dokumentationsformalitäten für Kundenbeziehungen eingehalten und jederzeit auf hohem Standard gehalten werden, einschließlich Kundenidentifikationsdokumentation (CDB), Kontoeröffnungsformularen und anderen relevanten Rechtsformen - Aktiv gewährleistet, dass die operative Kontoführung professionell durchgeführt wird, wobei alle Aufgaben/Systemwarnungen, soweit möglich, direkt gelöscht werden oder über RM, wenn eine investitionsbezogene Beratung erforderlich ist - gegebenenfalls ist Teil von Kundensitzungen und führt sogar Teile der Sitzung (z.B.

Dokumentationsformalitäten, Compliance, andere Anfragen des Kunden) falls Fall ermöglicht - Aktiv hält Client-Schlüsseldaten in Verbindung mit der RM zu gewährleisten, CRM und andere Datensätze sind korrekt für eine gute Aufrechterhaltung der Beziehung - Interagiert mit Kunden in einer unabhängigen und professionellen Art und Weise in allen Aspekten des Account Management - Proaktiv übernimmt die Führung bei der Unterstützung der RMs/TH in der Kundenbeziehung und alle damit verbundenen Aufgaben (Systeme, Anwendungen, Prozesse, Dokumente etc.), mit hoher Qualität, Präzision und zeitnahe Reaktionsfähigkeit - sorgt für operative Abdeckung und Client-Interaktion (nicht

Beratung) im Team während der Abwesenheiten - Kompiliert Präsentationen, unabhängig Entwurf von Anlagevorschlägen und unterstützt in Marketing-Aktivitäten - Erstellt und bietet Kunden mit maßgeschneiderten Informationen, Berichte und Statistiken, etc.

- Verwaltet den RM/TH,s Kalender, bereitet Kundentreffen vor, organisiert Geschäftsreisen, vervollständigt die Nachbearbeitung von Kundenanrufen, Kundentreffen oder Geschäftsreisen für RM/THs auf eigene Faust

Business Management - verwaltet die internen Projekte, die die Kontobeziehungen eines RM beeinflussen, löst direkt die administrativen Probleme, die entstehen und gewährleistet, dass alle relevanten Systeme gepflegt und aktualisiert und alle Dokumentationen, die erforderlich sind, gesammelt werden - sammelt und teilt relevante Informationen, Ideen, Erkenntnisse und Forschung mit Kollegen, um Prozesse zu verbessern und Produktivität und Qualität zu steigern - organisiert sich in einer effizienten und konformen Weise und gewährleistet rechtzeitige und angemessene Informationen des Vorgesetzten - führt Bewertungen, Pläne voraus und Dokumente seine

eigene Arbeit zu allen Zeiten - Bietet professionelle Eingabevorschläge für Verbesserungen auf der Grundlage von Erfahrung, Vorfall oder Beobachtung - verwaltet die Kosten-Antrag Prozess für RMs / TH proaktiv

Risikomanagement & Controls - Aktiv hilft Risikomanagement (Unterstützung erster Verteidigungslinie), d.h. in Kundendokumentation, indem Bedenken geweckt, Fragen unabhängig nachgegangen und eskaliert wird, wenn Zweifel bestehen - Gewährleistung der Einhaltung lokaler Vorschriften und der Einhaltung interner Richtlinien und Standards (z.B.

neue Kontoeröffnungen, Zahlungsanweisungen, Überprüfung von Kundentelefonanrufen oder Abmeldung auf eigener Kompetenzebene etc.) in Zusammenarbeit mit den jeweiligen RMs und TH - Gewährleistung einer rechtzeitigen Freigabe anstehender Gegenstände und eskalierter Mängel - Gewährleistung eines angemessenen ethischen und konformen Verhaltens in seinem Verantwortungsbereich - Gewährleistung einer korrekten, sinnvollen und verständlichen Dokumentation der Kundeninteraktion/Kundenaufträge in den entsprechenden Tools (z.B. CRM, DiAS)

Voraussetzungen Personal & Social Skills - Ausgezeichnete situationsbezogene Anpassungsfähigkeit (fähig für die Arbeit mit RMs und Kunden aus unterschiedlichen Hintergründen) - Freundliche, vertrauenswürdige und diskrete Persönlichkeit mit hohem Risikobewusstsein - Proaktiver und unabhängiger Arbeit Ansatz - Positiv, kann, Haltung und nähert sich Herausforderungen mit offenem Geist - nimmt auf eigene Initiative zusätzliche Verantwortungen an - Hochserviceorientiert und leidenschaftlich über Kundenbetreuung - Außergewöhnliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und immer in einer freundlichen, kompetenten und professionellen Weise kommuniziert - Ziel für Exzellenz durch Suche nach Wegen, um

tun Dinge intelligenter, schneller, besser und hat auch keine Angst, einen Status quo zu hinterfragen - Systematisch, präzise und fleißigen Arbeitsstil und die Fähigkeit, unter Druck äußerst gut zu arbeiten - Teamplayer - Hohe persönliche Integrität und ethisches Verhalten - ist ein go-to-Person von zB.

Unterstützung von Kollegen, Ausbildung anderer Assistenten, Teilnahme am,Buddy-Programm,

Professional Skills - Solide Affinität zu den abgedeckten geografischen Märkten, d.h. vertraut mit dem rechtlichen und regulatorischen Umfeld sowie dem kulturellen Bewusstsein - Profound Verständnis relevanter Produkte, Dienstleistungen sowie Tools im Private Banking - Erweiterte Kenntnisse über globale Finanzmärkte und aktuelle Entwicklungen in der Branche

Was wir anbieten Education & Experience - Entweder mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung als ARM oder 3 Jahre Erfahrung als ARM und berufsbezogene höhere Grad (z.B. Bachelor, CFA/AZEK/CAIA), ohne die Lehrzeit zu zählen - Ausgezeichnete Sprachkenntnisse (verbal und geschrieben) in Englisch ist ein Muss, andere Sprachen wie Deutsch, Finnisch und Schwedisch wäre ein Plus - Bewährte Erfolgsbilanz bei der Betreuung von Bankkunden mit komplexen Bedürfnissen (auf dem Boarding von neuen Kunden, Aufrechterhaltung und Ausbau der aktuellen Beziehungen) - Erfolgreicher Abschluss des internen AM PB-Trainingsprogramm

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Julius Baer, celebriamo e valorizziamo le qualità individuali che portate, permettendovi di essere impeccabili, di essere imprenditoriali, di essere potenziati e di creare valore al di là della ricchezza. Formiamo insieme il futuro della gestione della ricchezza.

Il Assistant Relationship Manager (ARM) Private Banking supporta uno o più Relationship Manager (RM)/ Team Head(s) (TH) nelle operazioni quotidiane, amministrazione, assistenza clienti e gestione delle relazioni. L'ARM interagisce con gli stakeholder interni ed esterni, fornisce ai clienti informazioni rilevanti e supporta il RM nell'implementazione di soluzioni personalizzate. Inoltre, l'ARM agisce come modello di ruolo nel portare la migliore qualità del servizio ai RM/TH in modo rapido, professionale e amichevole, vivendo sempre i valori di Julius Baer (Care, Passione ed Eccellenza) e aiutando così il team a gestire e crescere la sua attuale base clienti. Inserisce il feedback dei clienti per le persone/dipartimenti rilevanti all'interno della Banca per favorire il miglioramento continuo e l'adattamento rapido dei processi. Questa posizione è la spina dorsale della Gestione relazioni cliente.

LA TUA SICUREZZA
Amministrazione clienti e gestione

• Supporta RM/TH nell'interazione client e tutte le attività correlate (sistemi, processi, file, documenti ecc.) con elevata qualità, precisione e tempestiva reattività

• Personalizza le richieste dei clienti (relazione, statistiche, mailings ecc.)

• Gestisce il calendario di RM/TH, prepara le riunioni dei clienti, organizza viaggi di lavoro, completa il post elaborazione delle chiamate client, riunioni dei clienti o viaggi di lavoro per RM/ #

• Compili presentazioni, supporti nella redazione di proposte di investimento e nelle attività di marketing se necessario (accoglienza clienti, riunioni, viaggi di lavoro, eventi ecc.)

• Assicura la copertura in caso di proprie assenze

Gestione aziendale

• Raccoglie e scambia regolarmente informazioni pertinenti necessarie per il lavoro

• Organizza se stesso in modo efficiente e conforme e garantisce informazioni tempestive e appropriate del superiore

• Conduce recensioni, piani avanti e documenta il suo lavoro in ogni momento

• Supporta RM/TH nell'attuazione di progetti e iniziative

• Fornisce proposte di input professionali per miglioramenti basati su esperienza, incidente o osservazione

• Gestisce il processo di richiesta di spesa per RM/TH

Gestione del rischio e controlli

• Aiuta attivamente la gestione del rischio (supporto prima linea di difesa), cioè nella documentazione del cliente, sollevando preoccupazioni, a seguito di problemi e aumentando quando in dubbio

• Assicura l'adesione alle normative locali e la conformità alle politiche e agli standard interni (ad esempio nuove aperture di account, istruzioni di pagamento, la revisione delle telefonate dei clienti o la firma a proprio livello di competenza ecc.) in collaborazione con i rispettivi RM e TH

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

We are seeking an experienced Remote Access Engineer (Citrix NetScaler & Zscaler Private Access) to join our global security engineering team in Zurich. As the ideal candidate, you possess deep expertise in secure remote access technologies, strong authentication and identity integration skills, and hands-on experience operating enterprise-grade remote connectivity platforms within a regulated financial services environment. You are comfortable working across infrastructure, security, endpoint, and identity domains, ensuring that employees, contractors, and approved third parties can securely access corporate resources.

Your primary responsibilities will involve architecting, operating, and continuously improving the Bank’s Citrix NetScaler Gateway infrastructure, integrating and maintaining multi-factor authentication solutions, enforcing secure access and conditional access policies, and ensuring the resilience, security, and compliance of the Bank’s remote access services.

In addition, you will contribute to the design, implementation, and operationalisation of the Bank’s future Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) platform and support the evolution of the remote access landscape towards a modern Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) architecture. Working closely with IAM, Endpoint Management, Security Operations, and Global IT teams, you will help deliver secure, reliable, and scalable remote connectivity aligned with regulatory requirements and the Bank’s strategic security roadmap.

Beyond the remote access domain, you will also have the opportunity to contribute to and gain hands-on experience with other security services managed by the team, including Internet Proxy, Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), Privileged Access Management (PAM), Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), and Secure Mail Gateway solutions. This provides an excellent opportunity for candidates looking to broaden their expertise across multiple security domains and further develop their security engineering career within a collaborative and highly skilled team.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• As part of a dedicated security engineering team, administer, configure, and continuously improve the Bank’s Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway infrastructure, ensuring high availability, performance, scalability, and operational resilience across primary and disaster recovery environments

• Manage and maintain SSL-VPN and clientless access services, including virtual server configurations, authentication policies, rewrite rules, responder policies, and traffic steering mechanisms

• Design, implement, and maintain secure authentication and conditional access policies based on user identity, device type, network location, and contextual risk factors

• Participate in the design, implementation, and rollout of the Bank’s Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) platform, supporting the transition towards a modern Zero Trust Network Access architecture and contributing to technical design, testing, integration, and operational readiness activities

• Develop and maintain expertise across both Citrix NetScaler Gateway and Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) technologies, supporting the Bank’s strategic remote access roadmap and ensuring secure, seamless connectivity across multiple access platforms

• Plan, coordinate, and execute infrastructure upgrades, security patches, policy changes, and platform enhancements in accordance with established change management processes within a regulated financial environment

• Provide 2nd and 3rd level engineering support for the Bank’s remote access platforms, acting as an escalation point for complex incidents and participating in a shared 24/7 on-call rotation for critical services

YOUR PROFILE

• Highly proactive, solution-oriented, and capable of independently assessing, prioritising, and resolving complex technical challenges in a structured and efficient manner

• Strong analytical and conceptual thinking skills with a high level of attention to detail, particularly when working within business-critical and highly regulated environments

• Willingness and curiosity to learn new technologies and expand expertise across multiple security domains, contributing to the continuous evolution of the Bank’s security services

• University degree or higher technical education (university of applied sciences, federal diploma) in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related discipline — or equivalent practical experience

• Minimum 3–5 years of hands-on experience in IT Security or Infrastructure Engineering, with a strong focus on secure remote access, identity management, authentication technologies, and endpoint security

• In-depth expertise in Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway, including hands-on experience with AAA policies, virtual server configuration, SSL-VPN services, high-availability deployments, authentication flows, and troubleshooting via both GUI and CLI

• Knowledge of Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) concepts and architectures; experience with Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) or comparable ZTNA technologies is considered an advantage

• Practical scripting and automation skills using one or more of PowerShell, Python, or Bash, including automation of certificate validation, health checks, log analysis, and operational tasks through REST APIs, Citrix Nitro API, or comparable interfaces

• Practical experience with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Active Directory, and hybrid identity environments

• Proven experience integrating remote access platforms with Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) solutions and modern identity providers

• Strong understanding of endpoint compliance validation, device trust concepts, BYOD access models, and modern remote access security architectures

• Experience working within financial services or other highly regulated industries, with a solid understanding of regulatory and compliance requirements

• Experience supporting and operating business-critical infrastructure platforms with a focus on availability, resilience, performance, and security

• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across global teams and translate technical concepts into practical solutions

• Fluent written and spoken English (B2/C1)

Titolo di lavoro Ingegnere di accesso remoto (Citrix NetScaler & Zscaler Private Access) Descrizione A Julius Baer, celebriamo e valorizziamo le singole qualità che portate, consentendovi di essere efficaci, di essere imprenditoriali, di essere capaci di creare valore oltre la ricchezza. Lasciamoci plasmare insieme il futuro della gestione della ricchezza.
• Stiamo cercando un esperto ingegnere di accesso remoto (Citrix NetScaler & Zscaler Private Access) per entrare a far parte del nostro team di ingegneria globale della sicurezza a Zurigo. Come candidato ideale, possedete una profonda esperienza in tecnologie di accesso remoto sicuro, forti abilità di autenticazione e integrazione dell'identità e un'esperienza pratica nell'esercizio di piattaforme di connettività remota di livello enterprise all'interno di un ambiente di servizi finanziari regolamentati. Siete a vostro agio a lavorare attraverso infrastrutture, sicurezza, endpoint e domini di identità, assicurando che dipendenti, appaltatori e terze parti approvate possano accedere in modo sicuro alle risorse aziendali. Le vostre responsabilità principali saranno l'architettura, il funzionamento e il miglioramento continuo dell'infrastruttura Bank.s Citrix NetScaler Gateway, l'integrazione e il mantenimento di soluzioni di autenticazione multi-fattori, l'applicazione di un accesso sicuro e di politiche di accesso condizionato, e garantire la resilienza, la sicurezza e la conformità dei servizi di accesso remoto della Banca.s. Inoltre, contribuirete alla progettazione, implementazione e implementazione della futura piattaforma Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) e supportate l'evoluzione del paesaggio di accesso remoto verso una moderna architettura Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA). Lavorando a stretto contatto con IAM, Endpoint Management, Security Operations e Global IT team, contribuirete a fornire connettività remota sicura, affidabile e scalabile in linea con i requisiti normativi e la tabella di marcia strategica della Banca per la sicurezza. Oltre al dominio di accesso remoto, avrete anche la possibilità di contribuire e acquisire esperienza pratica con altri servizi di sicurezza gestiti dal team, tra cui Internet Proxy, Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), Privileged Access Management (PAM), Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), e Secure Mail Gateway soluzioni. Ciò offre un'ottima opportunità per i candidati che cercano di ampliare la loro esperienza in più settori di sicurezza e sviluppare ulteriormente la loro carriera di ingegneria della sicurezza all'interno di un team collaborativo e altamente qualificato. descriptionByLocale.en:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

We are seeking an experienced Remote Access Engineer (Citrix NetScaler & Zscaler Private Access) to join our global security engineering team in Zurich. As the ideal candidate, you possess deep expertise in secure remote access technologies, strong authentication and identity integration skills, and hands-on experience operating enterprise-grade remote connectivity platforms within a regulated financial services environment. You are comfortable working across infrastructure, security, endpoint, and identity domains, ensuring that employees, contractors, and approved third parties can securely access corporate resources.

Your primary responsibilities will involve architecting, operating, and continuously improving the Bank’s Citrix NetScaler Gateway infrastructure, integrating and maintaining multi-factor authentication solutions, enforcing secure access and conditional access policies, and ensuring the resilience, security, and compliance of the Bank’s remote access services.

In addition, you will contribute to the design, implementation, and operationalisation of the Bank’s future Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) platform and support the evolution of the remote access landscape towards a modern Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) architecture. Working closely with IAM, Endpoint Management, Security Operations, and Global IT teams, you will help deliver secure, reliable, and scalable remote connectivity aligned with regulatory requirements and the Bank’s strategic security roadmap.

Beyond the remote access domain, you will also have the opportunity to contribute to and gain hands-on experience with other security services managed by the team, including Internet Proxy, Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), Privileged Access Management (PAM), Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), and Secure Mail Gateway solutions. This provides an excellent opportunity for candidates looking to broaden their expertise across multiple security domains and further develop their security engineering career within a collaborative and highly skilled team.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• As part of a dedicated security engineering team, administer, configure, and continuously improve the Bank’s Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway infrastructure, ensuring high availability, performance, scalability, and operational resilience across primary and disaster recovery environments

• Manage and maintain SSL-VPN and clientless access services, including virtual server configurations, authentication policies, rewrite rules, responder policies, and traffic steering mechanisms

• Design, implement, and maintain secure authentication and conditional access policies based on user identity, device type, network location, and contextual risk factors

• Participate in the design, implementation, and rollout of the Bank’s Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) platform, supporting the transition towards a modern Zero Trust Network Access architecture and contributing to technical design, testing, integration, and operational readiness activities

• Develop and maintain expertise across both Citrix NetScaler Gateway and Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) technologies, supporting the Bank’s strategic remote access roadmap and ensuring secure, seamless connectivity across multiple access platforms

• Plan, coordinate, and execute infrastructure upgrades, security patches, policy changes, and platform enhancements in accordance with established change management processes within a regulated financial environment

• Provide 2nd and 3rd level engineering support for the Bank’s remote access platforms, acting as an escalation point for complex incidents and participating in a shared 24/7 on-call rotation for critical services

YOUR PROFILE

• Highly proactive, solution-oriented, and capable of independently assessing, prioritising, and resolving complex technical challenges in a structured and efficient manner

• Strong analytical and conceptual thinking skills with a high level of attention to detail, particularly when working within business-critical and highly regulated environments

• Willingness and curiosity to learn new technologies and expand expertise across multiple security domains, contributing to the continuous evolution of the Bank’s security services

• University degree or higher technical education (university of applied sciences, federal diploma) in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related discipline — or equivalent practical experience

• Minimum 3–5 years of hands-on experience in IT Security or Infrastructure Engineering, with a strong focus on secure remote access, identity management, authentication technologies, and endpoint security

• In-depth expertise in Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway, including hands-on experience with AAA policies, virtual server configuration, SSL-VPN services, high-availability deployments, authentication flows, and troubleshooting via both GUI and CLI

• Knowledge of Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) concepts and architectures; experience with Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) or comparable ZTNA technologies is considered an advantage

• Practical scripting and automation skills using one or more of PowerShell, Python, or Bash, including automation of certificate validation, health checks, log analysis, and operational tasks through REST APIs, Citrix Nitro API, or comparable interfaces

• Practical experience with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Active Directory, and hybrid identity environments

• Proven experience integrating remote access platforms with Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) solutions and modern identity providers

• Strong understanding of endpoint compliance validation, device trust concepts, BYOD access models, and modern remote access security architectures

• Experience working within financial services or other highly regulated industries, with a solid understanding of regulatory and compliance requirements

• Experience supporting and operating business-critical infrastructure platforms with a focus on availability, resilience, performance, and security

• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across global teams and translate technical concepts into practical solutions

• Fluent written and spoken English (B2/C1)

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.

Rejoignez l'équipe de conseil en gestion des risques et de contrôle de Julius Baer dans Global Products & Solutions (GPS) en tant que gestionnaire de risques de la planification de patrimoine, où vous jouerez un rôle crucial dans le maintien de l'intégrité et de l'efficacité du cadre de gestion des risques et de contrôle de la planification de patrimoine.

En tant que l'une des principales banques privées suisses, nous joignons plus de 130 ans de patrimoine à des innovations innovantes et nous offrons des conseils personnalisés, ancrés dans l'expertise du marché et l'engagement personnel.

Le service GPS joue un rôle central dans l'élaboration de stratégies d'investissement axées sur les clients, le développement de produits financiers novateurs et la prestation de conseils d'experts dans toutes les grandes classes d'actifs.

VOS DÉFIS En tant que gestionnaire de risques d'entreprise de la planification de patrimoine GPS, vous jouerez un rôle crucial dans le maintien de l'intégrité et de l'efficacité du cadre de gestion des risques et de contrôle de la planification de patrimoine. En tant que membre clé de l'équipe, vous aurez la possibilité d'avoir un impact significatif, de conduire des gains d'efficacité et de promouvoir notre culture de gestion des risques.

- Être le gestionnaire des risques opérationnels de la division GPS - fournir des conseils d'experts et des conseils sur les risques aux parties prenantes, en veillant à ce que les risques clés soient pris en compte et atténués - concevoir, mettre en oeuvre, évaluer et maintenir le cadre de risque de contrôle du GPS pour renforcer le paysage de contrôle de la sous-unité du PPF conformément aux normes de contrôle interne de la Banque - gérer l'efficacité des contrôles dans l'ensemble de la sous-unité du PPF, identifier les domaines à améliorer et atténuer les risques potentiels pour assurer le respect des exigences réglementaires - évaluer l'impact des changements de la gestion à l'échelle de la banque

les politiques et veiller à ce que les ajustements soient reflétés dans les contrôles internes - Administrer l'outil de contrôle interne (p. ex.

Créer de nouveaux contrôles, modifier les contrôles existants et attribuer les rôles au besoin) central pour la sous-unité du PPF - Offrir une formation ciblée pour promouvoir notre culture de sensibilisation aux risques et de gestion des risques - Collaborer avec des équipes interfonctionnelles et identifier les possibilités d'améliorer l'efficacité fonctionnelle, proposer des améliorations des processus et des contrôles afin de mettre en oeuvre des contrôles efficaces pour atténuer les risques opérationnels clés - Représenter le service GPS dans les comités, projets et groupes de travail de la banque qui se consacrent aux risques pertinents du PPF et/ou aux sujets de contrôle

VOTRE PROFIL - Baccalauréat, diplôme ou équivalent en sciences bancaires et financières, droit, comptabilité ou fiscalité - Les études complémentaires sur les marchés financiers, la planification financière ou le risque sont un atout important (p. ex., CFA, CFP, FRM) - Expérience pertinente de l'industrie : plus de 5 ans d'expérience professionnelle de préférence dans le secteur bancaire privé, en mettant l'accent sur le risque, la législation, la conformité ou la planification de patrimoine/services fiduciaires - Connaissance approfondie des principes de gestion du risque et de vérification - Excellente capacité d'interaction, de communication et de présentation - Bonne compréhension des services bancaires

les processus liés à la planification de patrimoine et/ou aux services fiduciaires/fiduciaires - Expertise en analyse de données (en profondeur), en évaluation des lacunes et en développement d'options de solution - Capacité de travailler de façon indépendante dans une structure d'équipe globale, d'assumer des initiatives et d'avoir une façon précise et structurée de travailler - Personnalité hautement motivée avec une orientation marquée, du cran, de l'attitude et de la solution - Fluent en anglais (l'allemand est un avantage important) - Admissibilité au travail dans le pays d'application

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

You are a member of the System Architects team within global IT Architecture. Together with your colleagues from the Domain and Foundation Architecture teams, you are responsible for designing Solution Architectures.

As a System Architect within the ML & AI ART, you are responsible for defining and aligning the end‑to‑end system architecture for enterprise AI and ML solutions. Your objective is to ensure the ART delivers scalable, secure, and reusable AI capabilities aligned with enterprise architecture principles, target architectures, and business priorities, while enabling efficient and high-quality delivery across teams.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• You design and are responsible for the Solution Architecture of applications and AI platform components in delivery

• You ensure that Solution Architectures in delivery adhere to architecture standards and are aligned with the target architectures of the domain

• You initiate architecture decisions, document them as Architecture Decision Records (ADR) and have them approved by the relevant architecture boards

• You advise and coach software engineers on the implementation of Solution Architectures and ensure technical feasibility

Within the ML & AI ART in collaboration with the Lead Architect, you:

• Apply and refine the ART‑level target architecture within team and initiative contexts

• Drive hands‑on architectural design for AI and ML solutions within the teams, balancing consistency while addressing delivery needs

• Support the delivery of key ART initiatives (e.g. the AI automation orchestration layer) by translating high‑level architecture into concrete solution designs

• Ensure alignment and integration with enterprise platforms, data capabilities, security standards, and MLOps services

• Identify architectural risks, dependencies, and technical debt at team and solution level, and escalate them proactively

• Contribute architectural input to PI Planning, backlog refinement, and roadmap discussions from a delivery and feasibility perspective

• Act as the primary architectural contact for assigned teams, while aligning closely with the Lead Architect and other System Architects

YOUR PROFILE

• At least 3 years of experience as a Senior Architect in complex IT environments

• At least 5 years of experience as a Lead or Senior Software Engineer, with hands-on responsibility including practical experience with AI/ML solutions and platforms

• Responsible for solution architectures: from design and implementation to operation

• Ability to identify options for solution architectures and make trade-off architecture decisions

• Collaboratively develop and coordinate solutions with business and technology stakeholders and architecture colleagues

• Proactive mindset, able to work under pressure and meet deadlines

• Practical experience designing and delivering AI and ML solutions in scalable enterprise platforms

• Strong understanding of AI/ML solution patterns, data pipelines, orchestration, and platform integration

• Ability to translate ART- and domain-level target architectures into practical, team-level solution designs

• Experience working across multiple teams while maintaining architectural alignment and consistency

• Ability to identify architectural risks and technical debt early and address them constructively

• Strong communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain architectural topics to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a comparable field

• Additional certifications are an advantage (e.g. SAFe, cloud, architecture, or AI/ML-related certifications)

• English: business fluent

• Solid foundation in software and system architecture, including modern architectural styles such as event-driven architectures, microservices, and modular monoliths

• Strong understanding of distributed systems, APIs, and platform integration patterns

• Practical familiarity with AI/ML platforms and ecosystems, including data pipelines, orchestration, and model lifecycle concepts

• Experience working with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and operational considerations in production environments

• Ability to work effectively in agile and SAFe environments using common collaboration and delivery tooling

Responsabilità Sei membro del team System Architects nell'ambito dell'architettura IT globale. Insieme ai tuoi colleghi dei team Domain and Foundation Architecture, sei responsabile della progettazione di soluzioni Architectures.

In qualità di System Architect all'interno di ML & AI ART, è responsabile della definizione e dell'allineamento dell'architettura di sistema end-to-end per le soluzioni aziendali AI e ML. Il vostro obiettivo è garantire che l'ART fornisca capacità di intelligenza mobile, sicura e riutilizzabile in linea con i principi di architettura aziendale, le architetture di destinazione e le priorità aziendali, consentendo nel contempo una consegna efficiente e di alta qualità tra i team.

LA SFIDA

- Progetti e sei responsabile per la soluzione Architettura delle applicazioni e componenti della piattaforma AI in consegna - Tu assicuri che le soluzioni Architetture in consegna rispettino gli standard di architettura e siano allineate con le architetture target del dominio - Tu inizi le decisioni di architettura, le documenti come Architecture Decision Records (ADR) e le faccia approvare dai rispettivi pannelli di architettura - Tu consigli e alleni gli ingegneri software sull'implementazione delle soluzioni Architetture e assicuri la fattibilità tecnica

All'interno della ML & AI ART in collaborazione con l'architetto leader, si:

- Applicare e perfezionare l'architettura di destinazione a livello ART all'interno di team e contesti di iniziativa - Guidare la progettazione architettonica pratica per soluzioni AI e ML all'interno dei team, bilanciare la coerenza e rispondere alle esigenze di consegna - Sostenere la realizzazione di iniziative ART chiave (ad esempio.

il livello di orchestrazione dell'automazione AI) traducendo l'architettura di alto livello in progetti di soluzioni concrete - Garantire l'allineamento e l'integrazione con piattaforme aziendali, capacità di dati, standard di sicurezza e servizi MLOps - Identificare i rischi architettonici, le dipendenze e il debito tecnico a livello di team e soluzioni, e intensificarli in modo proattivo - Contribuire l'input architettonico a PI Pianificazione, perfezionamento del ritardo e discussioni di roadmap da una prospettiva di consegna e fattibilità - Agire come il contatto architettonico primario per i team assegnati, pur allineandosi strettamente con l'Architetto Lead

e altri System Architects

Requisiti del tuo profilo

- Almeno 3 anni di esperienza come Senior Architect in ambienti IT complessi - Almeno 5 anni di esperienza come Lead o Senior Software Engineer, con responsabilità pratica, compresa l'esperienza pratica con soluzioni e piattaforme AI/ML - Responsabile per architetture di soluzioni: dalla progettazione e implementazione al funzionamento - Capacità di identificare opzioni per architetture di soluzioni e prendere decisioni di architettura trade-off - sviluppare e coordinare in modo diabolico soluzioni con stakeholder di business e tecnologia e colleghi di architettura - Mindset proattivo, in grado di lavorare sotto

pressione e rispettare le scadenze - esperienza pratica nella progettazione e fornitura di soluzioni AI e ML nelle piattaforme aziendali a scala mobile - comprensione approfondita dei modelli di soluzioni AI/ML, dei condotti di dati, dell'orchestrazione e dell'integrazione delle piattaforme - capacità di tradurre architetture target a livello di ART e dominio in progetti pratici di soluzioni a livello di team - esperienza lavorando in più team mantenendo l'allineamento architettonico e la coerenza - capacità di identificare i rischi architettonici e il debito tecnico in anticipo e di affrontarli in modo costruttivo - abilità comunicative forti, con la capacità di

spiegare chiaramente gli argomenti architettonici sia agli stakeholder tecnici che non tecnici - Laurea magistrale in Informatica, Ingegneria o un campo comparabile - Le certificazioni aggiuntive sono un vantaggio (ad esempio.

SAFe, cloud, architettura o certificazioni AI/ML) - Inglese: business fluent - Fondamenti solidi in software e architettura di sistema, inclusi stili architettonici moderni come architetture guidate da eventi, microservizi e monoliti modulari - Forte comprensione di sistemi distribuiti, API e schemi di integrazione delle piattaforme - Practical perfotity with AI/ML platforms and ecosystems, including data pipelines, orchestration, and model lifecycle concepts - Experience working with CI/CD Pipelines, DevOps practices, and operational dealnerings in production envirours - Ability

lavorare efficacemente in ambienti agali e SAFE utilizzando strumenti comuni di collaborazione e consegna

Cosa offriamo Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la tua applicazione di lavoro completo attraverso il nostro strumento di applicazione online. Ulteriori interessanti opportunità di lavoro possono essere trovati sul nostro sito Career.

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

This role focuses on executing client tax reporting and withholding tax reclaim activities, ensuring compliance with policies while providing expert support in resolving complex tax-related issues. • Execute complex controls

• Manage incidents and resolutions

• Support the development of new solutions

• Handle single queries of high complexity

• Responsible for managing the day-to-day usage of key tools and processes

• Team player

• Distinct customer and service orientation

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Representation of Product Control as part of the replacement programme of the Swiss host (core banking) platform: Ensuring the Product Control related business requirements are accurately represented and configured in the target core banking system

• Impact Assessment Product Control: Gathering of business requirements for Product Control applications (SAP and GTMatch-based) resulting from the core banking and markets / new risk management system implementation

• Data Analysis: Collect, analyse, and interpret business data requirements for the Product Control domain

• Solution Development: Collaborate with IT teams to design, implement, and test solutions, ensuring alignment with business objectives and stakeholder expectations

• Change Management: Support organisational change by communicating and syndication changes to stakeholders

• Test Management: Managing the testing activities for the Product Control function across SIT, UAT and dress rehearsal incl. support of test case creation and defect management

YOUR PROFILE

• Experience in large scale transformation programmes in the banking industry

• Strong experience in Product Control and banking operations in particular regarding finance system’s integration with upstream applications such as trading platforms (Front Arena or Murex is a plus) and downstream applications such as core banking or reconciliation tools

• Solid understanding of processes and requirements regarding P&L generation, valuation adjustments as well as bank-wide front to back reconciliations

• Hands-on experience in supporting the end-to-end testing as part of a large scale transformation programme as well as knowledge of the various testing types - SIT, UAT, regression, and end-to-end integration testing

• Solid understanding of financial products and services (e.g. Structured or OTC products, Exchange-traded Derivatives) and their process-wise interplay with Operations, Markets and Finance

• Hands-on and delivery focussed

• Fluency in English; German skills are beneficial

• Esperienza nei programmi di trasformazione su larga scala nel settore bancario

• Solida comprensione dei processi e dei requisiti per quanto riguarda la generazione P&L, le regolazioni di valutazione, così come il fronte a livello bancario per le riconciliazione posteriori

• Hands-on e consegna messa a fuoco

jobs.title: Business Manager Intermediaries, Geneva, 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

The Business Manager Intermediaries will serve as a fully integrated role bridging central coordination and on-site operational support across the Market Intermediaries Western Switzerland & Americas. Combining the strategic and tactical responsibilities, this position ensures efficient execution of global initiatives while providing responsive, market-level support to front-line leaders and stakeholders.

Acting as a two-way conduit between Internal Units and the respective Intermediaries Market, the Business Manager Intermediaries drives alignment, enhances communication, and supports sustainable business growth through structured coordination and operational excellence.

YOUR CHALLENGE
Front-Line Operational Support

• Provide direct assistance to the Market Head Intermediaries Western Switzerland & Americas, as well as ad-hoc support to Group Heads and Relationship Managers

• Organize and coordinate Management Committees, regular business reviews and strategy sessions

• Track action items etc.; ensure accountability and follow-through

Strategic Coordination & Governance

• Serve as primary liaison between the Intermediaries segment, in particular Market Intermediaries Western Switzerland & Americas, and central/global functions (e.g., Compliance, IT, Marketing, Operations), facilitating smooth exchange of information and requirements

• Coordinate the implementation of bank-wide projects, initiatives, and regulatory changes at the market level, ensuring adherence to timelines and quality standards

• Represent the Intermediaries segment in cross-functional working groups; contribute market-relevant perspectives to shaping strategies and solutions

Top-Down Execution

• Receive, evaluate, and prepare centrally driven topics for local adaptation and distribution

• Disseminate approved directives, guidelines, and campaign materials to front-line units

• Monitor execution progress, identify roadblocks, and report outcomes back to central stakeholders

Bottom-Up Escalation

• Act as first point of contact for front-line inputs, feedback, and proposals; conduct initial assessment and prioritization

• Consolidate, refine, and forward relevant market-generated content to central bodies for consideration or action

• Advocate for practical adjustments based on real-world constraints or client needs

Project & Process Management

• Develop presentations, briefing notes, status updates, and decision dossiers for senior management

• Identify recurring inefficiencies and propose structural improvements

• Lead or co-manage workstreams

Deputy Function

• Step in to handle key business management tasks when needed, ensuring smooth operations during absences or busy periods

YOUR PROFILE
Qualifications & Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, or a related discipline (Master’s degree considered advantageous)

• Minimum of 5 years’ professional experience within private banking, wealth management, or financial services, with demonstrated exposure to both operational support and strategic coordination

• Prior experience in a business management, executive support, or intermediary-facing role strongly preferred

• Solid understanding of Swiss banking practices, regulatory expectations, and front-office workflows

Required Skills & Competencies

• Exceptional enthusiasm, with excellent organizational and time-management abilities with keen attention to detail

• Strong analytical skills with proficiency in synthesizing complex information into clear summaries

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills in French and English (additional fluency in Spanish and/or German is highly beneficial)

• High level of autonomy combined with teamwork orientation and service-mindedness

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Julius Baer, celebriamo e valorizziamo le qualità individuali che portate, permettendovi di essere impeccabili, di essere imprenditoriali, di essere potenziati e di creare valore al di là della ricchezza. Formiamo insieme il futuro della gestione della ricchezza.

Gli Intermediari di Business Manager serviranno come un ruolo completamente integrato che corrode il coordinamento centrale e il supporto operativo in loco attraverso gli Intermediari di mercato della Svizzera occidentale e delle Americhe. Combinando le responsabilità strategiche e tattiche, questa posizione garantisce un'esecuzione efficiente delle iniziative globali, fornendo supporto reattivo e di livello di mercato ai leader e agli stakeholder di prima linea.

Agendo come un condotto a due vie tra le unità interne e il rispettivo mercato intermedio, gli intermediari di Business Manager guida l'allineamento, migliora la comunicazione e supporta la crescita aziendale sostenibile attraverso il coordinamento strutturato e l'eccellenza operativa.

LA TUA SICUREZZA
Supporto operativo a prima linea

• Fornire assistenza diretta agli Intermediari di Market Head Western Svizzera & Americas, nonché supporto ad-hoc ai responsabili di Gruppo e Relazioni

• Organizzare e coordinare comitati di gestione, regolari recensioni aziendali e sessioni di strategia

• Monitorare gli elementi di azione ecc.; garantire la responsabilità e il follow-through

Coordinamento strategico e governance

• Serve come collegamento primario tra il segmento Intermediari, in particolare Intermediari di Mercato Svizzera occidentale e Americas, e funzioni centrali/globali (ad esempio, Compliance, IT, Marketing, Operazioni), facilitando lo scambio regolare di informazioni e requisiti

• Coordinare l'implementazione di progetti, iniziative e cambiamenti normativi a livello di mercato, assicurando l'adesione a tempi e standard di qualità

• Rappresentare il segmento Intermediari in gruppi di lavoro interfunzionali; contribuire prospettive di mercato rilevanti per modellare strategie e soluzioni

Esecuzione top-down

• Ricevi, valuta e prepara argomenti guidati centralmente per l'adattamento e la distribuzione locali

• Disseminare le direttive, le linee guida e i materiali di campagna approvati alle unità di prima linea

• Monitorare i progressi dell'esecuzione, identificare i blocchi stradali e riportare i risultati alle parti interessate centrali

Escalation inferiore

• Agire come primo punto di contatto per ingressi, feedback e proposte di prima linea; condurre la valutazione iniziale e la priorità

• Consolidare, perfezionare e trasmettere contenuti generati dal mercato agli organismi centrali per la considerazione o l'azione

• Avvocato per adeguamenti pratici basati su vincoli reali o esigenze del cliente

Gestione dei progetti e dei processi

• Sviluppare presentazioni, note di briefing, aggiornamenti di stato e dossier di decisione per la gestione senior

• Identificare inefficienze ricorrenti e proporre miglioramenti strutturali

• Flussi di lavoro di piombo o cogestione

Funzione aggiuntiva

• Passo per gestire i compiti chiave di gestione aziendale quando necessario, assicurando operazioni fluide durante le assenze o periodi occupati

Il tuo progetto
Qualifiche e esperienza

• Corso di laurea in Business Administration, finanza, economia, o una disciplina correlata (il grado di Master considerato vantaggioso)

• Esperienza professionale minima di 5 anni all’interno del private banking, della gestione patrimoniale o dei servizi finanziari, con esposizione dimostrata al supporto operativo e al coordinamento strategico

• Esperienza prioritaria in una gestione aziendale, supporto esecutivo o ruolo intermedio fortemente preferito

• Solida comprensione delle pratiche bancarie svizzere, delle aspettative normative e dei flussi di lavoro di front-office

Competenze e competenze necessarie

• Eccezionale entusiasmo, con eccellenti capacità organizzative e di gestione del tempo con cura attenta ai dettagli

• Forte capacità analitiche con competenza nel sintetizzare informazioni complesse in sintesi chiare

• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione verbale e scritta in francese e inglese (influenza aggiuntiva in spagnolo e/o tedesco è altamente vantaggioso)

• Alto livello di autonomia combinato con l'orientamento del lavoro di squadra e la mentalità del servizio

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Julius Baer, nous célébrons et valorisons les qualités individuelles que vous apportez, vous permettant d'avoir un impact, d'être entrepreneur, d'être autonomisé et de créer une valeur au-delà de la richesse. C'est l'avenir de la gestion des richesses.

Le Business Manager Intermediaries jouera un rôle pleinement intégré qui reliera la coordination centrale et le soutien opérationnel sur place dans les intermédiaires du marché de la Suisse occidentale et des Amériques. Combinant les responsabilités stratégiques et tactiques, ce poste assure l'exécution efficace des initiatives mondiales tout en fournissant un soutien adapté au niveau du marché aux dirigeants de première ligne et aux intervenants.

Agissant comme un canal bidirectionnel entre les unités internes et le marché des intermédiaires, le Business Manager Intermediaries stimule l'alignement, améliore la communication et soutient la croissance durable des entreprises par une coordination structurée et l'excellence opérationnelle.

Votre défi
Soutien opérationnel de première ligne

• Fournir une assistance directe aux intermédiaires du marché Suisse occidentale et Amériques, ainsi qu'un soutien ad hoc aux chefs de groupe et aux gestionnaires de relations

• Organiser et coordonner des comités de gestion, des examens réguliers des activités et des séances de stratégie

• Suivre les mesures à prendre, etc.; assurer la responsabilisation et le suivi

Coordination stratégique et gouvernance

• Servir de liaison principale entre le segment des intermédiaires, en particulier les intermédiaires du marché de la Suisse occidentale et des Amériques, et les fonctions centrales et mondiales (p. ex., conformité, TI, marketing, opérations), en facilitant l'échange d'informations et les exigences

• Coordonner la mise en oeuvre de projets, d'initiatives et de changements réglementaires à l'échelle de la banque au niveau du marché, en veillant au respect des délais et des normes de qualité

• Représenter le segment des intermédiaires dans les groupes de travail interfonctionnels; contribuer à l'élaboration de stratégies et de solutions en fonction du marché

Exécution de haut niveau

• Reçoit, évalue et prépare des thèmes centralisés pour l'adaptation et la distribution locales

• Diffuser les directives, lignes directrices et matériel de campagne approuvés aux unités de première ligne

• Surveiller les progrès de l'exécution, identifier les barrages routiers et rendre compte des résultats aux intervenants centraux

Escalade ascendante

• Agir comme premier point de contact pour les contributions, les commentaires et les propositions de première ligne; procéder à une évaluation initiale et établir des priorités

• Consolider, affiner et transmettre le contenu pertinent généré par le marché aux organes centraux pour examen ou action

• Plaidoyer pour des ajustements pratiques basés sur les contraintes réelles ou les besoins des clients

Gestion de projet et de processus

• Élaborer des présentations, des notes d'information, des mises à jour et des dossiers de décision pour la haute direction

• Identifier les inefficacités récurrentes et proposer des améliorations structurelles

• Secteurs de travail du plomb ou de la cogestion

Fonction adjointe

• Étape dans la gestion des tâches clés de gestion d'entreprise au besoin, en assurant des opérations en douceur pendant les absences ou les périodes occupées

VOTRE PROFIL
Qualifications et expérience

• Baccalauréat en administration des affaires, finances, économie, ou une discipline connexe (diplôme de maîtrise considéré comme avantageux)

• Au moins 5 ans d'expérience professionnelle au sein de la banque privée, de la gestion de patrimoine ou des services financiers, avec une exposition démontrée au soutien opérationnel et à la coordination stratégique

• Expérience antérieure dans un rôle de gestion d'entreprise, de soutien aux cadres ou d'intermédiaire fortement préféré

• Une bonne compréhension des pratiques bancaires suisses, des attentes en matière de réglementation et des flux de travail de première ligne

Compétences requises

• Un enthousiasme exceptionnel, avec d'excellentes capacités organisationnelles et de gestion du temps avec une attention particulière aux détails

• Fortes compétences analytiques en synthèse d'informations complexes

• Excellentes compétences en communication orale et écrite en français et en anglais (une maîtrise supplémentaire en espagnol et/ou en allemand est très bénéfique)

• Niveau élevé d'autonomie associé à l'orientation du travail d'équipe et à l'esprit de service

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

The Communication Specialist is responsible for driving and delivering high-impact internal and external communications in direct support of the Region Heads, Western Markets & Switzerland. In close collaboration with senior leadership and the Regional Chief of Staff, this role plans, develops, and executes strategic communication initiatives of the Region Heads that advance regional priorities, strengthen leadership visibility, and foster informed, engaged stakeholders across markets.

Operating at the centre of regional decision-making, the specialist ensures consistency, quality, and timing of all executive-level messaging — acting as a key enabler of reputational strength and organisational alignment.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Lead the development and delivery of executive communications for the Region Heads, including speeches, talking points, board updates, internal announcements, media contributions, and event briefings

• Act as primary writer and editor for all formal communications published/presented under the Region Heads’ names, ensuring strategic coherence, tonal appropriateness, and brand compliance

• Manage end-to-end production, from concept and drafting to editorial approval, translation coordination, and multi-channel distribution

• Design and execute integrated communication plans to support major business milestones, change initiatives, and leadership engagements

• Develop engaging formats — including slide decks, infographics, video scripts, podcasts, and digital features — to enhance reach and retention among employees and clients

• Engage proactively with Market Leaders and regional stakeholders to align messaging, capture local insights, and amplify key themes across Western Markets & Switzerland

YOUR PROFILE
Qualifications & Experience:

• University degree in Communications, Journalism, Public Affairs, or a related discipline

• Minimum of 5-8 years of experience in corporate communications, public relations, or journalism, preferably within wealth management or financial services

• Demonstrable record of successfully managing executive communications in complex organisations

Essential Skills and Requirements:

• Native or fluent proficiency in English (written and spoken) — mandatory

• Proficiency in Spanish is a plus (but not mandatory), reflecting regional engagement priorities

• Outstanding writing, editing, and narrative-building skills — with ability to distil complex topics into clear, compelling messages

• Direct experience working alongside senior executives and operating confidently in high-expectation environments

• Expertise in crafting content for diverse channels: print, digital, presentation, and broadcast

• Highly organised with strong project management abilities; adept at balancing competing demands without compromising quality

• Discreet and ethical in handling confidential and sensitive information

Behaviours & Personal Impact:

• Professional Excellence: Delivers polished, error-free work under pressure and short timelines

• Leadership Partnership: Builds trusted relationships through reliability, insight, and proactive support

• Stakeholder Engagement: Communicates with clarity, empathy, and cultural sensitivity across levels and geographies

• Initiative & Ownership: Anticipates needs, acts autonomously, and drives outcomes without oversight

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Julius Baer, celebriamo e valorizziamo le qualità individuali che portate, permettendovi di essere impeccabili, di essere imprenditoriali, di essere potenziati e di creare valore al di là della ricchezza. Formiamo insieme il futuro della gestione della ricchezza.

Lo Specialista della Comunicazione è responsabile per la guida e la fornitura di comunicazioni interne ed esterne ad alto impatto a supporto diretto dei Capi di Regione, dei Mercati occidentali e della Svizzera. In stretta collaborazione con la leadership senior e il Capo di Stato Maggiore Regionale, questo ruolo pianifica, sviluppa ed esegue iniziative strategiche di comunicazione dei Capi Regione che avanzano le priorità regionali, rafforzano la visibilità della leadership e favoriscono gli stakeholders informati e impegnati in tutti i mercati.

Operando al centro del processo decisionale regionale, lo specialista assicura la coerenza, la qualità e la tempistica di tutta la messaggistica a livello esecutivo - che agisce come un fattore chiave di forza reputazionale e allineamento organizzativo.

LA TUA SICUREZZA

• Guidare lo sviluppo e la consegna di comunicazioni esecutive per i Capi di Regione, tra cui discorsi, punti di conversazione, aggiornamenti di bordo, annunci interni, contributi multimediali e briefing eventi

• Atto come scrittore e redattore primario per tutte le comunicazioni formali pubblicate/presentate sotto i nomi dei Heads della Regione, assicurando coerenza strategica, idoneità tonale e conformità del marchio

• Gestire la produzione end-to-end, dal concetto e dalla redazione all'approvazione editoriale, al coordinamento delle traduzioni e alla distribuzione multicanale

• Progettare ed eseguire piani di comunicazione integrati per supportare importanti pietre miliari aziendali, cambiare iniziative e impegni di leadership

• Sviluppare formati coinvolgenti - tra cui piattaforme di scorrimento, infografiche, script video, podcast e funzioni digitali - per migliorare la portata e la ritenzione tra dipendenti e clienti

• Impegnarsi in modo proattivo con i leader di mercato e gli stakeholder regionali per allineare la messaggistica, catturare le intuizioni locali e amplificare i temi chiave su Western Markets & Switzerland

Il tuo progetto
Qualificazioni & Esperienza:

• Laurea in Comunicazione, Giornalismo, Affari Pubblici, o una disciplina correlata

• Minimo di 5-8 anni di esperienza nelle comunicazioni aziendali, nelle pubbliche relazioni o nel giornalismo, preferibilmente all'interno della gestione patrimoniale o dei servizi finanziari

• Registrazione dimostrabile di gestire con successo le comunicazioni esecutive in organizzazioni complesse

Competenze e Requisiti essenziali:

• Competenza nativa o fluente in inglese (scritta e parlata) — obbligatoria

• La competenza in spagnolo è un vantaggio (ma non obbligatorio), che riflette le priorità di impegno regionali

• Eccezionale capacità di scrittura, editing e creazione di narrazioni — con la capacità di distilare argomenti complessi in messaggi chiari e convincenti

• Esperienza diretta che lavora a fianco di dirigenti senior e funziona con fiducia in ambienti ad alta previsione

• Competenza nella realizzazione di contenuti per diversi canali: stampa, digitale, presentazione e trasmissione

• Altamente organizzato con forti capacità di gestione del progetto; adatto a bilanciare le richieste concorrenti senza compromettere la qualità

• Discreto ed etico nella gestione di informazioni riservate e sensibili

Comportamenti e impatto personale:

• Eccellenza professionale: Fornisce lavoro lucido e privo di errori sotto pressione e tempi brevi

• Leadership Partnership: Costruire relazioni di fiducia attraverso affidabilità, comprensione e supporto proattivo

• Stakeholder Engagement: Comunica con chiarezza, empatia e sensibilità culturale su livelli e geografie

• Iniziativa & ProprietÃ: gli anticipati hanno bisogno, agisce autonomamente e spinge i risultati senza supervisione

Bei Julius Bär feiern und schätzen wir die individuellen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen, damit Sie wirkungsvoll sein, unternehmerisch handeln, gestärkt werden und Werte jenseits von Wohlstand schaffen können. Gestalten wir gemeinsam die Zukunft des Wealth Managements.

Der Kommunikationsspezialist ist verantwortlich für die Steuerung und Bereitstellung einer wirkungsvollen internen und externen Kommunikation zur direkten Unterstützung der Region Heads, Western Markets & Switzerland. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsleitung und dem regionalen Stabschef plant, entwickelt und führt diese Rolle strategische Kommunikationsinitiativen der Leiter der Region durch, die regionale Prioritäten vorantreiben, die Sichtbarkeit von Führungskräften stärken und informierte, engagierte Interessengruppen auf allen Märkten fördern.

Der Spezialist, der im Zentrum der regionalen Entscheidungsfindung tätig ist, sorgt für Konsistenz, Qualität und Timing aller Nachrichten auf Führungsebene und fungiert als Schlüsselfaktor für Reputationsstärke und organisatorische Ausrichtung.

IHRE HERAUSFORDERUNG

• Führen Sie die Entwicklung und Bereitstellung von Executive Communications für die Leiter der Region, einschließlich Reden, Talking Points, Board Updates, interne Ankündigungen, Medienbeiträge und Event Briefings

• Handeln Sie als Hauptautor und Herausgeber für alle formalen Mitteilungen, die unter den Namen der Region Heads veröffentlicht / präsentiert werden, um strategische Kohärenz, tonale Angemessenheit und Markenkonformität zu gewährleisten

• Verwalten Sie die End-to-End-Produktion, vom Konzept und der Erstellung bis hin zur redaktionellen Genehmigung, Übersetzungskoordination und Multi-Channel-Verteilung

• Design und Umsetzung integrierter Kommunikationspläne zur Unterstützung wichtiger Geschäftsmeilensteine, Veränderungsinitiativen und Führungsverpflichtungen

• Entwickeln Sie ansprechende Formate - einschließlich Foliendecks, Infografiken, Videoskripten, Podcasts und digitalen Funktionen -, um die Reichweite und Bindung zwischen Mitarbeitern und Kunden zu verbessern

• Engagieren Sie sich proaktiv mit Marktführern und regionalen Stakeholdern, um das Messaging abzustimmen, lokale Erkenntnisse zu erfassen und Schlüsselthemen in den westlichen Märkten und der Schweiz zu erweitern

IHR PROFIL
Qualifikationen & Erfahrung:

• Universitätsabschluss in Kommunikation, Journalismus, Public Affairs oder einer verwandten Disziplin

• Mindestens 5-8 Jahre Erfahrung in Unternehmenskommunikation, Public Relations oder Journalismus, vorzugsweise im Bereich Wealth Management oder Finanzdienstleistungen

• Nachweisbarer Erfolg bei der Verwaltung der Exekutivkommunikation in komplexen Organisationen

Wesentliche Fähigkeiten und Anforderungen:

• Muttersprachliche oder fließende Englischkenntnisse (schriftlich und gesprochen) — obligatorisch

• Spanischkenntnisse sind ein Plus (aber nicht obligatorisch), was die regionalen Engagement-Prioritäten widerspiegelt

• Herausragende Schreib-, Bearbeitungs- und Erzählfähigkeiten - mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe Themen in klare, überzeugende Botschaften zu destillieren

• Direkte Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit leitenden Führungskräften und zuversichtlich in anspruchsvollen Umgebungen

• Expertise in der Gestaltung von Inhalten für verschiedene Kanäle: Print, Digital, Präsentation und Broadcast

• Hoch organisiert mit starken Projektmanagementfähigkeiten; fähig, konkurrierende Anforderungen auszugleichen, ohne die Qualität zu beeinträchtigen

• Diskret und ethisch im Umgang mit vertraulichen und sensiblen Informationen

Verhaltensweisen und persönliche Auswirkungen:

• Professional Excellence: Liefert polierte, fehlerfreie Arbeit unter Druck und kurze Zeitpläne

• Leadership Partnership: Aufbau vertrauenswürdiger Beziehungen durch Zuverlässigkeit, Einsicht und proaktive Unterstützung

• Stakeholder-Engagement: Kommuniziert mit Klarheit, Empathie und kultureller Sensibilität über Ebenen und Regionen hinweg

• Initiative & Ownership: Antizipiert Bedürfnisse, handelt autonom und treibt Ergebnisse ohne Aufsicht voran

Votre défi

• Diriger l'élaboration et la prestation des communications de la haute direction pour les chefs de région, y compris les discours, les points de discussion, les mises à jour du conseil, les annonces internes, les contributions des médias et les séances d'information sur les événements

• Agir en tant que rédacteur principal et rédacteur en chef pour toutes les communications officielles publiées/présentées sous les noms des chefs régionaux, en assurant la cohérence stratégique, l'adéquation tonale et la conformité de la marque

• Gérer la production de bout en bout, du concept et de la rédaction à l'approbation éditoriale, la coordination de la traduction et la distribution multicanal

• Concevoir et exécuter des plans de communication intégrés pour appuyer les grandes étapes opérationnelles, les initiatives de changement et les engagements en matière de leadership

• Un bilan démontrable de la gestion réussie des communications exécutives dans des organisations complexes

• Compétences exceptionnelles en matière d'écriture, d'édition et d'élaboration de textes narratifs, capables de diffuser des messages clairs et convaincants sur des sujets complexes

• Expérience directe en travaillant aux côtés des cadres supérieurs et en travaillant avec confiance dans des environnements à forte attente

• Expertise dans l'élaboration de contenus pour différents canaux : impression, numérique, présentation et diffusion

LA TUA SICUREZZA

• Supporta la RM e il team nell'interazione client in tutti gli aspetti

• Partecipa alle chiamate in arrivo e prende azione rapida

• Mantiene e aggiorna i record di istruzioni, dettagli e preferenze del cliente. Crea report basati sul sistema per la RM

• Elabora gli ordini, gli scambi, le transazioni, il posizionamento dei pagamenti (e-channel esterni) e gestisce ed esegue le richieste dei clienti

• Aiuta a promuovere l'uso e l'adozione dei nostri intermediari dedicati & FO e-channel

• Monitora l'elenco di scadenza per i depositi, i prestiti, i mestieri; agisce quando l'istruzione è standard, cerca istruzioni (da RM o cliente) se necessario e richiesto

• Aderenza completa in ogni momento alla conformità, linee guida legali, regole interne, regolamenti e politiche

• È una prima linea di difesa del rischio, attraverso l'aumento delle preoccupazioni, a seguito di problemi e l'escalation come necessario

• Conoscenze fondazionali dei mercati finanziari: struttura, funzione e ambiente legale/regolatorio e consapevolezza del settore

• Esperienza comprovata che coinvolge intermediari finanziari, come uffici multifamiliari e/o gestori patrimoniali, idealmente all'interno di un ambiente di private banking o asset management

• Compresa comprensione dei prodotti e dei servizi pertinenti applicabili ai clienti EAM, oltre ai principi di valutazione

• Eccellente capacità organizzative, in grado di lavorare rapidamente, indipendentemente all'interno dell'ambito RM Assistant e con precisione anche sotto pressione

• Proattivo, amichevole e soluzione- così come l'atteggiamento orientato al cliente

• Forte giocatore di squadra con eccellenti capacità di comunicazione

• Aspetto professionale, integrità personale e alta consapevolezza del rischio / mentalità etica
