L'adjoint soutient l'équipe et les gestionnaires de relations (GR) avec toutes les demandes d'Intermediaries & FO et de clients finals sur les aspects commerciaux et opérationnels - avec l'objectif d'assurer des opérations sans faille et des réponses rapides, compétentes et complètes. Les responsabilités comprennent le placement des commandes, le traitement des demandes des clients, l'exécution des paiements et le placement des prêts et des dépôts. L'exactitude et l'actualité sont primordiales, avec un traitement efficace des demandes de renseignements et de la fourniture de données, et une escalade vers les collègues supérieurs au besoin. La RM s'appuie sur l'adjoint pour promouvoir et desservir les canaux électroniques dédiés aux intermédiaires et au FO et pour traiter les demandes et demandes connexes.
L'adjoint participe à l'échange continu d'information avec les RM, ainsi qu'avec les intervenants internes et externes dans le cadre des activités avec les clients. En tant que tels, ils constituent un modèle de soins professionnels, compétents et de haute qualité pour nos clients et la base de nos équipes Front réussies.

Votre défi

• Soutient la RM et l'équipe dans l'interaction client à tous égards

• Assister aux appels entrants et agir rapidement

• Tenir et mettre à jour les dossiers des instructions, des détails et des préférences des clients. Crée des rapports basés sur le système pour la RM

• Fournit aux clients des informations et des données verbales et/ou écrites, ne donnant aucun avis ni aucune déclaration d'opinion comme jugement de valeur

• Traitement des ordres, métiers, transactions, placement des paiements (hors canaux électroniques) et traite et exécute les demandes des clients

• Aide à promouvoir l'utilisation et l'adoption de nos canaux électroniques dédiés Intermédiaires et FO

• Surveille la liste des échéances pour les dépôts, les prêts, les transactions; prend des mesures lorsque l'instruction est standard, demande des instructions (à la RM ou au client) si nécessaire et nécessaire

• Organiser et suivre les réunions des clients, y compris la logistique et la préparation des documents

• Soutient la RM dans les enquêtes et le dépannage, en maintenant une collaboration étroite entre les banques et les équipes/unités internes

• Respect intégral en tout temps de la conformité, des directives juridiques, des règles internes, des règlements et des politiques

• Est une première ligne de défense des risques, en soulevant des préoccupations, en assurant le suivi des questions et en intensifiant au besoin

VOTRE PROFIL

• Connaissance fondamentale des marchés financiers: structure, fonction et environnement juridique/réglementaire ainsi que sensibilisation de l'industrie

• Expérience éprouvée avec des intermédiaires financiers, tels que des bureaux multifamiliaux et/ou des gestionnaires de patrimoine, idéalement dans un environnement bancaire privé ou de gestion d'actifs

• Compréhension approfondie des produits et services pertinents applicables aux clients du MAE, plus les principes d'évaluation

• Excellentes compétences organisationnelles, capables de travailler rapidement, indépendamment dans le cadre de la RM adjointe et avec précision même sous pression

• Une attitude proactive, amicale et orientée vers le client

• Fort joueur d'équipe avec d'excellentes compétences en communication

• L'apparence professionnelle, l'intégrité personnelle impactée et élevée et la sensibilisation au risque/l'état d'esprit éthique

• Très bonnes compétences MS Office

• Forte maîtrise de l'anglais (oral et écrit) et d'autres langues selon les exigences du marché

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

At Julius Baer, we believe our people are our greatest asset. The Talent Management and Employer of Choice team attracts and empowers top talent, driving key initiatives such as the global promotion (framework) or the company-led talent management process, the interns first strategy or our AI empowered talent marketplace. As part of the Talent Acquisition and Management team, your team plays a strategic role across the HR value chain from attracting and hiring to developing and empowering our people as trusted advisors and strategic partners.

Joining the Talent Management and Employer of choice team offers a unique opportunity. This role allows you to make a meaningful contribution to our talent management strategy while experiencing the dynamic environment of Julius Baer.

You will work closely with HR colleagues and stakeholders, to continue to deliver an impactful talent strategy. As a trusted advisor, you will bring energy, empathy, and expertise to our team.

We are seeking a highly dedicated and proactive professional to temporarily assume responsibility for all the key operational aspects of the global promotion processes especially driving the senior promotion process and other initiatives like internal mobility or internal talent marketplace. This fixed-term role is critical to ensuring continuity and excellence in the delivery of the overall talent management journey and associated development offerings across the organisation.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Oversee the global promotion process, with special focus on driving the senior promotion process 2026/2027

• Drive strategic talent initiatives i.e. internal mobility, internal talent marketplace

• Lead, support and participate actively in various projects within the People, Brand & Marketing unit

• Work very closely together with colleagues driving the topics

YOUR PROFILE

• Personal & social

• You are passionate about developing talent and unlocking potential

• You are resilient, flexible and adaptable

Professional & Technical

• Master’s degree in HR, business or related field

• 3-5 years’ experience in human capital consulting or equivalent professional advisory environment or

• 4-6 years’ experience in HR project roles within financial industry

• Experience in implementing and managing promotion processes, internal mobility and talent marketplace processes

• Confident in dealing with line managers and employees of different hierarchies and personalities in an international environment

• Proficient user of Workday and advanced knowledge of Microsoft office suite (in particular PowerPoint and Excel, of help if familiar with VBA)

• Fluent in English and German, excellent in verbal and written communication

• You are proactive and self-motivated

• You navigate and adapt effectively and independently within changing situation

• Empathetic communicator who builds trust quickly

• Committed to fostering an inclusive environment where diverse talents thrive

Unirsi al Talent Management e datori di lavoro di squadra di scelta offre un'opportunità unica. Questo ruolo consente di dare un contributo significativo alla nostra strategia di gestione del talento, vivendo l'ambiente dinamico di Julius Baer.

Si lavorerà a stretto contatto con i colleghi e le parti interessate delle risorse umane, per continuare a fornire una strategia di talento efficace. Come consulente di fiducia, porterà energia, empatia e competenze al nostro team.

Siamo alla ricerca di un professionista altamente dedicato e proattivo ad assumersi temporaneamente la responsabilità di tutti gli aspetti operativi chiave dei processi di promozione globale, soprattutto guidando il processo di promozione senior e altre iniziative come la mobilità interna o il mercato del talento interno. Questo ruolo a tempo determinato è fondamentale per garantire continuità ed eccellenza nella consegna del percorso globale di gestione del talento e delle offerte di sviluppo associate in tutta l'organizzazione.

LA TUA SICUREZZA

• Superare il processo di promozione globale, con particolare attenzione alla guida del processo di promozione senior 2026/2027

• Guidare iniziative strategiche del talento, ovvero mobilità interna, mercato del talento interno

• Lavorare molto a stretto contatto con i colleghi che guidano gli argomenti

Il tuo progetto

• Personale e sociale

• Sei appassionato di sviluppare talento e sbloccare il potenziale

• Sei resistente, flessibile e adattabile

Professionista e Tecnica

• Laurea magistrale in HR, business o campo correlato

• 3-5 anni di esperienza nella consulenza del capitale umano o nell’ambiente di consulenza professionale equivalente o

• 4-6 anni di esperienza nei ruoli di progetto HR nell’industria finanziaria

• Esperienza nell'attuazione e nella gestione di processi di promozione, mobilità interna e processi di mercato del talento

• Fiducia nell'affrontare manager e dipendenti di diverse gerarchie e personalità in un ambiente internazionale

• L'utente competente di Workday e la conoscenza avanzata di Microsoft office suite (in particolare PowerPoint ed Excel, di aiuto se familiarità con VBA)

• Fluente in inglese e tedesco, eccellente nella comunicazione verbale e scritta

• Siete proattivi e automotivati

• Si naviga e si adatta in modo efficace e indipendente all'interno della situazione di cambiamento

Bei Julius Bär feiern und schätzen wir die individuellen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen, damit Sie wirkungsvoll sein, unternehmerisch handeln, gestärkt werden und Werte jenseits von Wohlstand schaffen können. Gestalten wir gemeinsam die Zukunft des Wealth Managements.

Bei Julius Bär glauben wir, dass unsere Mitarbeiter unser größtes Kapital sind. Das Team Talent Management und Employer of Choice zieht Top-Talente an und stärkt sie, indem es wichtige Initiativen wie die globale Förderung (Rahmen) oder den unternehmensgeführten Talentmanagement-Prozess, die erste Strategie für Praktikanten oder unseren KI-fähigen Talentmarkt vorantreibt. Als Teil des Talent Acquisition and Management-Teams spielt Ihr Team eine strategische Rolle in der gesamten HR-Wertschöpfungskette, von der Gewinnung und Einstellung bis hin zur Entwicklung und Stärkung unserer Mitarbeiter als vertrauenswürdige Berater und strategische Partner.

Der Beitritt zum Talent Management und Employer of Choice Team bietet eine einzigartige Gelegenheit. Diese Rolle ermöglicht es Ihnen, einen sinnvollen Beitrag zu unserer Talentmanagement-Strategie zu leisten und gleichzeitig das dynamische Umfeld von Julius Bär zu erleben.

Sie werden eng mit HR-Kollegen und Stakeholdern zusammenarbeiten, um weiterhin eine wirkungsvolle Talentstrategie zu liefern. Als vertrauenswürdiger Berater bringen Sie Energie, Empathie und Expertise in unser Team.

Wir suchen einen engagierten und proaktiven Fachmann, der vorübergehend die Verantwortung für alle wichtigen operativen Aspekte der globalen Promotion-Prozesse übernimmt, insbesondere für den Senioren-Promotion-Prozess und andere Initiativen wie interne Mobilität oder interner Talentmarkt. Diese befristete Rolle ist von entscheidender Bedeutung für die Gewährleistung von Kontinuität und Exzellenz bei der Bereitstellung des gesamten Talentmanagements und der damit verbundenen Entwicklungsangebote im gesamten Unternehmen.

IHRE HINWEISE

• Beaufsichtigen Sie den globalen Promotion-Prozess mit besonderem Fokus auf der Förderung von Senioren 2026/2027

• Förderung strategischer Talentinitiativen, z. B. interne Mobilität, interner Talentmarkt

• Führen, unterstützen und beteiligen Sie sich aktiv an verschiedenen Projekten innerhalb der Einheit People, Brand & Marketing

• Arbeiten Sie sehr eng mit Kollegen zusammen, die die Themen vorantreiben

IHR PROFIL

• Persönlich & sozial

• Sie sind leidenschaftlich daran interessiert, Talente zu entwickeln und Potenzial freizusetzen

• Sie sind widerstandsfähig, flexibel und anpassungsfähig

Professionell und technisch

• Master-Abschluss in HR, Business oder verwandten Bereichen

• 3-5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Humankapitalberatung oder einem gleichwertigen professionellen Beratungsumfeld oder

• 4-6 Jahre Erfahrung in HR-Projektrollen in der Finanzindustrie

• Erfahrung in der Umsetzung und Verwaltung von Promotionsprozessen, internen Mobilitäts- und Talentmarktprozessen

• Vertrauen im Umgang mit Vorgesetzten und Mitarbeitern unterschiedlicher Hierarchien und Persönlichkeiten im internationalen Umfeld

At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Lead the technical implementation of the Enterprise Data Management Ecosystem with IDMC mainly based on Data Governance, Catalog and Data Quality

• Design and maintain the metamodel (combination of conceptual and physical)

• Implement and configure workflows and UI in IDMC like dashboards, search queries

• Integrate Data Quality with Data Governance and Catalog

• Design and implement CAI processes

• Ideally also support Reference Data Design and implementation

• Support in documenting infrastructure, security, service and operations assets

• Support in managing and ordering of roles / IAM packages

• Solid experience with Cloud Data Governance and Catalog (CDGC) or Axon Data Governance (On-Prem solution), as well as with Metadata command centre

• Experience with Cloud Application Integration (CAI), Cloud Data Integration (CDI), Data Quality and Profiling as well as Data Marketplace is a big plus

• Proven track record in Data Modelling, Data Management

• Understanding of business user needs and documenting requirements; being able to explain technical processes/concepts in business language

• Experience in translating business requirements in the right solution into the tool

• Ability to configure/implement as well as support other team members with implementation

• Planning of new services / features as well as experience in workflow automation

• Certifications related to Data Governance and Catalog

• Strong team player with a very high level on self-motivation

• Customer oriented with focus to support an organisation in providing solutions

• Fluent in English (written and verbal); German language skills are a plus

At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

As part of the Emerging Markets Business Development team, you will work closely with the Region Head, Market Heads and key stakeholders across the organisation to drive business performance and strategic growth initiatives.

This is a highly analytical role for a professional who enjoys working with large and complex datasets, transforming data into meaningful insights, and translating numbers into concrete business actions. Beyond technical analytical skills, you will be expected to understand the broader business context, connect information from multiple sources, identify opportunities and risks, and provide recommendations that support senior management decision-making.
The role offers exposure to strategic initiatives across the Region, business planning, performance management and executive communications.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Own and further develop the Region’s business analytics and reporting framework, ensuring data quality, consistency and transparency

• Support forecasting and business planning processes through quantitative analysis

• Analyse complex business data and identify trends, opportunities, risks and performance drivers across Markets and client segments

• Consolidate and interpret large datasets from multiple sources to generate actionable insights and recommendations

• Lead, coordinate and support strategic and business development initiatives across the Region

• Respond to ad hoc analytical requests from senior management with clear, data-driven recommendations

YOUR PROFILE

• Relevant higher educational and professional background

• Wealth Management solutions and product know-how

• Project Management skills

• Very strong analytical, conceptual and problem-solving skills

• Know-how and applied experience in building and maintaining data queries

• Proficient user in MS Office applications, especially Excel

• Independent, efficient, proactive and meticulous work method

• Strong communication, presentation and interpersonal skills

• Able to work under pressure and manage a portfolio of tasks

jobs.title: Account Manager Private Banking - Zurich Senior Client Executive 1
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

In addition to the Assistant Relationship Manager (ARM) Private Banking role profile, the Account Manager Private Banking (AM PB) takes ownership of the account administration, documentation formalities and tasks in daily operations and projects impacting the account administration. In contrast to the Relationship Manager (RM), the AM PB does not have an own client book. The AM PB reaches out to clients where appropriate in close collaboration with the RM. He/she demonstrates excellent professional, personal as well as social skills when liaising with clients and the RM. The AM PB ensures the operational client account management and interacts with internal as well as external stakeholders independently, provides clients with relevant in- formation and supports the RM in implementing customized solutions. Furthermore, the AM PB acts as role model in bringing the best service quality to clients, RMs and Team Heads (THs) in a fast, professional and friendly manner, always living the Julius Baer values (Care, Passion, and Excellence) and thus, helping the team to manage and grow its current client base. He/she channels client feedback to the relevant individuals and departments within the Bank to foster continuous improvement and fast adaptation of processes. The AM PB shows professional commitment to ensuring excellent administration of the account, to clients as well as to the Bank and is willing to go the extra mile.

YOUR CHALLENGE
Client Administration & Management

• Ensures that accurate and high-quality client relationship documentation formalities are met and maintained to a high standard at all times including client identification documentation (CDB), account opening forms and other relevant legal forms

• Actively ensures that operational account management is undertaken professionally, with all tasks/system alerts cleared directly where possible or via RM if investment-related advice is needed

• Where appropriate is part of client meetings and even leads parts of the meeting (e.g. documentation formalities, compliance, other requests of the client) if case allows

• Actively maintains client key data in liaison with the RM to ensure CRM and other data sets are correct for good maintenance of the relationship

• Interacts with clients in an independent and professional manner in all aspects of account management

• Proactively takes the lead in supporting the RMs/TH in client relationship and all related tasks (systems, applications, processes, documents etc.), with high-quality, precision and timely responsiveness

• Ensures operational coverage and client interaction (not advice) within the team during absences.

• Compiles presentations, independently drafts investment proposals and supports in marketing activities

• Creates and provides clients with customized information, reports and statistics, etc.

• Manages the RM/TH’s calendar, prepares client meetings, organizes business trips, completes the post processing of client calls, client meetings or business trips for RMs/THs on his/her own

Business Management

• Manages the internal projects which impact the account relationships of an RM, directly solving the administrative issues that arise and ensuring that all relevant systems are maintained and updated and all documentation collected as necessary

• Collects and shares relevant information, ideas, findings and researchwith colleagues to improve pro- cesses and to increase productivity and quality

• Organises himself/herself in an efficient and compliant manner and ensures timely and appropriate information of the superior

• Conducts reviews, plans ahead and documents his/her own work at all times

• Provides professional input proposals for improvements based on experience, incident occurrence or observation

• Manages the expense claim process for RMs/TH proactively.

Risk Management & Controls

• Actively helps managing risk (support first line of defence), i.e. in client documentation, by raising concerns, following up on issues independently and by escalating when in doubt

• Ensures adherence to local regulations and compliance with internal policies and standards (e.g. new account openings, payment instructions, reviewing client phone calls or signing off at own level of competence etc.) in collaboration with the respective RMs and TH

• Ensures timely clearance of pending items and escalated deficiencies

• Ensures appropriate ethical and compliant behaviour in his/her area of responsibility

• Ensures correct, meaningful and understandable documentation of client interaction/client orders in the corresponding tools (e.g. CRM, DiAS)

YOUR PROFILE
Personal & Social Skills

• Excellent situational adaptability (able to work with RMs and clients from diverse backgrounds)

• Friendly, trustworthy and discreet personality with a high level of risk awareness

• Proactive and independent work approach

• Positive “can do” attitude and approaches challenges with an open mind

• Takes on extra responsibilities at own initiative

• Highly service oriented and passionate about client servicing

• Exceptional communication skills and always communicates in a friendly, competent and professional manner

• Aims for excellence by finding ways to do things smarter, faster, better and is also not afraid to question a status quo

• Systematic, precise and diligent working style and the ability to perform exceedingly well under pressure

• Team player

• High personal integrity and ethical behaviour

• Is a go-to person by e.g. helping colleagues, training other assistants, participating in the “Buddy Programme”

Professional Skills

• Sound affinity with the geographic market(s) covered, i.e. familiar with the legal and regulatory environment as well as cultural awareness

• Profound understanding of relevant products, services as well as tools in Private Banking

• Advanced knowledge of global financial markets and current developments in the industry

Education & Experience

• Either at least 5 years of experience as ARM or 3 years of experience as ARM and job related higher degree (e.g. Bachelor, CFA/AZEK/CAIA), without counting the apprenticeship period

• Excellent language skills in German and English is a must

• Proven track record in servicing banking clients with complex needs (on boarding of new clients, maintaining and extending current relationships)

• Successful completion of the internal AM PB training programme

At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

In addition to the Assistant Relationship Manager (ARM) Private Banking role profile, the Account Manager Private Banking (AM PB) takes ownership of the account administration, documentation formalities and tasks in daily operations and projects impacting the account administration. In contrast to the Relationship Manager (RM), the AM PB does not have an own client book. The AM PB reaches out to clients where appropriate in close collaboration with the RM. He/she demonstrates excellent professional, personal as well as social skills when liaising with clients and the RM. The AM PB ensures the operational client account management and interacts with internal as well as external stakeholders independently, provides clients with relevant in- formation and supports the RM in implementing customized solutions. Furthermore, the AM PB acts as role model in bringing the best service quality to clients, RMs and Team Heads (THs) in a fast, professional and friendly manner, always living the Julius Baer values (Care, Passion, and Excellence) and thus, helping the team to manage and grow its current client base. He/she channels client feedback to the relevant individuals and departments within the Bank to foster continuous improvement and fast adaptation of processes. The AM PB shows professional commitment to ensuring excellent administration of the account, to clients as well as to the Bank and is willing to go the extra mile.

YOUR CHALLENGE
Client Administration & Management

• Ensures that accurate and high-quality client relationship documentation formalities are met and maintained to a high standard at all times including client identification documentation (CDB), account opening forms and other relevant legal forms

• Actively ensures that operational account management is undertaken professionally, with all tasks/system alerts cleared directly where possible or via RM if investment-related advice is needed

• Where appropriate is part of client meetings and even leads parts of the meeting (e.g. documentation formalities, compliance, other requests of the client) if case allows

• Actively maintains client key data in liaison with the RM to ensure CRM and other data sets are correct for good maintenance of the relationship

• Interacts with clients in an independent and professional manner in all aspects of account management

• Proactively takes the lead in supporting the RMs/TH in client relationship and all related tasks (systems, applications, processes, documents etc.), with high-quality, precision and timely responsiveness

• Ensures operational coverage and client interaction (not advice) within the team during absences.

• Compiles presentations, independently drafts investment proposals and supports in marketing activities

• Creates and provides clients with customized information, reports and statistics, etc.

• Manages the RM/TH’s calendar, prepares client meetings, organizes business trips, completes the post processing of client calls, client meetings or business trips for RMs/THs on his/her own

Business Management

• Manages the internal projects which impact the account relationships of an RM, directly solving the administrative issues that arise and ensuring that all relevant systems are maintained and updated and all documentation collected as necessary

• Collects and shares relevant information, ideas, findings and researchwith colleagues to improve pro- cesses and to increase productivity and quality

• Organises himself/herself in an efficient and compliant manner and ensures timely and appropriate information of the superior

• Conducts reviews, plans ahead and documents his/her own work at all times

• Provides professional input proposals for improvements based on experience, incident occurrence or observation

• Manages the expense claim process for RMs/TH proactively.

Risk Management & Controls

• Actively helps managing risk (support first line of defence), i.e. in client documentation, by raising concerns, following up on issues independently and by escalating when in doubt

• Ensures adherence to local regulations and compliance with internal policies and standards (e.g. new account openings, payment instructions, reviewing client phone calls or signing off at own level of competence etc.) in collaboration with the respective RMs and TH

• Ensures timely clearance of pending items and escalated deficiencies

• Ensures appropriate ethical and compliant behaviour in his/her area of responsibility

• Ensures correct, meaningful and understandable documentation of client interaction/client orders in the corresponding tools (e.g. CRM, DiAS)

YOUR PROFILE
Personal & Social Skills

• Excellent situational adaptability (able to work with RMs and clients from diverse backgrounds)

• Friendly, trustworthy and discreet personality with a high level of risk awareness

• Proactive and independent work approach

• Positive “can do” attitude and approaches challenges with an open mind

• Takes on extra responsibilities at own initiative

• Highly service oriented and passionate about client servicing

• Exceptional communication skills and always communicates in a friendly, competent and professional manner

• Aims for excellence by finding ways to do things smarter, faster, better and is also not afraid to question a status quo

• Systematic, precise and diligent working style and the ability to perform exceedingly well under pressure

• Team player

• High personal integrity and ethical behaviour

• Is a go-to person by e.g. helping colleagues, training other assistants, participating in the “Buddy Programme”

Professional Skills

• Sound affinity with the geographic market(s) covered, i.e. familiar with the legal and regulatory environment as well as cultural awareness

• Profound understanding of relevant products, services as well as tools in Private Banking

• Advanced knowledge of global financial markets and current developments in the industry

Education & Experience

• Either at least 5 years of experience as ARM or 3 years of experience as ARM and job related higher degree (e.g. Bachelor, CFA/AZEK/CAIA), without counting the apprenticeship period

• Excellent language skills in German and English is a must

• Proven track record in servicing banking clients with complex needs (on boarding of new clients, maintaining and extending current relationships)

• Successful completion of the internal AM PB training programme

jobs.title: Application Responsible & Integrator SaaS Trading Solutions 100% (f/m/d) (Contract through our external payroll partner, immediate start for 12 months, possible extension)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

We are seeking an experienced Application Responsible/IT Service Owner to join Markets Technology in the Global Products & Solutions division. As a key member of our team, you will play a crucial role in delivering high-quality services to internal and external clients, collaborating closely with external SaaS partners, and ensuring the smooth operation of our trading solutions.

As an Application Responsible/IT Service Owner, you will act as a gateway to our external providers and as a key integrator of their solutions, representing the bank's interests in terms of service quality. Your primary responsibility will be to own the technical front-to-end solution integration and maintenance, ensuring seamless connectivity, data processing, and security.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Act as the end-to-end Application Responsible and IT Service Owner for strategic fund management and investment analytics applications, ensuring stable operations, availability, performance, and continuous improvement

• Own the technical and functional integration of applications within the broader technology landscape, including interfaces to market data providers, portfolio management systems, reporting platforms, data warehouses, and downstream consumers

• Serve as the primary point of contact for internal stakeholders across Fund Management, Investment Controlling, Risk Management, Operations, and Technology teams

• Manage relationships with external SaaS vendors and service providers, ensuring service quality, SLA adherence, issue resolution, and alignment with business priorities

• Lead and coordinate application changes, releases, upgrades, and lifecycle management activities while ensuring minimal business disruption

• Analyse business requirements and translate them into sustainable technical solutions in collaboration with business users, architects, developers, and vendors

• Maintain system documentation, application inventories, interface specifications, operational procedures, and architecture repositories

• Monitor application health, data quality, and operational processes, proactively identifying risks and opportunities for improvement

• Ensure seamless data integration, reconciliation, and processing across connected systems while maintaining data accuracy and consistency

• Support audits, regulatory requirements, and internal governance processes by ensuring compliance with security, risk, and operational standards

• Manage user access, entitlement reviews, and application security controls in line with corporate policies and regulatory requirements

• Perform hands-on configuration, troubleshooting, scripting, and support activities where required

• Periodically review vendor services, licensing models, and internal cost allocations to drive efficiency and optimize operating costs.

• Participate in strategic initiatives and projects aimed at enhancing fund management capabilities, improving data quality, and expanding the application ecosystem

YOUR PROFILE

• 5-10 years of experience as an Application Owner, IT Service Owner, Application Manager, or in a similar role within Financial Services

• Understanding of Asset Management, Fund Administration, Alternative Investments, Private Markets, Hedge Funds, or Multi-Asset investment processes is a big plus

• Experience managing SaaS solutions and third-party vendor relationships

• Strong knowledge of application integration, data flows, APIs, file-based interfaces, and cloud-based platforms

• Experience working with investment, portfolio, and fund data

• Understanding of IT Service Management, incident management, change management, and operational governance

• Hands-on technical skills in SQL, scripting, data analysis, and troubleshooting

• Experience working in regulated financial environments and managing security and compliance requirements

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to bridge business and technology domains

• Enthusiastic team player with a hands-on, can-do attitude, able to work effectively with cross-functional teams

• Ability to clearly articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

• Strong prioritisation skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines in a fast-paced environment

• Strong analytical skills, with the ability to analyse complex problems, identify solutions, and orchestrate implementation

• English Business fluent, native language (C1/2)

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Julius Baer, celebriamo e valorizziamo le qualità individuali che portate, permettendovi di essere impeccabili, di essere imprenditoriali, di essere potenziati e di creare valore al di là della ricchezza. Formiamo insieme il futuro della gestione della ricchezza.

Stiamo cercando un esperto Application Responsible/IT Service Owner per unire Markets Technology nella divisione Global Products & Solutions. Come membro chiave del nostro team, si svolgerà un ruolo cruciale nella fornitura di servizi di alta qualità a clienti interni ed esterni, collaborando a stretto contatto con i partner esterni SaaS, e garantendo il buon funzionamento delle nostre soluzioni di trading.

In qualità di Titolare del Servizio Responsabile/IT dell'Applicazione, Lei fungerà da gateway per i nostri fornitori esterni e come integratore chiave delle loro soluzioni, rappresentando gli interessi della banca in termini di qualità del servizio. La vostra responsabilità primaria sarà quella di possedere l'integrazione e la manutenzione della soluzione front-to-end tecnico, garantendo connettività senza soluzione di continuità, elaborazione dei dati e sicurezza.

LA TUA SICUREZZA

• Atto come Responsabile applicazioni end-to-end e proprietario di servizi IT per la gestione strategica dei fondi e applicazioni di analisi degli investimenti, garantendo operazioni stabili, disponibilità, prestazioni e miglioramento continuo

• Possedere l'integrazione tecnica e funzionale delle applicazioni all'interno del più ampio panorama tecnologico, comprese le interfacce ai fornitori di dati di mercato, sistemi di gestione del portafoglio, piattaforme di reporting, data warehouse e consumatori a valle

• Servire come punto di contatto principale per le parti interessate interne attraverso la gestione dei fondi, il controllo degli investimenti, la gestione dei rischi, le operazioni e le squadre tecnologiche

• Gestisci i rapporti con fornitori esterni SaaS e fornitori di servizi, assicurando qualità dei servizi, aderenza SLA, risoluzione dei problemi e allineamento con le priorità aziendali

• Guidare e coordinare le attività di gestione del ciclo di vita e delle modifiche, release, aggiornamenti, assicurando al contempo un minimo disagi

• Analizzare i requisiti aziendali e tradurli in soluzioni tecniche sostenibili in collaborazione con utenti aziendali, architetti, sviluppatori e fornitori

• Mantenere la documentazione del sistema, gli inventari delle applicazioni, le specifiche dell'interfaccia, le procedure operative e i repository di architettura

• Monitorare la salute delle applicazioni, la qualità dei dati e i processi operativi, identificare proattivamente i rischi e le opportunità di miglioramento

• Assicurare l'integrazione dei dati senza soluzione di continuità, la riconciliazione e l'elaborazione di sistemi collegati, mantenendo al contempo l'accuratezza e la coerenza dei dati

• Controlli di supporto, requisiti normativi e processi di governance interna assicurando il rispetto di sicurezza, rischio e standard operativi

• Gestire l'accesso degli utenti, le recensioni dei diritti e i controlli di sicurezza delle applicazioni in linea con le politiche aziendali e i requisiti normativi

• Eseguire la configurazione hands-on, la risoluzione dei problemi, la scrittura e le attività di supporto dove richiesto

• Consulta periodicamente i servizi del fornitore, i modelli di licenze e le allocazioni dei costi interni per aumentare l'efficienza e ottimizzare i costi operativi.

• Partecipare a iniziative e progetti strategici volti a migliorare le capacità di gestione dei fondi, migliorare la qualità dei dati e ampliare l'ecosistema delle applicazioni

Il tuo progetto

• 5-10 anni di esperienza come proprietario dell'applicazione, proprietario del servizio IT, responsabile dell'applicazione, o in un ruolo simile all'interno dei servizi finanziari

• La comprensione della gestione delle risorse, dell'amministrazione dei fondi, degli investimenti alternativi, dei mercati privati, dei fondi di copertura o dei processi di investimento multi-Asset è un grande vantaggio

• Gestione delle soluzioni SaaS e relazioni con fornitori di terze parti

• Forte conoscenza dell'integrazione delle applicazioni, flussi di dati, API, interfacce basate su file e piattaforme basate su cloud

• Esperienza di lavoro con investimenti, portafoglio e dati di fondo

• Comprensione di IT Service Management, gestione degli incidenti, gestione dei cambiamenti e governance operativa

• Competenze tecniche pratiche in SQL, scripting, analisi dei dati e risoluzione dei problemi

• Esperienza di lavoro in ambienti finanziari regolamentati e gestione dei requisiti di sicurezza e conformità

• Forte capacità di comunicazione e gestione degli stakeholder con la capacità di colmare i domini aziendali e tecnologici

• Giocatore di squadra entusiasta con un atteggiamento pratico, can-do, in grado di lavorare efficacemente con le squadre interfunzionali

• Capacità di articolare con chiarezza concetti tecnici complessi sia per gli stakeholder tecnici che non tecnici

• Forti competenze di priorità, con la capacità di gestire più compiti e scadenze in un ambiente frenetico

• Forte capacità analitiche, con la capacità di analizzare problemi complessi, identificare soluzioni e orchestrare l'implementazione

• Inglese Business fluente, lingua madre (C1/2)

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

This is a challenging and interesting role as a legal counsel with a focus on legal and regulatory matters in relation to the provision of financial services (advisory and discretionary management) as well wealth planning solutions within the team Legal Investment Solutions & Distribution.

The team consists of highly qualified lawyers located at the Head Office in Zurich. The team is part of the General Counsel Wealth Management sub-division and provides legal advice to our stakeholders, including senior management from the Division Global Products & Solutions (GPS) of Bank Julius Baer & Co. Ltd. Our work is truly international as we closely collaborate with other teams around the globe with the aim to provide tailor-made solutions with a hands-on approach. We are a dynamic, highly motivated team and pride ourselves in our excellent team spirit and supportive atmosphere.

This global role has a multijurisdictional scope, allows you to work on a wide variety of contractual and regulatory topics in relation to onshore and cross-border financial and wealth planning services. From the very beginning, you will handle your own portfolio of tasks. You therefore have a direct impact on Julius Baer’s legal affairs and business. You will also have a close working relationship with compliance, front office and front risk management.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Act as legal expert for financial and wealth planning services (including advisory and discretionary mandate services, as well as trust, pension and life insurance solutions)

• Assess and review B2B documentation and agreements, particularly with external partners and providers, in relation to wealth planning services

• Provide guidance to senior management and internal stakeholders on projects and initiatives

• Monitor legal and regulatory developments in Switzerland and assess potential risks related to cross-border service provision (incl. civil liability and regulatory risks)

• Support legal colleagues participating in internal committees by providing wealth planning expertise

• Contribute to strategic projects and deliver ad-hoc legal support, offering efficient, client-oriented solutions related to FinSA and MiFID

YOUR PROFILE

• Master’s degree in law (preferably from a Swiss University) and admission to the bar; additional qualifications such as an LL.M. are an asset

• 1-3 years of professional experience, preferably in a law firm, financial institution of consulting firm

• Profound understanding of Swiss banking and contract law as well as the Swiss regulatory landscape

• Analytical, structured and solution orientated with a proactive approach and capable of translating legal requirements into business-oriented solutions

• A proactive and solution-oriented mindset with the ability to work independently and as a team-player in groups

• Ability to perform under pressure and efficiently handle different competing tasks and priorities

• Good communication skills and a natural capacity to convincingly share ideas

• Excellent proficiency in English and German, knowledge of additional languages is considered an advantage

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Julius Baer, celebriamo e valorizziamo le qualità individuali che portate, permettendovi di essere impeccabili, di essere imprenditoriali, di essere potenziati e di creare valore al di là della ricchezza. Formiamo insieme il futuro della gestione della ricchezza.

Si tratta di un ruolo impegnativo e interessante come consulente legale con un focus su questioni legali e regolamentari in relazione alla fornitura di servizi finanziari (gestione di consulenza e discrezione) e soluzioni di pianificazione patrimoniale all'interno del team Legal Investment Solutions & Distribution.

Il team è composto da avvocati altamente qualificati situati presso la sede centrale di Zurigo. Il team fa parte della divisione General Counsel Wealth Management e fornisce consulenza legale ai nostri stakeholder, tra cui la gestione senior della Division Global Products & Solutions (GPS) di Bank Julius Baer & Co. Ltd. Il nostro lavoro è veramente internazionale mentre collaboriamo a stretto contatto con altre squadre in tutto il mondo con l'obiettivo di fornire soluzioni su misura con un approccio pratico. Siamo un team dinamico e altamente motivato e siamo orgogliosi del nostro eccellente spirito di squadra e dell'atmosfera di supporto.

Questo ruolo globale ha una portata multigiurisdizionale, consente di lavorare su una vasta gamma di argomenti contrattuali e regolamentari in relazione ai servizi di pianificazione finanziaria e patrimoniale onshore e transfrontaliera. Fin dall'inizio, gestirai il tuo portafoglio di compiti. Avete quindi un impatto diretto sugli affari legali e gli affari di Julius Baer. Avrete anche una stretta relazione di lavoro con la conformità, l'ufficio frontale e la gestione del rischio anteriore.

LA TUA SICUREZZA

• Atto come esperto legale per i servizi di pianificazione finanziaria e patrimoniale (inclusi servizi di consulenza e mandato discrezionale, così come soluzioni di fiducia, pensione e assicurazione sulla vita)

• Valutare e rivedere la documentazione e gli accordi B2B, in particolare con partner esterni e fornitori, in relazione ai servizi di pianificazione patrimoniale

• Fornire una guida alla gestione senior e agli stakeholder interni su progetti e iniziative

• Monitorare gli sviluppi legali e normativi in Svizzera e valutare i potenziali rischi legati alla fornitura di servizi transfrontalieri (incl. responsabilità civile e rischi normativi)

• Sostenere i colleghi legali che partecipano ai comitati interni fornendo competenze di pianificazione della ricchezza

• Contribuire a progetti strategici e fornire supporto giuridico ad-hoc, offrendo soluzioni efficienti e orientate al cliente relative a FinSA e MiFID

Il tuo progetto

• Laurea magistrale in diritto (preferibilmente presso un'Università Svizzera) e ammissione al bar; qualifiche aggiuntive come un LL.M. sono un bene

• 1-3 anni di esperienza professionale, preferibilmente in uno studio legale, istituzione finanziaria di società di consulenza

• Una profonda comprensione del diritto bancario e contrattuale svizzero e del paesaggio normativo svizzero

• Analitico, strutturato e soluzione orientato con un approccio proattivo e capace di tradurre i requisiti legali in soluzioni orientate al business

• Una mentalità proattiva e orientata alla soluzione con la capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e come giocatore di squadra in gruppi

• Capacità di eseguire sotto pressione e gestire in modo efficiente diversi compiti e priorità concorrenti

• Buone capacità di comunicazione e una capacità naturale di condividere con convinzione idee

• Ottima competenza in inglese e tedesco, la conoscenza delle lingue aggiuntive è considerata un vantaggio

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Julius Bär feiern und schätzen wir die individuellen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen, damit Sie wirkungsvoll sein, unternehmerisch handeln, gestärkt werden und Werte jenseits von Wohlstand schaffen können. Gestalten wir gemeinsam die Zukunft des Wealth Managements.

Dies ist eine herausfordernde und interessante Rolle als Rechtsberater mit Schwerpunkt auf rechtlichen und regulatorischen Fragen in Bezug auf die Bereitstellung von Finanzdienstleistungen (Beratungs- und Ermessensmanagement) sowie Vermögensplanungslösungen im Team Legal Investment Solutions & Distribution.

Das Team besteht aus hochqualifizierten Juristen am Hauptsitz in Zürich. Das Team ist Teil des Unterbereichs General Counsel Wealth Management und bietet Rechtsberatung für unsere Stakeholder, einschließlich der Geschäftsleitung der Division Global Products & Solutions (GPS) der Bank Julius Bär & Co. Ltd. Unsere Arbeit ist wirklich international, da wir eng mit anderen Teams auf der ganzen Welt zusammenarbeiten, um maßgeschneiderte Lösungen mit einem praktischen Ansatz anzubieten. Wir sind ein dynamisches, hochmotiviertes Team und stolz auf unseren exzellenten Teamgeist und unsere unterstützende Atmosphäre.

Diese globale Rolle hat einen multijurisdiktionalen Umfang und ermöglicht es Ihnen, an einer Vielzahl von vertraglichen und regulatorischen Themen in Bezug auf Onshore- und grenzüberschreitende Finanz- und Vermögensplanungsdienste zu arbeiten. Von Anfang an übernehmen Sie Ihr eigenes Aufgabenportfolio. Sie haben somit direkten Einfluss auf die rechtlichen Angelegenheiten und Geschäfte von Julius Bär. Sie haben auch eine enge Zusammenarbeit mit Compliance, Front Office und Front-Risikomanagement.

IHRE HERAUSFORDERUNG

• Tätigkeit als Rechtsexperte für Finanz- und Vermögensplanungsdienstleistungen (einschließlich beratender und diskretionärer Mandatsdienstleistungen sowie Treuhand-, Renten- und Lebensversicherungslösungen)

• Bewertung und Überprüfung der B2B-Dokumentation und -Vereinbarungen, insbesondere mit externen Partnern und Anbietern, in Bezug auf Vermögensplanungsleistungen

• Beratung der Geschäftsleitung und internen Stakeholder bei Projekten und Initiativen

• Überwachung der rechtlichen und regulatorischen Entwicklungen in der Schweiz und Bewertung potenzieller Risiken im Zusammenhang mit der grenzüberschreitenden Erbringung von Dienstleistungen (einschließlich zivilrechtlicher und regulatorischer Risiken)

• Unterstützung von Rechtskollegen, die an internen Ausschüssen teilnehmen, durch die Bereitstellung von Vermögensplanungsexpertise

• Tragen Sie zu strategischen Projekten bei und bieten Sie Ad-hoc-rechtliche Unterstützung, indem Sie effiziente, kundenorientierte Lösungen im Zusammenhang mit FinSA und MiFID anbieten

IHR PROFIL

• Master-Abschluss in Rechtswissenschaften (vorzugsweise von einer Schweizer Universität) und Zulassung zur Bar; Zusatzqualifikationen wie ein LL.M. sind ein Asset

• 1-3 Jahre Berufserfahrung, vorzugsweise in einer Anwaltskanzlei, Finanzinstitution einer Beratungsfirma

• Tiefes Verständnis des Schweizer Bank- und Vertragsrechts sowie der Schweizer Regulierungslandschaft

• Analytisch, strukturiert und lösungsorientiert mit proaktivem Ansatz und in der Lage, gesetzliche Anforderungen in unternehmensorientierte Lösungen zu übersetzen

• Eine proaktive und lösungsorientierte Denkweise mit der Fähigkeit, selbstständig und als Teamplayer in Gruppen zu arbeiten

• Fähigkeit, unter Druck zu arbeiten und verschiedene konkurrierende Aufgaben und Prioritäten effizient zu bewältigen

• Gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und eine natürliche Fähigkeit, Ideen überzeugend zu teilen

• Ausgezeichnete Englisch- und Deutschkenntnisse, Kenntnisse zusätzlicher Sprachen gelten als Vorteil

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Julius Baer, nous célébrons et valorisons les qualités individuelles que vous apportez, vous permettant d'avoir un impact, d'être entrepreneur, d'être autonomisé et de créer une valeur au-delà de la richesse. C'est l'avenir de la gestion des richesses.

Il s'agit d'un rôle stimulant et intéressant en tant que conseiller juridique qui met l'accent sur les questions juridiques et réglementaires liées à la prestation de services financiers (gestion consultative et discrétionnaire) ainsi que sur les solutions de planification de patrimoine au sein de l'équipe Solutions d'investissement et distribution juridiques.

L'équipe est composée d'avocats hautement qualifiés situés au siège social de Zurich. L'équipe fait partie de la division General Counsel Wealth Management et fournit des conseils juridiques à nos intervenants, y compris à la haute direction de la Division Global Products & Solutions (GPS) de Bank Julius Baer & Co. Ltd. Notre travail est vraiment international car nous collaborons étroitement avec d'autres équipes du monde entier dans le but de fournir des solutions sur mesure avec une approche pratique. Nous sommes une équipe dynamique et très motivée et nous sommes fiers de notre excellent esprit d'équipe et de notre atmosphère de soutien.

Ce rôle mondial a une portée multigouvernementale, vous permet de travailler sur une grande variété de sujets contractuels et réglementaires en relation avec les services financiers et de planification de patrimoine à terre et transfrontaliers. Dès le début, vous gérerez votre propre portefeuille de tâches. Vous avez donc un impact direct sur les affaires juridiques et les affaires de Julius Baer. Vous aurez également une relation de travail étroite avec la conformité, le front office et la gestion des risques frontaux.

Votre défi

• Agir en tant qu'expert juridique en matière de services financiers et de planification du patrimoine (y compris les services de conseil et de mandat discrétionnaire, ainsi que les solutions en matière de fiducie, de pension et d'assurance-vie)

• Évaluer et examiner la documentation et les ententes B2B, en particulier avec des partenaires et des fournisseurs externes, en ce qui concerne les services de planification du patrimoine

• Fournir des conseils à la haute direction et aux intervenants internes sur les projets et les initiatives

• Surveiller les évolutions juridiques et réglementaires en Suisse et évaluer les risques potentiels liés à la prestation de services transfrontaliers (y compris la responsabilité civile et les risques réglementaires)

• Appuyer les collègues juridiques qui participent aux comités internes en fournissant une expertise en planification de patrimoine

• Contribuer aux projets stratégiques et fournir un soutien juridique ad hoc, offrant des solutions efficaces et orientées client liées à FinSA et MiFID

VOTRE PROFIL

• Maîtrise en droit (de préférence d'une université suisse) et admission au barreau; des diplômes supplémentaires comme un LL.M. sont un atout

• 1-3 ans d'expérience professionnelle, de préférence dans un cabinet d'avocats, institution financière du cabinet de conseil

• Connaissance approfondie du droit bancaire et du droit des contrats suisses ainsi que du paysage réglementaire suisse

• Analyse, structure et solution orientée vers une approche proactive et capable de traduire les exigences juridiques en solutions orientées vers l'entreprise

• Un état d'esprit proactif et orienté vers la solution avec la capacité de travailler de manière indépendante et en tant que joueur d'équipe en groupe

• Aptitude à effectuer sous pression et à gérer efficacement différentes tâches et priorités concurrentes

• Bonnes compétences en communication et capacité naturelle de partager des idées de manière convaincante

• Excellente maîtrise de l'anglais et de l'allemand, connaissance de langues supplémentaires est considéré comme un avantage

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

Julius Baer is the leading Swiss private banking group with a focus on servicing and advising sophisticated private clients and is a premium brand in global wealth management.
We are searching for an experienced, reliable and organized personality to support the leadership team of the Group CFO. Starting date is as soon as possible.

YOUR CHALLENGE
• Provide administrative support to direct reports of the Group CFO, acting as the primary point of contact for internal stakeholders at all levels and external counterparts, demonstrating discretion, professionalism, and strong communication skills
• Manage complex calendars, coordinate meetings, global travel arrangements, and prepare expense reports with precision
• Plan and manage business trips including travel planning such as flights, hotels, and transfers
• Prepare and process detailed expense reports accurately and in a timely manner, maintaining audit readiness
• Organize internal and external meetings and events, conferences, and team workshops, covering all logistical aspects
• Proactively support preparation for meetings, anticipating needs in advance with appropriate research
• Independently handle ad-hoc tasks, including small project coordination and HR-related administrative support
• Ensure smooth day-to-day office operations, managing correspondence, calls, and requests with tact and diplomacy
• Opportunity to gain broader insights across the Finance unit by providing coordinated administrative support to direct reports of the Group CFO, ensuring efficiency

YOUR PROFILE
• Discreet and trustworthy individual with absolute dedication to confidentiality
• Minimum 3-4 years’ experience as EA/PA, ideally in finance or corporate environment
• Team-oriented and solution-focused with excellent problem-solving abilities
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and German
• Strong time management skills and ability to multi-task and prioritize work
• Highly organised, proactive, and able to operate reliably under pressure with minimal supervision, with strong attention to detail
• Proficient user in MS Office applications, including Excel and PowerPoint

jobs.title: Data Platform Responsible 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

As a Data Platform Responsible (PR) you are responsible for the end-to-end technical leadership and lifecycle management of a global data platform (datalake house) ensuring alignment with business needs, architecture standards, and operational resilience. Working closely with Product Owners, Platform Owner, System Architects, and IT Service Owners, the Platform Responsible supports technical decision-making, oversees solution design and drives technical decision-making, responsible for successful development execution, and ensures production readiness and release planning within defined frameworks. The role combines hands-on technical oversight with supplier management, risk assessment, quality assurance, and deep involvement in agile delivery and incident support.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• You are key technical stakeholder in the technical design of a Global Platform based on a modern infrastructure

• You are part of the agile setup and support development team

• Lead the technical design, development, and operational performance of the platform, ensuring full lifecycle management and compliance with corporate standards

• Contribute to platforms technical roadmap, including technology changes, modernisation, and decommissioning, in alignment with business and architectural strategies

• Own and contribute to key deliverables including Solution Design, Security Concept, and Interface Agreements; ensure adherence to architecture standards in collaboration with the System Architect

• Plan and coordinate application releases in line with Change- and Release Management processes, jointly deciding on production go-live with the Product Owner, Platform Owner and ITSO

• Supervise platform infrastructure and data development activities, promote “shift-left” practices (automation, unit testing, CI/CD), and ensure robust implementation of functional and non-functional requirements

• Provide 3rd level support, serve as master data custodian in JBAR, and lead supplier management for third-party applications, including performance and delivery oversight

• Estimate effort for changes, advise on technical risks and mitigation, support budgeting, and ensure technical requirements are properly validated and tested prior to release

• You feel responsible for the global data platform which serves global data for different analytics use cases and ensure a running and stable environment

• Support the System Architect in the raising and maintenance of technical debts

• Support Business Responsible and IT Product Owner in shaping platform service and its execution

• Collaboration with support teams in Asia to ensure enhanced support hours

YOUR PROFILE

• At least 8 years of experience in Data Platforms / Data Lakes / Data Lake houses (Kubernetes, Kafka, Distributed Storage like S3/HDFS) – preferably On prem.

• Several years of work experience in a similar capacity in the financial industry

• Experience in leading technical direction of data platforms, keeping up to date with the modern possibilities of tooling, formats, concepts.

• Experience in managing the full platform lifecycle, from concept and design through development, testing, deployment, operation, and eventual retirement, including responsibility for master data, incident support, and release coordination

• VM setup and scaling (pods), K8S scaling, managing Docker with Harbor, pushing Images through CI/CD together with development team

• Higher Education in Computer Science (University, University of Applied Sciences or equivalent diploma)

• Very strong communication and planning / coordination skills

• Willingness to bring in new ideas and initiate changes and sees themselves as proactive, reliable and solution driven

• Good English language skills (written and verbal), German a plus

• Strong team player

• Customer oriented with focus to support an organisation in providing solutions

• Very good understanding of data technology and its operational management

• Very high level on self-motivation to drive initiatives and initiating changes

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.
Is this not quite what you are looking for? Set up a job alert by creating a candidate account here.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Julius Bär feiern und schätzen wir die individuellen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen, damit Sie wirkungsvoll sein, unternehmerisch handeln, gestärkt werden und Werte jenseits von Wohlstand schaffen können. Gestalten wir gemeinsam die Zukunft des Wealth Managements. Als Data Platform Responsible (PR) sind Sie für die durchgängige technische Führung und das Lifecycle-Management einer globalen Datenplattform (Datalake House) verantwortlich, die die Ausrichtung auf Geschäftsanforderungen, Architekturstandards und operative Belastbarkeit gewährleistet. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Product Ownern, Platform Owner, Systemarchitekten und IT-Service-Eigentümern unterstützt der Platform Responsible die technische Entscheidungsfindung, überwacht das Lösungsdesign und treibt die technische Entscheidungsfindung voran, ist für die erfolgreiche Ausführung der Entwicklung verantwortlich und stellt die Produktionsbereitschaft und Release-Planung innerhalb definierter Frameworks sicher. Die Rolle kombiniert praktische technische Aufsicht mit Lieferantenmanagement, Risikobeurteilung, Qualitätssicherung und einer umfassenden Beteiligung an agiler Liefer- und Incident-Unterstützung. IHRE HINWEISE
• Sie sind wichtiger technischer Stakeholder beim technischen Design einer globalen Plattform auf Basis einer modernen Infrastruktur
• Sie sind Teil des agilen Setup- und Support-Entwicklungsteams
• Führen Sie das technische Design, die Entwicklung und die operative Leistung der Plattform, um ein vollständiges Lebenszyklusmanagement und die Einhaltung der Unternehmensstandards zu gewährleisten
• Beitrag zur technischen Roadmap der Plattformen, einschließlich Technologieänderungen, Modernisierung und Stilllegung in Übereinstimmung mit Geschäfts- und Architekturstrategien
• Eigenverantwortung und Beitrag zu wichtigen Leistungen, einschließlich Solution Design, Security Concept und Interface Agreements; Gewährleistung der Einhaltung von Architekturstandards in Zusammenarbeit mit dem System Architect
• Planen und koordinieren Sie Anwendungs-Releases im Einklang mit Change- und Release-Management-Prozessen und entscheiden gemeinsam mit Product Owner, Platform Owner und ITSO über den Produktions-Go-Live
• Beaufsichtigen Sie die Plattforminfrastruktur und Datenentwicklungsaktivitäten, fördern Sie "Shift-left" -Praktiken (Automatisierung, Unit Testing, CI / CD) und gewährleisten Sie eine robuste Implementierung funktionaler und nicht funktionaler Anforderungen
• Bereitstellung von 3rd-Level-Support, als Master Data Custodian in JBAR und Leitung des Lieferantenmanagements für Anwendungen von Drittanbietern, einschließlich Leistungs- und Lieferaufsicht
• Schätzen Sie den Aufwand für Änderungen, beraten Sie zu technischen Risiken und Minderung, unterstützen Sie die Budgetierung und stellen Sie sicher, dass die technischen Anforderungen vor der Veröffentlichung ordnungsgemäß validiert und getestet werden
• Sie fühlen sich verantwortlich für die globale Datenplattform, die globale Daten für verschiedene Analyse-Anwendungsfälle bereitstellt und eine laufende und stabile Umgebung gewährleistet.
• Unterstützen Sie den Systemarchitekten bei der Erhebung und Aufrechterhaltung technischer Schulden
• Unterstützen Sie Business Responsible und IT Product Owner bei der Gestaltung des Plattformdienstes und seiner Ausführung
• Zusammenarbeit mit Supportteams in Asien, um verbesserte Supportzeiten zu gewährleisten IHR PROFIL
• Mindestens 8 Jahre Erfahrung in Data Platforms / Data Lakes / Data Lake Häusern (Kubernetes, Kafka, Distributed Storage wie S3/HDFS) – vorzugsweise On prem.
• Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in ähnlicher Funktion in der Finanzbranche
• Erfahrung in der führenden technischen Leitung von Datenplattformen, auf dem neuesten Stand der modernen Möglichkeiten der Werkzeuge, Formate, Konzepte.
• Erfahrung in der Verwaltung des gesamten Plattformlebenszyklus, von Konzept und Design über Entwicklung, Test, Bereitstellung, Betrieb und eventuellen Ruhestand, einschließlich der Verantwortung für Stammdaten, Incident-Support und Release-Koordination
• VM-Einrichtung und -Skalierung (Pods), K8S-Skalierung, Verwaltung von Docker mit Harbor, Pushing von Images durch CI/CD zusammen mit dem Entwicklungsteam
• Hochschulbildung in Informatik (Universität, Fachhochschule oder gleichwertiges Diplom)
• Sehr starke Kommunikations- und Planungs-/Koordinationsfähigkeiten
• Bereitschaft, neue Ideen einzubringen und Veränderungen anzustoßen und versteht sich als proaktiv, zuverlässig und lösungsorientiert
• Gute Englischkenntnisse (schriftlich und mündlich), Deutsch ein Plus
• Starker Teamplayer
• Kundenorientiert mit Fokus auf Unterstützung einer Organisation bei der Bereitstellung von Lösungen
• Sehr gutes Verständnis der Datentechnologie und ihrer Betriebsführung

jobs.title: GPS Strategy & Business Development Project Leader – Zurich 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

Global Products & Solutions plays a central role in shaping client-focused investment strategies, developing innovative financial products, and providing expert advisory across all major asset classes. By aligning global insights with local needs, we empower relationship managers with tailored solutions that meet evolving client needs.
In this role, the primary responsibilities include shaping and driving the global strategic agenda for GPS. This entails spearheading strategic growth initiatives that align with the Bank’s overarching strategy, ensuring strong alignment across regions, and ensure they are based on client demand. The individual shall partner closely with business owners/stewards to identify, assess and drive new business opportunities.

The role also requires assessing strategic partnerships as well as inorganic business opportunities (e.g. M&As, establishment of joint ventures) from a GPS perspective. Further, the individual shall coordinate cross-unit collaboration, drive insight generation through robust market and competitor analysis, and support senior management with recommendations and decision-making.

The role will report to the Head of GPS Strategy & Business Development (Switzerland & Europe).

YOUR CHALLENGE
Stakeholder management (internal & external)

• Drive global strategic growth initiatives that align with the Group’s overall strategic priorities

• Partner with GPS business owners/stewards to identify, evaluate, and drive new business opportunities and partnerships and outline growth plans

• Support all GPS teams in project and change management activities

• Work in close collaboration with Group Strategy and Group Finance to support the end-to-end execution of strategic initiatives

Business management

• Define and drive the ambitions/objectives of the team in consultation with Head of GPS Strategy & Business Development (Switzerland & Europe)

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

We seek a highly skilled Wealth Planner to join Julius Baer (JB) Wealth Planning based in Zurich, Switzerland. Wealth Planning, a unit of Global Products & Solutions (GPS), is a core offering of the JB Group and provides specialist wealth planning to support Relationship Managers (RMs) in acquiring, maintaining, and retaining private client relationships. Your main responsibility will be to provide wealth planning guidance and introduce wealth planning products and solutions to meet the needs of our private clients.

The successful candidate will stand out for their ability to deliver excellence in two key areas. The first is as subject matter expert in Latin American markets where agility in wealth planning topics including philanthropy, relocation, succession planning, taxation and wealth structuring will be needed. (Proven experience in Mexico, but not only, will be a distinct advantage.) The second is in relation to our key client and ultra-high net worth segment, which is more universal and less country-specific in nature. Here, experience in family governance topics and harmonizing these with the wealth structures needed will distinguish the ideal profile.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Provide strategic wealth planning guidance to RMs and their clients, actively coordinating the wealth planning process by leveraging internal and external experts as needed

• Implement suitable solutions, such as private insurance, private trusts, private foundations or private companies in collaboration with internal and external providers

• Serve as a subject matter specialist in client-facing interactions, following the JB Advisory Process which includes fact-finding, analysis, discussion of principles, evaluation of concepts, proposal of solutions/services, implementation and follow-up

• Support the Wealth Planning Key Clients & Family Office Services (FOS) Team in delivering services to UHNW prospects and clients, by applying WP’s offering, with focus on Family Roadmap, Family Purpose (including Philanthropy Advisory) and Family Governance, amongst others

• Stay up to date with industry, legal, regulatory and taxation changes, and inform clients and internal stakeholders accordingly

• Support RMs and other stakeholders by providing training, knowledge transfer and assistance on wealth planning topics and services/products

YOUR PROFILE
Professional Qualifications & Education

• Minimum of 10 years of professional experience in relevant financial services sectors or comparable private client practices (e.g. private bank, legal practice, tax advisor, fiduciary company)

• University degree in Law (a Latin American country qualification), master in tax or a related field is a must. Additional qualifications on family governance and experience in servicing private clients would be of advantage. Additional courses linked to the area of expertise, such as STEP accreditation, are preferred

Experience & Competencies

• Client-centric approach. Passion for wealth planning advice for private HNW and UHNW individuals

• Engaging personality with the ability to work effectively with high-net-worth clients, ensuring their needs and objectives are met

• Travel to win, maintain and retain Clients will be required on an ad hoc basis, including to Latin America

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. Strong work ethic, being a team player and collaborating with different stakeholders as part of an international team of wealth planning professionals

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

• Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively within a domestic and global team, both in person and in virtual formats

• Self-starter with a solution-oriented mindset

• Spanish native speaker. Fluent in English. Additional European language skills, including German are a distinct advantage

Il primo è come esperto di materia tematica nei mercati latinoamericani dove sarà necessaria l'agilità nei temi della pianificazione della ricchezza, tra cui filantropia, trasferimento, pianificazione della successione, tassazione e strutturazione della ricchezza. (Prova esperienza in Messico, ma non solo, sarà un vantaggio distinto.) Il secondo è in relazione al nostro cliente chiave e ultra-alto segmento di valore netto, che è più universale e meno specifico paese in natura. Qui, l'esperienza nei temi della governance familiare e l'armonizzazione di questi con le strutture di ricchezza necessarie distinguono il profilo ideale.

LA TUA SICUREZZA

• Implementare soluzioni adatte, come assicurazioni private, trust privati, fondazioni private o aziende private in collaborazione con fornitori interni ed esterni

We seek a highly skilled Wealth Planner to join Julius Baer (JB) Wealth Planning based in Zurich, Switzerland. Wealth Planning, a unit of Global Products & Solutions (GPS), is a core offering of the JB Group and provides specialist wealth planning to support Relationship Managers (RMs) in acquiring, maintaining, and retaining private client relationships. Your main responsibility will be to provide wealth planning guidance and introduce wealth planning products and solutions to meet the needs of our private clients.

The successful candidate will stand out for their ability to deliver excellence in two key areas. The first is as subject matter expert in Latin American markets where agility in wealth planning topics including philanthropy, relocation, succession planning, taxation and wealth structuring will be needed. (Proven experience in Mexico, but not only, will be a distinct advantage.) The second is in relation to our key client and ultra-high net worth segment, which is more universal and less country-specific in nature. Here, experience in family governance topics and harmonizing these with the wealth structures needed will distinguish the ideal profile.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Provide strategic wealth planning guidance to RMs and their clients, actively coordinating the wealth planning process by leveraging internal and external experts as needed

• Implement suitable solutions, such as private insurance, private trusts, private foundations or private companies in collaboration with internal and external providers

• Serve as a subject matter specialist in client-facing interactions, following the JB Advisory Process which includes fact-finding, analysis, discussion of principles, evaluation of concepts, proposal of solutions/services, implementation and follow-up

• Support the Wealth Planning Key Clients & Family Office Services (FOS) Team in delivering services to UHNW prospects and clients, by applying WP’s offering, with focus on Family Roadmap, Family Purpose (including Philanthropy Advisory) and Family Governance, amongst others

• Stay up to date with industry, legal, regulatory and taxation changes, and inform clients and internal stakeholders accordingly

• Support RMs and other stakeholders by providing training, knowledge transfer and assistance on wealth planning topics and services/products

YOUR PROFILE
Professional Qualifications & Education

• Minimum of 10 years of professional experience in relevant financial services sectors or comparable private client practices (e.g. private bank, legal practice, tax advisor, fiduciary company)

• University degree in Law (a Latin American country qualification), master in tax or a related field is a must. Additional qualifications on family governance and experience in servicing private clients would be of advantage. Additional courses linked to the area of expertise, such as STEP accreditation, are preferred

Experience & Competencies

• Client-centric approach. Passion for wealth planning advice for private HNW and UHNW individuals

• Engaging personality with the ability to work effectively with high-net-worth clients, ensuring their needs and objectives are met

• Travel to win, maintain and retain Clients will be required on an ad hoc basis, including to Latin America

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. Strong work ethic, being a team player and collaborating with different stakeholders as part of an international team of wealth planning professionals

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

• Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively within a domestic and global team, both in person and in virtual formats

• Self-starter with a solution-oriented mindset

• Spanish native speaker. Fluent in English. Additional European language skills, including German are a distinct advantage
