jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

The Investment Risk & Portfolio Engineering team is part of the CIO Office which is responsible for managing all discretionary mandates and funds of Julius Baer.

We are responsible for maintaining the asset allocations for all multi asset class mandates. We design and update the strategic and tactical asset allocations for these mandates, provide quantitative analysis to the Investment Committee and run ex-ante risk and liquidity reports.

We also manage the market and liquidity risk of our discretionary mandates and all our funds: equity, fixed income and multi-asset. Support of portfolio managers for portfolio construction and relationship managers with optimizations and analysis for bespoke mandates for ultra-high-net-worth (UHNW) clients is also part of our role. We build, maintain and improve our proprietary tools deployed for our daily job.
We are looking for a motivated senior new colleague to expand our team and help us with our growing responsibilities.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Take ownership of our financial time series database and data feed processes: maintain, further automate and constantly improve the tools

• Act as subject matter expert in the area of financial data and indices in particular

• Provide high-quality and timely quantitative support for our Investment Committee upon request for specific simulations or analyses

• Deliver optimized strategic asset allocation and quantitative analyses for large bespoke mandates to relationship managers for UHNW portfolios and participate in client meetings, upon request

YOUR PROFILE

• A Master’s degree in a quantitative subject (e.g. math, engineering, finance)

• At least 5 years of relevant work experience in financial market data and databases

• Solid and proven hands-on experience downloading, cleaning, maintaining, storing and distributing financial data time series and benchmark indices

• Knowledge and experience in portfolio optimization is a plus

• Strong IT skills, including programming and data analysis experience. Working knowledge of MATLAB (or similar programming language) and maintaining & developing databases is required

• Proficiency in English, as well as German or French (both spoken and written)

• Able to confidently present results to groups of portfolio managers and senior management

• Solid communication and stakeholder management skills

• Highly motivated, reliable and well-organized team player

• Forte competenze IT, compresa la programmazione e l'esperienza di analisi dei dati. La conoscenza di lavoro di MATLAB (o linguaggio di programmazione simile) e il mantenimento e lo sviluppo di database è richiesto

• Competenza in inglese, tedesco o francese (sia parlato che scritto)

jobs.title: Deferred Compensation Specialist (f,m,d) - 100%
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

Shape the Future of Executive Compensation at Julius Baer

We are looking for a proactive and experienced Deferred Compensation Specialist to take ownership of the end-to-end administration of Julius Baer’s global deferred compensation programmes. This is a key specialist position within our dynamic Rewards & Performance Management function, offering strategic exposure across compensation, compliance, tax, and governance topics.

As a trusted advisor in one of the most complex areas of total rewards, you will play a central role in managing, maintaining, and evolving our deferred compensation framework across multiple jurisdictions. With increasing scrutiny on remuneration practices in financial services, this role sits at the intersection of risk, regulation, and talent strategy.

The ideal candidate is both a structured thinker and a hands-on executor – equally comfortable analysing regulatory trends, drafting board submissions, and performing detailed operational tasks. You thrive in complex, fast-moving environments and demonstrate strong adaptability and flexibility as priorities shift across regions, business lines, or regulatory regimes.

Join a compact, high-performing team that oversees Deferred Compensation, Global Mobility, and Business Travel Compliance, giving you broad exposure across reward, tax, compliance, and finance – all within a respected global private banking leader.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Strategic Plan Design & Governance Support: Play a key role in reviewing and enhancing existing deferred compensation frameworks – proposing improvements based on regulatory developments, market practice, or internal feedback. Prepare clear, accurate, and well-structured submissions and governance documentation for presentation to the Executive Board and the Board of Directors.

• End-to-End Programme Leadership: Own the full lifecycle of deferred compensation plans – from design to delivery – ensuring precision, consistency, and adherence to internal policies and strategic objectives.

• Stakeholder Engagement & Advisory: Act as the primary point of contact for employees, executives, and cross-functional partners (HR, Finance, Legal, Compliance, Internal Audit, and external vendors), providing clear guidance on award mechanics, tax implications, and policy interpretation.

• Operational Rigor with Control Mindset: Balance strategic responsibilities with operational efficiency in execution: including transactions processing, data validation, and troubleshooting to ensure daily operations run smoothly – without losing sight of longer-term improvements.

• Global Compliance & Risk Oversight: Ensure strict compliance with international tax regulations (including local reporting obligations), coordinate annual remuneration disclosures, and support audit readiness across all operating entities.

• Process Innovation & Digitalisation: Drive continuous improvement through technology enablement – evaluating, implementing, and optimising external platforms like Workday and Equatex/EquatePlus to streamline processes, reduce manual effort, and improve user experience.

• Governance & Control Excellence: Support global oversight by preparing and/or reviewing plan and contract documentation, regulatory submissions, and reports. Maintain comprehensive records and controls to meet internal and external audit requirements.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate closely with Global Mobility, Payroll, Legal, and Reward colleagues to ensure integrated delivery across related domains, particularly in areas touching expatriation, incentives, and regulatory reporting.

YOUR PROFILE

• Experience: Higher education qualification in business, finance, or law with a minimum of 4 years’ experience in equity or deferred compensation design and administration, preferably within financial services or a multinational corporation.

• Deferred Compensation expertise: Demonstrated knowledge of cash- and equity-based deferral mechanisms, including performance conditions, vesting rules, post-termination delivery scenarios, and market practices. Solid grasp of tax and legal considerations (Swiss and international), as well as, employment and regulatory issues related to deferral programmes, and financial reporting impacts (e.g. IFRS2).

• Technical Proficiency: High familiarity with HR Information Systems (esp. Workday), equity tracking software (esp. EquatePlus), and related reporting tools. Advanced MS Office skills especially Excel modelling.

​Personal attributes:

• Demonstrate strong organisational skills, agility, and resilience, adapting quickly while maintaining accuracy and service levels.

• Function effectively amidst change – whether triggered by regulation, reorganisation, or evolving business priorities.

• Meticulous attention to detail, with uncompromising standards for accuracy

• Structured thinker with strong organisational skills who thrives in complex, regulated environments

• Results-oriented self-starter capable of working autonomously yet collaboratively

• Exceptional communicator – able to explain technical concepts simply and confidently, even under pressure

• High degree of discretion and integrity when handling sensitive, executive-level data

• A team player with a desire to continue learning, growing and developing in the role and within the area of reward/compensation.

• Language: Fluency in German and English is required.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Designazione delle merci

In Julius Baer, celebriamo e valorizziamo le singole qualità che porti, consentendoti di essere influente, imprenditoriale, di essere capace, e di creare valore oltre la ricchezza. Lasciati plasmare il futuro della gestione della ricchezza insieme.

Formare il futuro della compensazione esecutiva a Julius Baer

Stiamo cercando uno specialista in compensi differiti proattivo ed esperto per prendere la proprietà dell'amministrazione end-to-end dei programmi di compensazione differiti globali di Julius Baer. Questa è una posizione specializzata chiave all'interno della nostra funzione dinamica di Rewards & Performance Management, che offre un'esposizione strategica su argomenti di compensazione, conformità, tassazione e governance.

Come consulente di fiducia in uno dei settori più complessi di ricompense totali, svolgerai un ruolo centrale nella gestione, nel mantenimento e nell'evoluzione del nostro quadro di compensazione differita in molteplici giurisdizioni. Con un crescente controllo sulle pratiche retributive nei servizi finanziari, questo ruolo si pone all'intersezione tra rischio, regolamentazione e strategia di talento.

Il candidato ideale è sia un pensatore strutturato che un esecutore pratico. Altrettanto comodo analizzare le tendenze normative, presentare la redazione del consiglio di amministrazione e svolgere compiti operativi dettagliati. Si prospera in ambienti complessi e in rapida evoluzione e dimostrare una forte adattabilità e flessibilità, come priorità si spostano tra regioni, linee di business, o regimi normativi.

Unisciti a un team compatto e performante che supervisiona la compensazione differita, la mobilità globale e la conformità ai viaggi aziendali, offrendoti un'ampia esposizione attraverso premi, imposte, compliance e finanza. tutto all'interno di un rispettato leader bancario privato globale.

La tua sfida

- Supporto alla progettazione e governance del piano strategico: svolgere un ruolo chiave nel riesame e nel miglioramento dei quadri di compensazione differiti esistenti. proporre miglioramenti basati su sviluppi normativi, pratiche di mercato o feedback interno. Preparare presentazioni chiare, accurate e ben strutturate e documentazione di governance da presentare al Comitato esecutivo e al Consiglio di amministrazione.

- Leadership del programma End-to-End: possedere l'intero ciclo di vita dei piani di compensazione differiti. dalla progettazione alla realizzazione. garantire precisione, coerenza e adesione alle politiche interne e agli obiettivi strategici.

- Engagement & Advisory delle parti interessate: agire come punto di contatto primario per i dipendenti, i dirigenti e i partner interfunzionali (HR, finanza, giuridico, conformità, audit interno e fornitori esterni), fornendo orientamenti chiari sulla meccanica dei premi, le implicazioni fiscali e l'interpretazione delle politiche.

- Rigor operativo con controllo Mindset: Equilibrio delle responsabilità strategiche con efficienza operativa in esecuzione: compreso l'elaborazione delle transazioni, la convalida dei dati e la risoluzione dei problemi per garantire che le operazioni quotidiane funzionino senza problemi. senza perdere di vista i miglioramenti a lungo termine.

- Global Compliance & Risk Oversight: garantire la stretta conformità alle normative fiscali internazionali (inclusi gli obblighi di segnalazione locale), coordinare le informazioni annuali sulle retribuzioni e sostenere la disponibilità ad effettuare audit su tutti gli enti operativi.

- Innovazione di processo e Digitalizzazione: guidare il miglioramento continuo attraverso l'attivazione tecnologica. valutare, implementare e ottimizzare piattaforme esterne come Workday ed Equatex/EquatePlus per semplificare i processi, ridurre lo sforzo manuale e migliorare l'esperienza degli utenti.

- Governance & Control Excellence: Supporta la supervisione globale preparando e/o rivedendo la documentazione di piano e contratto, le presentazioni e i rapporti normativi. Mantieni registri e controlli completi per soddisfare i requisiti di audit interno ed esterno.

- Il "Cross-Functional" (Cross-Functional) è un'iniziativa di collaborazione tra i colleghi Global Mobility, Payroll, Legal e Reward, che si occupa di garantire la fornitura integrata in tutti i settori correlati, in particolare in settori che toccano l'espatrio, gli incentivi e i rapporti normativi.

Il tuo profilo

- Esperienza: qualifica di istruzione superiore in attività, finanza o legge con un minimo di 4 anni. esperienza in equity o differito progettazione di compensazione e amministrazione, preferibilmente all'interno di servizi finanziari o una multinazionale.

- Differito Compensazioni competenze: Conoscenza dimostrata di meccanismi di rinvio basati sul cash-and equity-based, comprese le condizioni di performance, regole incisive, scenari di consegna post-terminazione, e pratiche di mercato. Piena comprensione delle considerazioni fiscali e giuridiche (svizzero e internazionale), nonché, occupazione e questioni normative relative ai programmi di rinvio, e l'impatto della rendicontazione finanziaria (ad esempio IFRS2).

- Proficienza tecnica: elevata qualità con sistemi informativi HR (es. giornata lavorativa), software di tracciamento equity (es. EquatePlus), e relativi strumenti di reporting.

At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

Shape the Future of Executive Compensation at Julius Baer

We are looking for a proactive and experienced Deferred Compensation Specialist to take ownership of the end-to-end administration of Julius Baer’s global deferred compensation programmes. This is a key specialist position within our dynamic Rewards & Performance Management function, offering strategic exposure across compensation, compliance, tax, and governance topics.

As a trusted advisor in one of the most complex areas of total rewards, you will play a central role in managing, maintaining, and evolving our deferred compensation framework across multiple jurisdictions. With increasing scrutiny on remuneration practices in financial services, this role sits at the intersection of risk, regulation, and talent strategy.

The ideal candidate is both a structured thinker and a hands-on executor – equally comfortable analysing regulatory trends, drafting board submissions, and performing detailed operational tasks. You thrive in complex, fast-moving environments and demonstrate strong adaptability and flexibility as priorities shift across regions, business lines, or regulatory regimes.

Join a compact, high-performing team that oversees Deferred Compensation, Global Mobility, and Business Travel Compliance, giving you broad exposure across reward, tax, compliance, and finance – all within a respected global private banking leader.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Strategic Plan Design & Governance Support: Play a key role in reviewing and enhancing existing deferred compensation frameworks – proposing improvements based on regulatory developments, market practice, or internal feedback. Prepare clear, accurate, and well-structured submissions and governance documentation for presentation to the Executive Board and the Board of Directors.

• End-to-End Programme Leadership: Own the full lifecycle of deferred compensation plans – from design to delivery – ensuring precision, consistency, and adherence to internal policies and strategic objectives.

• Stakeholder Engagement & Advisory: Act as the primary point of contact for employees, executives, and cross-functional partners (HR, Finance, Legal, Compliance, Internal Audit, and external vendors), providing clear guidance on award mechanics, tax implications, and policy interpretation.

• Operational Rigor with Control Mindset: Balance strategic responsibilities with operational efficiency in execution: including transactions processing, data validation, and troubleshooting to ensure daily operations run smoothly – without losing sight of longer-term improvements.

• Global Compliance & Risk Oversight: Ensure strict compliance with international tax regulations (including local reporting obligations), coordinate annual remuneration disclosures, and support audit readiness across all operating entities.

• Process Innovation & Digitalisation: Drive continuous improvement through technology enablement – evaluating, implementing, and optimising external platforms like Workday and Equatex/EquatePlus to streamline processes, reduce manual effort, and improve user experience.

• Governance & Control Excellence: Support global oversight by preparing and/or reviewing plan and contract documentation, regulatory submissions, and reports. Maintain comprehensive records and controls to meet internal and external audit requirements.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate closely with Global Mobility, Payroll, Legal, and Reward colleagues to ensure integrated delivery across related domains, particularly in areas touching expatriation, incentives, and regulatory reporting.

YOUR PROFILE

• Experience: Higher education qualification in business, finance, or law with a minimum of 4 years’ experience in equity or deferred compensation design and administration, preferably within financial services or a multinational corporation.

• Deferred Compensation expertise: Demonstrated knowledge of cash- and equity-based deferral mechanisms, including performance conditions, vesting rules, post-termination delivery scenarios, and market practices. Solid grasp of tax and legal considerations (Swiss and international), as well as, employment and regulatory issues related to deferral programmes, and financial reporting impacts (e.g. IFRS2).

• Technical Proficiency: High familiarity with HR Information Systems (esp. Workday), equity tracking software (esp. EquatePlus), and related reporting tools. Advanced MS Office skills especially Excel modelling.

​Personal attributes:

• Demonstrate strong organisational skills, agility, and resilience, adapting quickly while maintaining accuracy and service levels.

• Function effectively amidst change – whether triggered by regulation, reorganisation, or evolving business priorities.

• Meticulous attention to detail, with uncompromising standards for accuracy

• Structured thinker with strong organisational skills who thrives in complex, regulated environments

• Results-oriented self-starter capable of working autonomously yet collaboratively

• Exceptional communicator – able to explain technical concepts simply and confidently, even under pressure

• High degree of discretion and integrity when handling sensitive, executive-level data

• A team player with a desire to continue learning, growing and developing in the role and within the area of reward/compensation.

• Language: Fluency in German and English is required.

Warenbezeichnung

Wir feiern und schätzen bei Julius Baer die individuellen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen, damit Sie sich einbringen, unternehmerisch sind, gestärkt werden und Wert jenseits des Reichtums schaffen. Lassen Sie uns gemeinsam die Zukunft des Vermögensmanagements gestalten.

Die Zukunft der Executive Compensation bei Julius Baer gestalten

Wir suchen einen proaktiven und erfahrenen Deferred Compensation Specialist, der die End-to-End-Verwaltung von Julius Baer, den globalen latenten Vergütungsprogrammen, in die Hand nimmt. Dies ist eine wichtige Fachposition innerhalb unserer dynamischen Rewards & Performance Management Funktion, die strategisches Engagement in den Bereichen Vergütung, Compliance, Steuern und Governance bietet.

Als vertrauenswürdiger Berater in einem der komplexesten Bereiche der Gesamtprämien werden Sie eine zentrale Rolle bei der Verwaltung, Aufrechterhaltung und Weiterentwicklung unseres aufgeschobenen Vergütungsrahmens in mehreren Ländern spielen. Mit zunehmender Prüfung der Vergütungspraktiken in Finanzdienstleistungen steht diese Rolle an der Schnittstelle von Risiko-, Regulierungs- und Talentstrategie.

Der ideale Kandidat ist sowohl ein strukturierter Denker als auch ein praktischer Vollstrecker – ebenso komfortabel wie die Analyse regulatorischer Trends, die Erstellung von Vorstandsbeiträgen und die Durchführung detaillierter operativer Aufgaben. Sie gedeihen in komplexen, schnelllebigen Umgebungen und zeigen eine starke Anpassungsfähigkeit und Flexibilität, da sich die Prioritäten über Regionen, Geschäftsfelder oder Regulierungsregime hinweg verschieben.

Schließen Sie sich einem kompakten, leistungsstarken Team an, das die Einhaltung der Anforderungen der Deferred Compensation, Global Mobility und Business Travel überwacht und Ihnen eine breite Präsenz in den Bereichen Belohnung, Steuern, Compliance und Finanzen bietet – alles innerhalb eines angesehenen globalen Private Banking-Führers.

Deine Herausforderung

- Strategisches Plandesign und Unterstützung für die Governance: Eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Überprüfung und Verbesserung bestehender, aufgeschobener Vergütungsrahmen spielen – Verbesserungsvorschläge basierend auf regulatorischen Entwicklungen, Marktpraxis oder internen Rückmeldungen. Bereiten Sie klare, genaue und gut strukturierte Einreichungen und Governance-Dokumentationen vor, die dem Vorstand und dem Verwaltungsrat vorgelegt werden können.

- Programmleitung Ende-zu-Ende: Sie haben den gesamten Lebenszyklus der aufgeschobenen Vergütungspläne – von der Planung bis zur Umsetzung – und gewährleisten Präzision, Konsistenz und die Einhaltung interner Politiken und strategischer Ziele.

- Dialog & Beratung: Handeln Sie als wichtigste Anlaufstelle für Mitarbeiter, Führungskräfte und funktionsübergreifende Partner (HR, Finanzen, Recht, Compliance, Interne Revision und externe Anbieter), die klare Leitlinien für die Vergabemechanik, Steuerfolgen und Politikinterpretation liefern.

- Operational Rigor with Control Mindset: Ausgleichen Sie strategische Verantwortlichkeiten mit operativer Effizienz bei der Ausführung: einschließlich Transaktionsverarbeitung, Datenvalidierung und Fehlerbehebung, um einen reibungslosen Ablauf des täglichen Betriebs zu gewährleisten – ohne längerfristige Verbesserungen aus den Augen zu verlieren.

- Global Compliance & Risk Oversight: Sicherstellung der strikten Einhaltung internationaler Steuervorschriften (einschließlich lokaler Meldepflichten), Koordinierung der jährlichen Vergütungsangaben und Unterstützung der Prüfungsbereitschaft in allen operativen Unternehmen.

- Prozessinnovation & Digitalisierung: Durch Technologie-Empowerment kontinuierlich verbessern – externe Plattformen wie Workday und Equatex/EquatePlus bewerten, implementieren und optimieren, um Prozesse zu optimieren, manuellen Aufwand zu reduzieren und die Benutzererfahrung zu verbessern.

- Governance & Control Excellence: Unterstützung der globalen Aufsicht durch die Erstellung und/oder Überprüfung von Plan- und Vertragsdokumentationen, regulatorischen Einreichungen und Berichten. Pflege umfassender Aufzeichnungen und Kontrollen zur Erfüllung interner und externer Auditanforderungen.

- Interfunktionale Zusammenarbeit: Zusammenarbeit mit den Kollegen von Global Mobility, Payroll, Legal und Reward, um eine integrierte Bereitstellung über verwandte Bereiche hinweg zu gewährleisten, insbesondere in Bereichen, die die Auswanderung, Anreize und regulatorische Berichterstattung betreffen.

Ihr Profil

- Erfahrung: Hochschulabschluss in den Bereichen Wirtschaft, Finanzen oder Recht mit mindestens 4 Jahren Erfahrung in der Eigenkapital- oder aufgeschobenen Vergütungsplanung und -verwaltung, vorzugsweise im Rahmen von Finanzdienstleistungen oder einer multinationalen Gesellschaft.

- Deferred Compensation Expertise: Vorgestelltes Wissen über bar- und kapitalbasierte Aufschubmechanismen, einschließlich Performance-Bedingungen, Rückgriffsregeln, Post-Determinations-Lieferungsszenarien und Marktpraktiken. Solides Verständnis von steuerlichen und rechtlichen Überlegungen (Schweiz und international), sowie Beschäftigungs- und Regulierungsfragen im Zusammenhang mit Aufschubprogrammen und Auswirkungen auf die Rechnungslegung (z.B. IFRS2).

- Technische Kompetenz: Hohe Vertrautheit mit HR-Informationssystemen (esp. Workday), Equity-Tracking-Software (esp. EquatePlus) und damit verbundenen Reporting-Tools. Erweiterte MS Office-Fähigkeiten, insbesondere Excel-Modellierung.

- Persönliche Attribute: - Demonstration starker organisatorischer Fähigkeiten, Agilität und Resilienz, schnelle Anpassung unter Beibehaltung der Genauigkeit und Service-Levels. - Funktion effektiv inmitten von Veränderungen – ob durch Regulierung, Reorganisation oder sich entwickelnde Geschäftsprioritäten ausgelöst.

- Sanftmütige Detaillierung mit kompromisslosen Genauigkeitsstandards - Strukturierter Denker mit starken organisatorischen Fähigkeiten, der in komplexen, regulierten Umgebungen gedeiht - Ergebnisorientierter Selbststarter, der autonom und doch kollaborativ arbeiten kann - Außergewöhnlicher Kommunikator – der in der Lage ist, technische Konzepte einfach und selbstbewusst, auch unter Druck zu erklären - Hohe Diskretion und Integrität bei der Handhabung sensibler Daten auf Führungsebene - Teamplayer mit dem Wunsch, in der Rolle und im Bereich der Belohnung/Kompensation weiter zu lernen, zu wachsen und sich weiterzuentwickeln.

Désignation des marchandises

Chez Julius Baer, nous célébrons et valorisons les qualités individuelles que vous apportez, vous permettant d'être impacté, d'être entrepreneur, d'être autonomisé et de créer une valeur au-delà de la richesse.

Former l'avenir de la rémunération des cadres supérieurs à Julius Baer

Nous recherchons un spécialiste de la rémunération différée proactif et expérimenté pour prendre en charge l'administration de bout en bout de Julius Baer, les programmes de rémunération différée globale. Il s'agit d'une position spécialisée clé dans notre fonction dynamique Rewards & Performance Management, offrant une exposition stratégique sur les questions de rémunération, de conformité, de fiscalité et de gouvernance.

En tant que conseiller de confiance dans l'un des domaines les plus complexes de la rémunération totale, vous jouerez un rôle central dans la gestion, le maintien et l'évolution de notre cadre de rémunération différée dans plusieurs administrations.

Le candidat idéal est à la fois un penseur structuré et un exécuteur pratique – tout aussi à l'aise d'analyser les tendances réglementaires, les présentations de rédaction et l'exécution de tâches opérationnelles détaillées. Vous vous développez dans des environnements complexes et rapides et démontrez une grande capacité d'adaptation et de flexibilité en tant que priorités changeantes entre les régions, les secteurs d'activité ou les régimes réglementaires.

Rejoignez une équipe compacte et performante qui supervise la rémunération, la mobilité mondiale et la conformité aux règles de voyage d'affaires, vous donnant une large visibilité sur les récompenses, les impôts, la conformité et les finances – le tout au sein d'un leader mondial des banques privées.

Votre défi

- Soutien à la conception et à la gouvernance du plan stratégique : jouer un rôle clé dans l'examen et l'amélioration des cadres de rémunération différée existants – proposer des améliorations fondées sur les évolutions réglementaires, les pratiques du marché ou les commentaires internes.

- Leadership du programme de bout en bout : Possédez le cycle de vie complet des plans de rémunération différés – de la conception à la prestation – en assurant la précision, la cohérence et le respect des politiques internes et des objectifs stratégiques.

- Engagement des intervenants et avis : Agir comme principal point de contact pour les employés, les cadres supérieurs et les partenaires interfonctionnels (RH, Finances, Services juridiques, Conformité, Vérification interne et fournisseurs externes), en fournissant des conseils clairs sur la mécanique des prix, les implications fiscales et l'interprétation des politiques.

- Rigeur opérationnelle avec contrôle Mindset : équilibrer les responsabilités stratégiques avec l'efficacité opérationnelle en exécution : traitement des transactions, validation des données et dépannage pour assurer un fonctionnement quotidien sans perdre de vue les améliorations à long terme.

- Surveillance mondiale de la conformité et des risques : veiller au strict respect des réglementations fiscales internationales (y compris les obligations de déclaration locales), coordonner les divulgations annuelles de la rémunération et appuyer la préparation des audits dans toutes les entités opérationnelles.

- Innovation et numérisation des processus : Diriger l'amélioration continue par la technologie en 2006 – évaluer, mettre en œuvre et optimiser les plateformes externes comme Workday et Equitex/EquatePlus pour rationaliser les processus, réduire l'effort manuel et améliorer l'expérience utilisateur.

- Gouvernance et excellence en matière de contrôle : Appuyer la surveillance mondiale en préparant et/ou en examinant la documentation sur les plans et les contrats, les présentations réglementaires et les rapports.

- Collaboration interfonctionnelle : Collaborez étroitement avec les collègues de la Mobilité mondiale, de la Rémunération, des Services juridiques et des Récompenses pour assurer une prestation intégrée dans les domaines connexes, en particulier dans les domaines touchant l'expatriation, les mesures incitatives et les rapports réglementaires.

Votre profil

- Expérience : Formation supérieure en affaires, finances ou droit avec un minimum de 4 ans, expérience en capitaux propres ou en planification et administration différées de la rémunération, de préférence dans les services financiers ou dans une société multinationale.

- Expertise en rémunérations dépréciées : Connaissance démontrée des mécanismes de report fondés sur la trésorerie et les capitaux propres, y compris les conditions de performance, les règles de cession, les scénarios de livraison après la détermination et les pratiques du marché.

- Compétences techniques : Connaissance des systèmes d'information RH (esp. Workday), des logiciels de suivi des actions (esp. EquatePlus) et des outils de rapport connexes.

- Attributs personnels : - Démontrer des compétences organisationnelles fortes, de l'agilité et de la résilience, s'adapter rapidement tout en maintenant la précision et les niveaux de service. - Fonctionner efficacement au milieu du changement – que ce soit par la réglementation, la réorganisation ou l'évolution des priorités commerciales.

- Une attention particulière aux détails, avec des normes de précision intransigeantes - Un penseur structuré doté de solides compétences organisationnelles qui prospère dans des environnements complexes et réglementés - Un auto-démarrage orienté vers les résultats capable de travailler de manière autonome et collaborative - Un communicateur exceptionnel - capable d'expliquer les concepts techniques simplement et en toute confiance, même sous pression - Un haut degré de discrétion et d'intégrité lors de la manipulation de données sensibles et de niveau exécutif - Un joueur d'équipe qui souhaite continuer à apprendre, à grandir et à se développer dans le rôle et dans le domaine de la récompense/compensation.

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

Valuation Control is part of Product Control which is focused on the trading and treasury activities of Julius Baer. Independent compilations of profit and loss figures allow for a transparent and save business environment ensuring accurate financial reporting. Front to back reconciliations of positions, cash accounts and profit and loss statements ensure data integrity across systems.

Valuation Control collaborates with Finance, Risk, and Front Office functions to support transparent financial reporting and meets regulatory and audit obligations. Operating independently, Valuation Control provides a crucial second-line-of-defence oversight to safeguard the reliability of the Bank’s financial statements. Its function ensures the accuracy and integrity of fair value measurements for financial instruments, primarily under IFRS 13 requirements. It performs independent price verification, identifying and resolving discrepancies. The team oversees the classification of instruments within the fair value hierarchy (Levels 1–3) and monitors the use of pricing models, especially for illiquid or complex products.

Moreover, Valuation Control is responsible for the calculation of various additional valuation adjustments under Prudent Valuation regulations. As such the team ensures a robust valuation governance framework to enhance the credibility and reliability of financial reporting by reflecting realistic market conditions, thereby strengthening investor confidence, supporting regulatory compliance, and mitigating the risk of future losses or restatements.

The successful candidate will be a senior valuation control professional with strong technical expertise across financial instruments, valuation methodologies, valuation uncertainty and regulatory expectations. The role requires strong leadership, provides independent challenge to Front valuations and partners across Finance, Product Control, Market Risk, Model Validation, Front Office, Regulatory Reporting and Technology. The role will provide senior ownership of valuation governance, independent price verification, valuation adjustments, fair value control, prudent valuation adjustments and related control processes.

YOUR CHALLENGE
The role of the Head of Valuation Control includes:

• Lead Valuation Control within Product Control, overseeing valuation governance, independent price verification (IPV), valuation adjustments, and fair value controls

• Defining and implementing the target operating model for prudent valuation adjustments (PVA), including methodology, governance, controls, data requirements, systems, reporting and senior management oversight

• Lead development and governance of additional valuation adjustments (AVA), covering market price uncertainty, close-out costs, funding & investing costs, unearned credit spreads, concentrated positions, future administrative costs and early termination

• Enhancement of the Bank’s valuation control framework

• Assessing new products in the new product approval process

• Develop a comprehensive fair value levelling framework

• Provide senior-level oversight of valuations for trading and treasury products, including derivatives, fixed income, rates, credit, FX, and structured instruments

• Ensure robust independent price verification through price testing, adjustments, valuation challenge, and escalation

• Deliver independent challenge to Front Office pricing, models, assumptions, and methodologies

• Establish strong governance via methodology reviews, control standards, documentation, approvals, and senior reporting

• Present valuation control insights to senior management, risk committees, auditors, and regulators

• Ensure valuation processes are underpinned by reliable data, systems, controls, and auditability

• Support internal/external audits and regulatory reviews on fair value and valuation control matters

• Drive automation, process improvements, and control enhancements for greater efficiency and scalability

• Lead and develop a high-performing team of valuation control specialists, fostering technical excellence and career growth

YOUR PROFILE

• Degree in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a quantitative field

• Extensive experience in Risk or Finance (10+ years) of which at least 5-year experience in Valuation Control, Market Risk, or related banking control functions

• Proven leadership track record within valuation or product control environments

• Leading the Bank’s PVA agenda within Product Control / Valuation Control

• Deep technical expertise in fair value governance, IPV, valuation reserves, and PVA, including market price uncertainty, model risk, and close-out costs

• Strong knowledge of financial instruments across rates, credit, FX, derivatives, fixed income, and structured products

• Experienced in challenging valuation models, assumptions, inputs, and outputs in collaboration with Front Office and Model Validation

• Thorough understanding of regulatory requirements (IFRS 13, Basel, EBA) relating to fair value and valuation control

• Skilled in designing and enhancing valuation control frameworks, governance, reporting, and system-driven controls

• Strong data and technology awareness, with ability to drive automation and control improvements

• Programming skills (Python, SQL or alike) desirabl

• Excellent analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills—effective at engaging senior leaders, auditors, and regulators

• Capable of leading teams and delivering results in complex, highly regulated environments

• Professional qualification (e.g., CFA, FRM, ACA/ACCA, CPA) desirable

• Business fluency in English required, German an advantage

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Julius Baer, celebriamo e valorizziamo le qualità individuali che portate, permettendovi di essere impeccabili, di essere imprenditoriali, di essere potenziati e di creare valore al di là della ricchezza. Formiamo insieme il futuro della gestione della ricchezza. Valuation Control fa parte del Product Control che si concentra sulle attività di trading e di tesoreria di Julius Baer. Le compilazioni indipendenti di dati di profitto e di perdita permettono un ambiente di business trasparente e sicuro, assicurando un report finanziario accurato. Le conciliazioni di posizioni, conti in contanti e dichiarazioni di profitto e di perdita assicurano l'integrità dei dati attraverso i sistemi. Valuation Control collabora con le funzioni Finance, Risk e Front Office per supportare la reportistica finanziaria trasparente e soddisfare gli obblighi normativi e di audit. Operando in modo indipendente, Valuation Control fornisce una fondamentale supervisione di seconda linea di difesa per salvaguardare l’affidabilità del bilancio della Banca. La sua funzione garantisce l'accuratezza e l'integrità delle misure di fair value per gli strumenti finanziari, principalmente sotto i requisiti IFRS 13. Esegue la verifica dei prezzi indipendente, l'identificazione e la risoluzione delle discrepanze. Il team supervisiona la classificazione degli strumenti all'interno della gerarchia del fair value (Levels 1–3) e monitora l'utilizzo dei modelli di prezzi, soprattutto per prodotti illiquidi o complessi. Inoltre, Valuation Control è responsabile per il calcolo di varie regolazioni di valutazione aggiuntive in base alle normative di Prudent Valuation. In quanto tale il team assicura un quadro di governance di valutazione robusto per migliorare la credibilità e l'affidabilità del reporting finanziario riflettendo le condizioni di mercato realistiche, rafforzando così la fiducia degli investitori, sostenendo la conformità normativa, e mitigando il rischio di future perdite o risarcimenti. Il candidato di successo sarà un professionista di controllo di valutazione senior con una forte competenza tecnica tra strumenti finanziari, metodologie di valutazione, incertezza di valutazione e aspettative di regolamentazione. Il ruolo richiede una forte leadership, fornisce una sfida indipendente alle valutazioni frontali e ai partner tra Finanza, Controllo prodotti, Rischio di mercato, Convalida dei modelli, Front Office, Resoconto Regolamentare e Tecnologia. Il ruolo fornirà la proprietà senior della governance della valutazione, la verifica dei prezzi indipendente, le regolazioni di valutazione, il controllo del fair value, le regolazioni di valutazione prudente e i relativi processi di controllo. LA TUA SICUREZZA Il ruolo del capo del controllo della valutazione comprende:
• Lead Valuation Control all'interno del Product Control, supervisionando la governance della valutazione, la verifica dei prezzi indipendente (IPV), le regolazioni di valutazione e i controlli del fair value
• Definire e implementare il modello operativo target per gli aggiustamenti di valutazione prudente (PVA), tra cui metodologia, governance, controlli, requisiti di dati, sistemi, reporting e supervisione senior management
• Sviluppo del piombo e governance di ulteriori aggiustamenti di valutazione (AVA), che coprono l'incertezza dei prezzi di mercato, i costi di chiusura, i costi di finanziamento e di investimento, gli spread di credito non recuperati, le posizioni concentrate, i costi amministrativi futuri e la risoluzione anticipata
• Miglioramento del quadro di controllo della valutazione della Banca
• Valutare nuovi prodotti nel nuovo processo di approvazione del prodotto
• Sviluppare un quadro globale di livellamento del fair value
• Fornire la supervisione di livello superiore delle valutazioni per i prodotti di trading e di tesoreria, compresi derivati, reddito fisso, tassi, credito, FX e strumenti strutturati
• Assicurare una robusta verifica dei prezzi indipendente tramite test dei prezzi, regolazioni, sfida di valutazione e escalation
• Fornire una sfida indipendente ai prezzi, modelli, ipotesi e metodologie di Front Office

At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

Valuation Control is part of Product Control which is focused on the trading and treasury activities of Julius Baer. Independent compilations of profit and loss figures allow for a transparent and save business environment ensuring accurate financial reporting. Front to back reconciliations of positions, cash accounts and profit and loss statements ensure data integrity across systems.

Valuation Control collaborates with Finance, Risk, and Front Office functions to support transparent financial reporting and meets regulatory and audit obligations. Operating independently, Valuation Control provides a crucial second-line-of-defence oversight to safeguard the reliability of the Bank’s financial statements. Its function ensures the accuracy and integrity of fair value measurements for financial instruments, primarily under IFRS 13 requirements. It performs independent price verification, identifying and resolving discrepancies. The team oversees the classification of instruments within the fair value hierarchy (Levels 1–3) and monitors the use of pricing models, especially for illiquid or complex products.

Moreover, Valuation Control is responsible for the calculation of various additional valuation adjustments under Prudent Valuation regulations. As such the team ensures a robust valuation governance framework to enhance the credibility and reliability of financial reporting by reflecting realistic market conditions, thereby strengthening investor confidence, supporting regulatory compliance, and mitigating the risk of future losses or restatements.

The successful candidate will be a senior valuation control professional with strong technical expertise across financial instruments, valuation methodologies, valuation uncertainty and regulatory expectations. The role requires strong leadership, provides independent challenge to Front valuations and partners across Finance, Product Control, Market Risk, Model Validation, Front Office, Regulatory Reporting and Technology. The role will provide senior ownership of valuation governance, independent price verification, valuation adjustments, fair value control, prudent valuation adjustments and related control processes.

YOUR CHALLENGE
The role of the Head of Valuation Control includes:

• Lead Valuation Control within Product Control, overseeing valuation governance, independent price verification (IPV), valuation adjustments, and fair value controls

• Defining and implementing the target operating model for prudent valuation adjustments (PVA), including methodology, governance, controls, data requirements, systems, reporting and senior management oversight

• Lead development and governance of additional valuation adjustments (AVA), covering market price uncertainty, close-out costs, funding & investing costs, unearned credit spreads, concentrated positions, future administrative costs and early termination

• Enhancement of the Bank’s valuation control framework

• Assessing new products in the new product approval process

• Develop a comprehensive fair value levelling framework

• Provide senior-level oversight of valuations for trading and treasury products, including derivatives, fixed income, rates, credit, FX, and structured instruments

• Ensure robust independent price verification through price testing, adjustments, valuation challenge, and escalation

• Deliver independent challenge to Front Office pricing, models, assumptions, and methodologies

• Establish strong governance via methodology reviews, control standards, documentation, approvals, and senior reporting

• Present valuation control insights to senior management, risk committees, auditors, and regulators

• Ensure valuation processes are underpinned by reliable data, systems, controls, and auditability

• Support internal/external audits and regulatory reviews on fair value and valuation control matters

• Drive automation, process improvements, and control enhancements for greater efficiency and scalability

• Lead and develop a high-performing team of valuation control specialists, fostering technical excellence and career growth

YOUR PROFILE

• Degree in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a quantitative field

• Extensive experience in Risk or Finance (10+ years) of which at least 5-year experience in Valuation Control, Market Risk, or related banking control functions

• Proven leadership track record within valuation or product control environments

• Leading the Bank’s PVA agenda within Product Control / Valuation Control

• Deep technical expertise in fair value governance, IPV, valuation reserves, and PVA, including market price uncertainty, model risk, and close-out costs

• Strong knowledge of financial instruments across rates, credit, FX, derivatives, fixed income, and structured products

• Experienced in challenging valuation models, assumptions, inputs, and outputs in collaboration with Front Office and Model Validation

• Thorough understanding of regulatory requirements (IFRS 13, Basel, EBA) relating to fair value and valuation control

• Skilled in designing and enhancing valuation control frameworks, governance, reporting, and system-driven controls

• Strong data and technology awareness, with ability to drive automation and control improvements

• Programming skills (Python, SQL or alike) desirabl

• Excellent analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills—effective at engaging senior leaders, auditors, and regulators

• Capable of leading teams and delivering results in complex, highly regulated environments

• Professional qualification (e.g., CFA, FRM, ACA/ACCA, CPA) desirable

• Business fluency in English required, German an advantage

Bei Julius Bär feiern und schätzen wir die individuellen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen, damit Sie wirkungsvoll sein, unternehmerisch handeln, gestärkt werden und Werte jenseits von Wohlstand schaffen können. Gestalten wir gemeinsam die Zukunft des Wealth Managements. Valuation Control ist Teil der Produktkontrolle, die sich auf die Handels- und Treasury-Aktivitäten von Julius Bär konzentriert. Unabhängige Zusammenstellungen von Gewinn- und Verlustzahlen ermöglichen ein transparentes und sicheres Geschäftsumfeld, das eine genaue Finanzberichterstattung gewährleistet. Front-to-back-Abgleiche von Positionen, Geldkonten und Gewinn- und Verlustrechnungen gewährleisten die Datenintegrität über alle Systeme hinweg. Valuation Control arbeitet mit Finanz-, Risiko- und Front Office-Funktionen zusammen, um eine transparente Finanzberichterstattung zu unterstützen und die regulatorischen und Prüfungspflichten zu erfüllen. Unabhängig tätig, bietet Valuation Control eine entscheidende Second-Line-of-Defence-Aufsicht, um die Zuverlässigkeit der Finanzausweise der Bank zu gewährleisten. Seine Funktion gewährleistet die Genauigkeit und Integrität der Bemessung des beizulegenden Zeitwerts von Finanzinstrumenten, vor allem nach den IFRS 13-Anforderungen. Es führt eine unabhängige Preisüberprüfung durch, identifiziert und löst Diskrepanzen. Das Team überwacht die Klassifizierung von Instrumenten innerhalb der Fair-Value-Hierarchie (Stufen 1–3) und überwacht die Verwendung von Preismodellen, insbesondere für illiquide oder komplexe Produkte. Darüber hinaus ist Valuation Control für die Berechnung verschiedener zusätzlicher Bewertungsanpassungen gemäß den Prudent Valuation-Vorschriften verantwortlich. Als solches stellt das Team einen robusten Bewertungs-Governance-Rahmen sicher, um die Glaubwürdigkeit und Zuverlässigkeit der Finanzberichterstattung zu verbessern, indem es realistische Marktbedingungen widerspiegelt, wodurch das Vertrauen der Anleger gestärkt, die Einhaltung der Vorschriften unterstützt und das Risiko zukünftiger Verluste oder Anpassungen verringert wird. Chez Julius Baer, nous célébrons et valorisons les qualités individuelles que vous apportez, vous permettant d'avoir un impact, d'être entrepreneur, d'être autonomisé et de créer une valeur au-delà de la richesse. C'est l'avenir de la gestion des richesses. Le contrôle de l'évaluation fait partie du contrôle des produits qui est axé sur les activités de négociation et de trésorerie de Julius Baer. Des compilations indépendantes de chiffres de profits et pertes permettent de créer un environnement commercial transparent et économisant garantissant une information financière précise. Les rapprochements des positions, des comptes de caisse et des états des profits et pertes font en sorte que les données sont intégrées dans tous les systèmes. Le contrôle de l'évaluation collabore avec les fonctions Finances, Risques et Front Office pour appuyer la transparence des rapports financiers et respecter les obligations réglementaires et de vérification. Fonctionnant de façon indépendante, le Contrôle de l'évaluation assure une surveillance de deuxième ligne de défense essentielle pour préserver la fiabilité des états financiers de la Banque. Sa fonction garantit l'exactitude et l'intégrité des mesures de la juste valeur des instruments financiers, principalement selon les exigences d'IFRS 13. Il effectue une vérification indépendante des prix, identifie et résout les écarts. L'équipe supervise la classification des instruments dans la hiérarchie de la juste valeur (niveaux 1 à 3) et surveille l'utilisation des modèles de tarification, en particulier pour les produits non liquides ou complexes. De plus, le contrôle d'évaluation est responsable du calcul de divers rajustements d'évaluation supplémentaires en vertu des règlements sur l'évaluation prudente. À ce titre, l'équipe assure un cadre solide de gouvernance de l'évaluation pour accroître la crédibilité et la fiabilité de l'information financière en tenant compte des conditions réalistes du marché, renforçant ainsi la confiance des investisseurs, appuyant la conformité à la réglementation et atténuant le risque de pertes ou de reformulations futures. Le candidat retenu sera un professionnel principal du contrôle de l'évaluation ayant une solide expertise technique dans les instruments financiers, les méthodes d'évaluation, l'incertitude en matière d'évaluation et les attentes réglementaires. Ce rôle exige un leadership solide, constitue un défi indépendant pour les évaluateurs et les partenaires du secteur des finances, du contrôle des produits, du risque de marché, de la validation des modèles, de l'administration centrale, des rapports réglementaires et de la technologie. Ce rôle assurera la propriété principale de la gouvernance de l'évaluation, de la vérification indépendante des prix, des ajustements d'évaluation, du contrôle de la juste valeur, des ajustements d'évaluation prudents et des processus de contrôle connexes. Votre défi Le rôle du chef du contrôle de l'évaluation comprend :
• Contrôle de l'évaluation du plomb au sein du contrôle des produits, supervision de la gouvernance de l'évaluation, vérification indépendante des prix (VPI), ajustements d'évaluation et contrôles de la juste valeur
• Définition et mise en œuvre du modèle opérationnel cible pour les ajustements prudents en matière d'évaluation, y compris la méthodologie, la gouvernance, les contrôles, les exigences en matière de données, les systèmes, les rapports et la surveillance de la haute direction
• Diriger le développement et la gouvernance des ajustements d'évaluation supplémentaires (AVA), couvrant l'incertitude des prix du marché, les coûts de clôture, les coûts de financement et d'investissement, les écarts de crédit non gagnés, les positions concentrées, les coûts administratifs futurs et la résiliation anticipée
• Amélioration du cadre de contrôle de l'évaluation de la Banque
• Évaluation des nouveaux produits dans le nouveau processus d'approbation des produits
• Élaborer un cadre global de nivelage de la juste valeur
• Superviser de haut niveau les évaluations des produits de négociation et de trésorerie, y compris les produits dérivés, les produits à revenu fixe, les taux, le crédit, les instruments financiers et les instruments structurés
• Assurer une solide vérification indépendante des prix grâce à des tests de prix, des ajustements, un défi d'évaluation et une escalade
• Offrir un défi indépendant aux prix, aux modèles, aux hypothèses et aux méthodologies de Front Office
• Établir une gouvernance solide au moyen d'examens méthodologiques, de normes de contrôle, de documents, d'approbations et de rapports de haut niveau
• Présenter des renseignements sur le contrôle de l'évaluation à la haute direction, aux comités des risques, aux vérificateurs et aux organismes de réglementation
• Veiller à ce que les processus d'évaluation soient étayés par des données, des systèmes, des contrôles fiables et une vérification des comptes
• Appuyer les vérifications internes/externes et les examens réglementaires sur les questions de juste valeur et de contrôle de l'évaluation
• Automatisation de la conduite, améliorations des processus et améliorations de contrôle pour une plus grande efficacité et évolutivité
• Diriger et développer une équipe de spécialistes du contrôle de l'évaluation hautement performante, favorisant l'excellence technique et la croissance de carrière VOTRE PROFIL

At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

Join Our Team as Financial Accountant!
At Julius Baer, we are committed to excellence in wealth management. As a Financial Accountant, you will play a key role in managing accounting activities for both domestic and international entities, contributing directly to the integrity and efficiency of our financial operations.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Manage accounting and financial reporting for Bank Julius Baer and affiliated domestic and international entities

• Prepare monthly financial statements and business reports, including VAT returns in accordance with local regulations

• Ensure compliance with internal control systems (ICS)

• Contribute to the implementation of internal and external accounting regulations (including IFRS)

• Perform analytical reviews of balance sheet and income statement positions

• Prepare group (IFRS) and local statutory reporting

• Collaborate cross-functionally with Group Tax, Management Accounting, IT, and Payroll

• Support corporate activities such as entity setup, acquisitions, and liquidations

• Drive process improvements and support SAP-related initiatives (R/3, S/4HANA)

• Provide technical accounting support and troubleshooting across international teams

• Participate in system and process testing for accounting applications

YOUR PROFILE

• Swiss Certified Accountant or Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, or related field

• Minimum 3 years of experience in financial accounting, ideally within banking or financial services

• Strong knowledge of IFRS

• Experience with SAP R/3 or S/4HANA is an advantage

• Proficient in MS Office

• Fluent in German and English (written and spoken)

• Strong analytical skills and attention to detail

• Collaborative team player with a proactive mindset

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

The Global Network Management department is responsible for the management and strategy of Bank Julius Baer’s custodian and cash correspondent relationships. As a Global Network Manager, you will be responsible for managing this network of Agent Banks. We are a pivotal team that has touchpoints across the entire global organisation and a significant impact on the success of the firm. In this highly varied role, you will be responsible for the management of all aspects of these relationships and play a central role in ensuring best in class provision of post trade services to the bank, as well as further developing the network
to meet our evolving needs. In this exciting role - no two days will be the same. The opening would suit a candidate with ambition to develop a broad, cross-disciplinary expertise and have exposure to a wide range of processes and initiatives. We look forward to hearing from you!

YOUR CHALLENGE
Global responsibility for assigned custodian and cash correspondent relationships, which
includes:
• Active service management of Agent Bank relationships, conducting regular service meetings, service reviews, due diligences, the active monitoring, and management of service provision to Bank Julius Baer
• Negotiation and management of fees, ensuring understanding of costs, evolution, as well as idea generation and implementation to achieve cost optimisations
• Oversight of contracts, negotiation, and implementation of documentation necessary for these relationships
• Collaborate with stakeholders to identify and deliver on continued Front to Back process optimisation across the network
• Understanding of market and agent developments, trends, and opportunities to Bank Julius Baer and dissemination to stakeholders
• Maintain deep understanding of the custody rules and a strong ability to apply knowledges to support with internal advisory / consultancy to support business and client needs
Bank Julius Baer service delivery which includes:
• Develop deep custody and payments expertise to be able to provide guidance to client facing units on local account opening requirements, market custody rules and service issues
• Establish and maintain strong relationships with all key internal stakeholders associated with custody and cash correspondent service (ie. Operations, Trading, Global Custody, Private Banking Front Office, Compliance, etc)
• Respond promptly and effectively to any market specific queries and escalations from Business, Operations, or other colleagues
• Work in the team to support colleagues with markets and tasks as and when required
• Contribute to special projects and initiatives within Bank Julius Baer as required
• Undertake necessary steps with internal and external colleagues to remediate any identified issues to ensure market compliance
• Contribute to help shape a culture of openness, enthusiasm and curiosity within the team and the firm

YOUR PROFILE
• Relevant experience in a Network Management, Financial Institutions, Relationship Management or Client facing role in a banking environment preferred
• Demonstrated track record managing vendors and/or internal stakeholders, ideally related to custodian and cash correspondent preferred
• At least general knowledge of custody operations, market rules and cash operations, correspondent services
• Excellent interpersonal skills and able to build strong relationships with internal and external partners
• Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities under pressure. Demonstratable can-do mindset and a structured working style
• Ability to identify root causes of issues and required remediation under pressure
• Proactive, self-motivated mindset and willingness to take on responsibility.
• Excellent analytical, decision making and problem-solving skills to effectively resolve and/or guide the resolution of service issues
• Willingness to understand the mechanics of processes and to continue to develop expertise
• Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills to manage external and internal relationships and represent Bank Julius Baer influencing to lead negotiations
• Strong team player, able to multi-task in a dynamic business environment
• Excellent data analysis and presentation skills are essential, an aptitude for technology will be an added advantage
• Good MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint skills essential, an aptitude for technology will be an added advantage
• Proficiency in German and English (written and spoken) essential, additional languages are a plus

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.
Is this not quite what you are looking for? Set up a job alert by creating a candidate account here.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Chi Siamo A Julius Baer, celebriamo e valorizziamo le qualità individuali che si portano, consentendo di essere influenti, di essere imprenditoriale, di essere autorizzati, e di creare valore al di là della ricchezza. Lasciate che il futuro della gestione della ricchezza insieme. Descrizione Il dipartimento di Gestione della Rete Globale è responsabile della gestione e della strategia di Bank Julius Baer.s custode e rapporti di corrispondenza in denaro. Come Global Network Manager, sarà responsabile della gestione di questa rete di Agent Banks. Siamo un team fondamentale che ha punti di contatto in tutta l'organizzazione globale e un impatto significativo sul successo dell'azienda. In questo ruolo molto vario, sarete responsabili della gestione di tutti gli aspetti di queste relazioni e svolgerete un ruolo centrale nel garantire il meglio nella fornitura di servizi post-commercio di classe alla banca, nonché nello sviluppo ulteriore della rete per soddisfare le nostre esigenze in evoluzione. In questo ruolo entusiasmante - non ci saranno due giorni uguali. L'apertura si addicerebbe ad un candidato con l'ambizione di sviluppare un'ampia competenza interdisciplinare e avere esposizione ad una vasta gamma di processi e iniziative. Responsabilità La SFIDA Responsabilità globale per i rapporti di deposito e di corrispondente in contanti assegnati, che comprende: - Gestione attiva dei rapporti con l'agente Banca, svolgimento di riunioni regolari di servizio, revisioni dei servizi, due diligence, monitoraggio attivo e gestione della fornitura di servizi a Bank Julius Baer - Negoziazione e gestione delle commissioni, garanzia di comprensione dei costi, evoluzione, nonché generazione di idee e attuazione per ottenere ottimizzazioni dei costi - Supervisione dei contratti, negoziazione e attuazione della documentazione necessaria per questi relazioni - Collaborare con le parti interessate per identificare e fornire l'ottimizzazione continua del processo Front to Back in tutta la rete - Comprensione degli sviluppi del mercato e degli agenti, tendenze e opportunità per Bank Julius Baer e diffusione alle parti interessate - Mantenere una profonda comprensione delle regole di custodia e una forte capacità di applicare le conoscenze per supportare con consulenza interna / consulenza per sostenere le esigenze aziendali e dei clienti Bank Julius Baer consegna del servizio che include: - Sviluppare competenze di custodia e pagamenti per essere in grado di fornire orientamenti ai clienti affrontando le unità su requisiti di apertura dei conti locali, regole di custodia del mercato e questioni di servizio - Stabilire e mantenere forti relazioni con tutti i principali soggetti interni coinvolti nel servizio di custodia e corrispondente in contanti (es. Operazioni, Trading, Custodia Globale, Private Banking Front Office, Compliance, ecc. - Rispondere prontamente ed efficacemente a qualsiasi domanda e crescente richiesta di mercato da parte di Business, Operazioni o altri colleghi - Lavorare nel team per supportare i colleghi con mercati e compiti come e quando richiesto - Contribuire a progetti speciali e iniziative in seno a Bank Julius Baer se necessario - Intraprendere i passi necessari con colleghi interni ed esterni per remediare eventuali problemi identificati per garantire la conformità del mercato - Contribuire a contribuire a formare una cultura di apertura, entusiasmo e curiosità all'interno della squadra e lo studio
• Requisiti Il tuo PROFILE - Esperienza rilevante in una gestione di rete, istituzioni finanziarie, gestione delle relazioni o ruolo di fronte al cliente in un ambiente bancario preferito - Dimostrata gestione dei record di track e/o stakeholder interni, idealmente legato al custode e corrispondente al contante preferito - Almeno conoscenza generale delle operazioni di custodia, regole di mercato e operazioni di cassa, servizi corrispondenti - Ottime competenze interpersonali e in grado di costruire forti relazioni con partner interni ed esterni - Forte capacità organizzative con la capacità di gestire concorrenti priorità sotto pressione. Dimostrabile capacità di fare la mente e uno stile di lavoro strutturato - Capacità di identificare le cause profonde dei problemi e necessaria bonifica sotto pressione - Proattivo, auto-motivato mentalità e la volontà di assumersi la responsabilità. - Eccellente capacità analitica, decisionale e di risoluzione dei problemi per risolvere efficacemente e/o guidare la risoluzione dei problemi di servizio - Volontà di comprendere la meccanica dei processi e di continuare a sviluppare competenze - Comunicazione eccezionale e capacità interpersonali per gestire relazioni esterne e interne e rappresentare la Banca Julius Baer che influenza per condurre trattative - Forte giocatore di squadra, in grado di multi-task in un ambiente dinamico di business - Ottima analisi dei dati e capacità di presentazione sono essenziali, un'attitudine per la tecnologia sarà un vantaggio aggiunto - Buona MS Word, Excel e competenze PowerPoint essenziali, un'attitudine per la tecnologia sarà un vantaggio aggiunto - Proficienza in tedesco e inglese (scritto e parlato) essenziale, ulteriori lingue sono un plus Contatto Siamo lieti di ricevere la vostra applicazione di lavoro completo attraverso il nostro strumento di applicazione online. Ulteriori interessanti opportunità di lavoro possono essere trovati sul nostro sito Career. Non è questo che stai cercando? Configurare un avviso di lavoro creando un account candidato qui.

jobs.title: Lombard Credit Officer 100% (f/m/d) - (Contract through our external payroll partner with immediate start until 23.12.2026)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

Responsible for all Lombard risk aspects of a portfolio of domestic and international private banking clients. Assess, analyse, structure, approve, implement and monitor Lombard credit requests / transactions. Provide credit advisory service to internal clients and work hand-in-hand with RMs /first line of defense to customise appropriate solutions to the end clients.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Analysis and assessment of collateral and exposure (e.g. derivatives) including detection of concentration risks

• Assessment of borrower, collateral provider with regards to structural, legal, compliance and reputational risks

• Determination of risk rating for a credit facility

• Preparation and approval of credit limits within the delegated credit approval authority (depending on risk rating and amount)

• Application of special lending values and margin terms on client specific level

• Ongoing monitoring of credit exposure; resolving of collateral shortfalls and limit excesses, including issuance of margin calls

• Regular review of approved limits

• Administration duties, e.g. fixed term loans approval, payment and securities releases and proper credit documentation

• Deputize other Credit Officers in their absence

• Support relationship managers and other stakeholders in all credit related matters, establish regular and proactive contact as well as providing ongoing credit training

• Contribution in credit related projects and process improvements

• Work with legal to draft non-standard documents related to credit transactions

• Preparation and performing of training session for Credit Officer and Relationship Manager

YOUR PROFILE

• University Bachelor degree or completed studies at a university of applied sciences (economics, banking, finance, law), or equivalent education or professional experience

• Several years of professional experience in the credit sector (in particular Lombard credit) is an advantage

• Solid technical knowledge regarding the handling of life insurance policies (wrappers, ULIPs) is a plus

• Interest in the functioning of financial markets and financial institutions

• Good IT skills (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and excellent analytical skills

• Independent, reliable, and team-oriented personality

• Solution oriented with problem solving and negotiating skills

• Strong analytical skills, developed awareness in legal, tax and reputational issues

• Personality with good organizational and operational skills and ability to work under high pressure

• Sense of integrity and discretion

• Excellent communication and solid presentation skills

• Perseverance and persistence

• Excellent German and English language skills (written and spoken), any additional languages are an advantage

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.
Is this not quite what you are looking for? Set up a job alert by creating a candidate account here.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Julius Bär feiern und schätzen wir die individuellen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen, damit Sie wirkungsvoll sein, unternehmerisch handeln, gestärkt werden und Werte jenseits von Wohlstand schaffen können. Gestalten wir gemeinsam die Zukunft des Wealth Managements. Verantwortlich für alle Lombard-Risikoaspekte eines Portfolios von inländischen und internationalen Private-Banking-Kunden. Bewerten, analysieren, strukturieren, genehmigen, implementieren und überwachen Lombard Kreditanfragen / Transaktionen. Bieten Sie Kreditberatung für interne Kunden und arbeiten Sie Hand in Hand mit RMs / First Line of Defense, um geeignete Lösungen für die Endkunden anzupassen. IHRE HERAUSFORDERUNG
• Analyse und Bewertung von Sicherheiten und Risikopositionen (z. B. Derivate) einschließlich Ermittlung von Konzentrationsrisiken
• Bewertung des Kreditnehmers, des Besicherungsgebers in Bezug auf strukturelle, rechtliche, Compliance- und Reputationsrisiken
• Bestimmung des Risikoratings für eine Kreditfazilität
• Erstellung und Genehmigung von Kreditlimits innerhalb der delegierten Kreditgenehmigungsbehörde (abhängig von Risikoeinstufung und -betrag)
• Anwendung besonderer Kreditwerte und Einschussbedingungen auf kundenspezifischer Ebene
• Laufende Überwachung des Kreditrisikos; Behebung von Sicherheitslücken und Begrenzung von Überschreitungen, einschließlich Ausgabe von Nachschussforderungen
• Regelmäßige Überprüfung genehmigter Grenzwerte
• Verwaltungsaufgaben, z. B. Genehmigung von befristeten Darlehen, Zahlungs- und Wertpapierfreigaben und ordnungsgemäße Kreditdokumentation
• Ersetzen Sie andere Credit Officers in ihrer Abwesenheit
• Unterstützung von Relationship Managern und anderen Stakeholdern in allen kreditbezogenen Angelegenheiten, regelmäßige und proaktive Kontakte sowie laufende Kreditschulungen
• Beitrag zu kreditbezogenen Projekten und Prozessverbesserungen
• Arbeiten Sie mit Legal, um nicht standardisierte Dokumente im Zusammenhang mit Kredittransaktionen zu erstellen
• Vorbereitung und Durchführung von Schulungen für Credit Officer und Relationship Manager IHR PROFIL
• Hochschulabschluss oder abgeschlossenes Studium an einer Fachhochschule (Wirtschaft, Bankwesen, Finanzen, Recht) oder gleichwertige Ausbildung oder Berufserfahrung
• Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Kreditbereich (insbesondere Lombardkredite) ist von Vorteil
• Fundiertes technisches Wissen über den Umgang mit Lebensversicherungen (Wrapper, ULIPs) ist ein Plus
• Interesse am Funktionieren der Finanzmärkte und Finanzinstitute
• Gute IT-Kenntnisse (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) und hervorragende analytische Fähigkeiten
• Unabhängige, zuverlässige und teamorientierte Persönlichkeit
• Lösungsorientiert mit Problemlösung und Verhandlungsgeschick
• Starke analytische Fähigkeiten, entwickeltes Bewusstsein in rechtlichen, steuerlichen und Reputationsfragen
• Persönlichkeit mit guten organisatorischen und operativen Fähigkeiten und der Fähigkeit, unter hohem Druck zu arbeiten
• Integrität und Diskretion
• Ausgezeichnete Kommunikation und solide Präsentationsfähigkeiten
• Ausdauer und Beharrlichkeit
• Hervorragende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (schriftlich und gesprochen), zusätzliche Sprachen sind von Vorteil Wir freuen uns auf Ihre vollständige Bewerbung über unser Online-Bewerbungstool. descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Julius Baer, nous célébrons et valorisons les qualités individuelles que vous apportez, vous permettant d'avoir un impact, d'être entrepreneur, d'être autonomisé et de créer une valeur au-delà de la richesse. C'est l'avenir de la gestion des richesses. Responsable de tous les aspects de risque Lombard d'un portefeuille de clients bancaires privés nationaux et internationaux. Évaluer, analyser, structurer, approuver, mettre en œuvre et surveiller les demandes de crédit et les transactions lombardes. Fournir un service de conseil en crédit aux clients internes et travailler main dans la main avec les RM / première ligne de défense pour personnaliser les solutions appropriées aux clients finaux. Votre défi
• Analyse et évaluation de la sûreté et de l'exposition (par exemple dérivés) y compris détection des risques de concentration
• Évaluation de l'emprunteur, du fournisseur de garanties en ce qui concerne les risques structurels, juridiques, de conformité et de réputation
• Détermination de la cote de risque pour une facilité de crédit
• Préparation et approbation des limites de crédit au sein du pouvoir délégué d'approbation de crédit (selon la cote de risque et le montant)
• Application des valeurs de prêt spéciales et des conditions de marge au niveau du client
• Surveillance continue de l'exposition au crédit; règlement des déficits de garantie et des dépassements de marge, y compris l'émission d'appels de marge
• Examen régulier des limites approuvées
• Obligations administratives, p.ex. approbation de prêts à durée déterminée, paiement et libérations de titres et documents de crédit appropriés
• Députez les autres agents de crédit en leur absence
• Appuyer les gestionnaires de relations et les autres intervenants dans toutes les questions liées au crédit, établir des contacts réguliers et proactifs et offrir une formation continue en matière de crédit
• Contribution à des projets liés au crédit et amélioration des processus
• Travailler avec la loi pour rédiger des documents non normalisés relatifs aux opérations de crédit
• Préparation et tenue d'une séance de formation à l'intention des agents de crédit et des gestionnaires des relations VOTRE PROFIL
• Baccalauréat universitaire ou études terminées dans une université de sciences appliquées (économie, banque, finance, droit), ou études équivalentes ou expérience professionnelle
• Plusieurs années d'expérience professionnelle dans le secteur du crédit (en particulier le crédit Lombard) sont un avantage
• Des connaissances techniques solides concernant le traitement des polices d'assurance vie (wrappers, ULIP) sont un plus
• Intérêts dans le fonctionnement des marchés financiers et des institutions financières
• Bonnes compétences en TI (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) et excellentes compétences analytiques
• Personnalité indépendante, fiable et axée sur l'équipe
• Solution axée sur la résolution de problèmes et la négociation
• Fortes compétences analytiques, sensibilisation aux questions juridiques, fiscales et de réputation
• Personnalité avec de bonnes compétences organisationnelles et opérationnelles et capacité à travailler sous haute pression
• Sens d'intégrité et de discrétion
• Excellente communication et solides compétences de présentation
• Persévérance et persistance
• Excellente maîtrise de l'allemand et de l'anglais (écrit et parlé), toute autre langue est un avantage Nous sommes impatients de recevoir votre candidature complète par l'intermédiaire de notre outil d'application en ligne.
