jobs.title: Senior Specialist - Employee related Conflicts 80-100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

For our Employee Compliance Team within Central Compliance, we are looking for a Specialist, Employee Conflicts Management to join our team. The team is responsible for the Conduct Framework, monitoring and promoting effective governance and ensuring highest standards of Compliance across our operations.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Evolve the design, governance, and global implementation of the Employee Conflicts framework, ensuring alignment with evolving regulatory expectations, internal policies, and the Bank’s risk appetite

• Lead the design and operation of preventive controls for employee trading, Personal Account Transactions and conflict-of-interest frameworks, with accountability to Group Compliance and regulators

• Own and govern end-to-end processes including restricted lists, pre-clearance, and annual declarations, execution of controls driving consistency and audit readiness

• Champion process improvements through automation and technology partnerships to increase efficiency, coverage, and risk detection

• Act as escalation point for suspected breaches; lead investigations and coordinate disciplinary actions in collaboration with HR and Line Management

• Advise Senior Management on conduct risks, personal trading restrictions, and mitigation measures — delivering pragmatic, principles-based guidance aligned with business realities

YOUR PROFILE

• Either a university degree in law, business, finance, or a related field or substantial professional experience in the banking sector, particularly in areas such as trading or trade surveillance

• Minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in a financial services environment, preferably within private banking or wealth management, with a solid understanding of market conduct principles and regulatory expectations

• Proven expertise in transaction monitoring and/or employee compliance, covering policy interpretation, breach assessments, investigative procedures and disciplinary recommendations

• Demonstrated interest in and contribution to the optimisation, automation and digitalisation of compliance processes – particularly in areas such as transaction monitoring, pre-clearance workflows or employee disclosure initiatives.

• Solid product and service knowledge within private banking, enabling accurate assessment of employee transactions in the context of complex instruments, investment products and advisory activities

• Proficient in Microsoft Office; experience with compliance systems, Workday, or trade surveillance platforms is an asset

• Fluent in English (written and spoken); German language skills are a distinct advantage

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.

Chez Julius Baer, nous célébrons et valorisons les qualités individuelles que vous apportez, vous permettant d'avoir un impact, d'être entrepreneur, d'être autonomisé et de créer une valeur au-delà de la richesse. Laissez-les façonner ensemble l'avenir de la gestion des richesses. Pour notre équipe de conformité des employés au sein de la conformité centrale, nous cherchons un spécialiste, Gestion des conflits d'employés pour rejoindre notre équipe. L'équipe est responsable du cadre de conduite, de la surveillance et de la promotion d'une gouvernance efficace et de la garantie de normes de conformité les plus élevées dans l'ensemble de nos opérations. VOTRE DÉFIS
• Évoluer la conception, la gouvernance et la mise en oeuvre globale du cadre des conflits d'employés, en assurant l'alignement sur l'évolution des attentes réglementaires, des politiques internes et de l'appétit pour les risques de la Banque
• Diriger la conception et le fonctionnement de contrôles préventifs pour les cadres de négociation et de conflit d'intérêts des employés, avec responsabilité envers le Groupe Conformité et les régulateurs
• Propre et régir les processus de bout en bout, y compris les listes restreintes, l'approbation préalable et les déclarations annuelles, en favorisant la cohérence et l'état de préparation à l'audit
• Améliorer les processus champions grâce à des partenariats d'automatisation et de technologie pour accroître l'efficacité, la couverture et la détection des risques
• Agir comme point d'escalade pour les infractions présumées; diriger les enquêtes et coordonner les mesures disciplinaires en collaboration avec les RH et la gestion hiérarchique
• Conseiller la haute direction sur les risques de conduite, les restrictions commerciales personnelles et les mesures d'atténuation – fournir des directives pragmatiques et fondées sur des principes, en harmonie avec les réalités commerciales VOTRE PROFIL
• Diplôme universitaire en droit, en affaires, en finance ou dans un domaine connexe ou expérience professionnelle substantielle dans le secteur bancaire, en particulier dans des domaines tels que le commerce ou la surveillance commerciale
• Au moins 5 ans d'expérience pertinente dans un environnement de services financiers, de préférence dans le cadre de la banque privée ou de la gestion du patrimoine, avec une bonne compréhension des principes de conduite du marché et des attentes réglementaires
• Expertise éprouvée en matière de surveillance des transactions et/ou de conformité des employés, en ce qui concerne l'interprétation des politiques, les évaluations des infractions, les procédures d'enquête et les recommandations disciplinaires
• Intérêt manifesté et contribution à l'optimisation, à l'automatisation et à la numérisation des processus de conformité – en particulier dans des domaines tels que le suivi des transactions, les flux de travail avant approbation ou les initiatives de divulgation des employés.
• Connaissances solides en matière de produits et de services dans le secteur bancaire privé, permettant une évaluation précise des transactions des employés dans le contexte d'instruments complexes, de produits d'investissement et d'activités de conseil
• Compétence en Microsoft Office; expérience avec les systèmes de conformité, Workday, ou les plateformes de surveillance commerciale est un atout
• La maîtrise de l'anglais (écrite et parlée); les compétences linguistiques en allemand constituent un avantage distinct Nous sommes impatients de recevoir votre candidature complète à travers notre outil d'application en ligne. jobs.title: Senior Front Arena Developer 100% (f/m/d) - (Contract through our external payroll partner with immediate start for 12 months with possible extension)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

You will serve as a senior key person within our Front Arena team, responsible for implementing new structured products across the value chain from front office (Sales & Trading) to mid-office functions, ensuring accurate product representation and comprehensive lifecycle management.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Customise and extend the Front Arena platform to deliver new risk and valuation capabilities

• Design, develop, test, and deploy robust functionalities integrated across trading and back-office ecosystems

• Ensure end-to-end ownership of critical services, guaranteeing high availability and minimal production downtime

• Lead integration efforts between Front Arena and upstream/downstream systems (pricing, market data, risk engines)

• Perform root cause analysis and resolve complex production incidents efficiently

• Conduct thorough code reviews to uphold quality, security, and alignment with architectural standards

• Identify and implement system improvements to boost performance, scalability, and operational resilience

• Contribute to change and release management processes within an agile (SAFe) delivery framework

• Uphold ethical conduct, risk discipline, and compliance with all applicable regulatory requirements

YOUR PROFILE

• 10+ years of experience in Front Arena roles supporting trading, mid-office, valuation, and risk

• 8+ years of hands-on development with Front Arena AEL, ACM, and ADFL (all three required)

• Solid understanding of capital markets, particularly structured products and equity derivatives

• In-depth knowledge of financial product lifecycles (e.g., cash flows, corporate actions, expiries)

• Practical experience with Front Arena data models, workflows, and component interactions

• Experience working in agile teams using tools such as Git or Bitbucket

• Proven ability to communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with technical and business stakeholders

• Comfortable working under pressure, with strong organisational skills and ability to prioritise dynamically

• Willingness to work on public Swiss/Zurich holidays where foreign markets are open (e.g. Aug 1st)

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.

jobs.title: Assistant Relationship Manager 80 - 100% for Zurich Desk (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

The Assistant Relationship Manager (ARM) Private Banking supports one or more Relationship Manager(s) (RM)/ Team Head(s) (TH) in daily operations, administration, client care and relationship management. The ARM interacts with internal as well as external stakeholders, provides clients with relevant information and supports the RM in implementing customized solutions. Furthermore, the ARM acts as role model in bringing the best service quality to the RMs/TH in a fast, professional and friendly manner, always living the Julius Baer values (Care, Passion and Excellence) and thus helping the team to manage and grow its current client base. He/she channels client feedback to the relevant individuals/departments within the Bank to foster continuous improvement and fast adaptation of processes. This position is the backbone of Client Relationship Management.

YOUR CHALLENGE
Client Administration & Management

• Supports RMs/TH in client interaction and all related tasks (systems, processes, files, documents etc.) with high-quality, precision and timely responsiveness

• Customizes client requests (reporting, statistics, mailings etc.)

• Manages the RM/TH’s calendar, prepares client meetings, organizes business trips, completes the post processing of client calls, client meetings or business trips for RMs/TH

• Compiles presentations, supports in drafting investment  proposals and in marketing activities if needed (client reception, meetings, business trips, events etc.)

• Ensures coverage in case of own absences

Business Management

• Regularly collects and exchanges relevant information necessary for the job

• Organises himself/herself in an efficient and compliant manner and ensures timely and appropriate information of the superior

• Conducts reviews, plans ahead and documents his/her work at all times

• Supports RM/TH in implementation of projects and initiatives

• Provides professional input proposals for improvements based on experience, incident occurrence or observation

• Manages the expense claim process for RMs/TH

Risk Management & Controls

• Actively helps managing risk (support first line of defence), i.e. in client documentation, by raising concerns, following up on issues and by escalating when in doubt

• Ensures adherence to local regulations and compliance with internal policies and standards (e.g. new account openings, payment instructions, reviewing client phone calls or signing off at own level of competence etc.) in collaboration with the respective RMs and TH

• Ensures timely clearance of pending items and escalated deficiencies

• Ensures appropriate ethical and compliant behaviour in his/her area of responsibility

• Ensures correct, meaningful and understandable documentation of client interaction/client orders in the corresponding tool (e.g. CRM, DiAS)

YOUR PROFILE
Personal & Social Skills

• Team player

• Excellent situational adaptability (able to work with RMs and clients from diverse backgrounds)

• Friendly, trustworthy and discreet personality with high level of risk awareness

• Highly service oriented and passionate about client servicing

• Always communicates in a friendly, competent and professional manner

• Open, approachable an displays genuine interest in people and in improving processes

• Systematic, precise and diligent working style and the ability to perform under pressure

• Personal integrity and ethical behaviour

Professional Skills

• Sound affinity with the geographic market(s) covered, i.e. familiar with the legal and regulatory environment as well as cultural awareness

• Good understanding of relevant products and services in Private Banking

• Basic knowledge of global financial markets and current developments in the industry

Education and Experience

• Relevant educational (bank apprenticeship or equivalent) and 3 - 5 years of professional experience in a similar role in the banking industry

• Fluency in German and English (verbal and written)

• Proven track record in servicing banking clients with complex needs (onboarding of new, maintaining and extending current relationships)

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Informazioni su Julius Baer

In Julius Baer, celebriamo e valorizziamo le qualità individuali che apporti, consentendoti di avere un impatto, di essere imprenditoriale, di essere responsabilizzato e di creare valore oltre la ricchezza. Modelliamo insieme il futuro della gestione patrimoniale.

Il Ruolo

L'Assistant Relationship Manager (ARM) Private Banking supporta uno o più Relationship Manager(RM)/ Team Head(TH) nelle operazioni quotidiane, nell'amministrazione, nella cura del cliente e nella gestione delle relazioni. L'ARM interagisce con gli stakeholder interni ed esterni, fornisce ai clienti informazioni pertinenti e supporta il RM nell'implementazione di soluzioni personalizzate. Inoltre, il BRACCIO funge da modello per portare la migliore qualità del servizio al RMs/TH in modo rapido, professionale e amichevole, vivendo sempre i valori Julius Baer (Cura, Passione ed Eccellenza) e aiutando così il team a gestire e far crescere la sua attuale base di clienti. Canalizza il feedback dei clienti agli individui/dipartimenti rilevanti all'interno della Banca per favorire il miglioramento continuo e il rapido adattamento dei processi. Questa posizione è la spina dorsale del Customer Relationship Management.

Responsabilità

Amministrazione e gestione dei clienti

- Supporta RMs/TH nell'interazione con il cliente e tutte le attività correlate (sistemi, processi, file, documenti, ecc.) con alta qualità, precisione e tempestività
- Personalizza le richieste dei clienti (reportistica, statistiche, mailing ecc.)
- Gestisce il calendario del RM/TH, prepara gli incontri con i clienti, organizza i viaggi di lavoro,

Wir feiern und schätzen bei Julius Baer die individuellen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen, damit Sie einflussreich sein, unternehmerisch sein, gestärkt werden und Wert jenseits des Reichtums schaffen können. Lassen Sie uns gemeinsam die Zukunft des Vermögensmanagements gestalten.

Die Rolle

Der Assistant Relationship Manager (ARM) Private Banking unterstützt einen oder mehrere Relationship Manager (RM)/ Team Head(s) (TH) im täglichen Betrieb, in der Verwaltung, im Kundenbetreuungs- und im Beziehungsmanagement. Das ARM interagiert mit internen und externen Stakeholdern, bietet Kunden relevante Informationen und unterstützt die RM bei der Umsetzung maßgeschneiderter Lösungen.

Darüber hinaus fungiert die ARM als Vorbild, um die RMs/TH schnell, professionell und freundlich in die beste Servicequalität zu bringen, immer die Julius Baer-Werte (Care, Passion und Excellence) zu leben und damit dem Team zu helfen, seine aktuelle Kundenbasis zu verwalten und zu erweitern. Er/sie leitet Kundenfeedback an die relevanten Personen/Abteilungen innerhalb der Bank, um eine kontinuierliche Verbesserung und schnelle Anpassung der Prozesse zu fördern.

Zuständigkeiten

Client-Verwaltung & Management

- Unterstützt RMs/TH in der Client-Interaktion und alle damit verbundenen Aufgaben (Systeme, Prozesse, Dateien, Dokumente etc.) mit hoher Qualität, Präzision und zeitnaher Reaktion - Kundenwünsche (Reporting, Statistiken, Mailings etc.) anpassen - verwaltet den RM/TH Kalender, bereitet Kundentreffen vor, organisiert Geschäftsreisen, vervollständigt die Nachbearbeitung von Kundenanrufen, Kundentreffen oder Geschäftsreisen für RM/TH - Kompiliert Präsentationen, unterstützt bei der Erstellung von Anlagevorschlägen und bei Marketingaktivitäten, falls erforderlich (Kundenempfang, Meetings, Geschäftsreisen, Events etc.) - sorgt für Abdeckung im Falle von

Eigenentlassungen

Unternehmensführung

- Regelmäßig sammelt und austauscht die für die Arbeit notwendigen relevanten Informationen - organisiert sich in effizienter und konformer Weise und gewährleistet rechtzeitige und angemessene Informationen des Vorgesetzten - führt Überprüfungen, Pläne voraus und dokumentiert seine Arbeit zu allen Zeiten - unterstützt RM/TH bei der Durchführung von Projekten und Initiativen - Bietet professionelle Vorschläge für Verbesserungen auf der Grundlage von Erfahrung, Zwischenfall oder Beobachtung - verwaltet die Kosten-Antrag Prozess für RMs / TH

Risikomanagement & Kontrollen

- Aktiv hilft, Risiken zu bewältigen (unterstützen Sie die erste Verteidigungslinie), d.h. in der Kundendokumentation, indem Sie Bedenken aufwerfen, Fragen nachgehen und eskalieren, wenn im Zweifelsfall - Gewährleistung der Einhaltung lokaler Vorschriften und der Einhaltung interner Richtlinien und Standards (z.B.

neue Kontoeröffnungen, Zahlungsanweisungen, Überprüfung von Kundentelefonanrufen oder Abmeldung auf eigener Kompetenzebene etc.) in Zusammenarbeit mit den jeweiligen RMs und TH - Gewährleistung einer rechtzeitigen Freigabe anstehender Gegenstände und eskalierter Mängel - Gewährleistung eines angemessenen ethischen und konformen Verhaltens in seinem Verantwortungsbereich - Gewährleistung einer korrekten, sinnvollen und verständlichen Dokumentation der Kundeninteraktion/Kundenaufträge im entsprechenden Tool (z.B. CRM, DiAS)

Anforderungen

Persönliche und soziale Fähigkeiten

- Teamplayer - Exzellente Situationsanpassungsfähigkeit (fähig für die Arbeit mit RMs und Kunden aus verschiedenen Hintergründen) - Freundliche, vertrauenswürdige und diskrete Persönlichkeit mit hohem Risikobewusstsein - Hochserviceorientiert und leidenschaftlich über die Kundenbetreuung - Immer freundlich, kompetent und professionell kommunizieren - Offen, zugänglich zeigt echtes Interesse an Menschen und an der Verbesserung der Prozesse - Systematisch, präzise und fleißig Arbeitsstil und die Fähigkeit, unter Druck zu führen - Persönliche Integrität und ethisches Verhalten

Berufsqualifikationen

- Solide Affinität zu den/den abgedeckten geografischen Märkten, d.h. Kenntnis des rechtlichen und regulatorischen Umfelds sowie des kulturellen Bewusstseins - Gutes Verständnis relevanter Produkte und Dienstleistungen im Private Banking - Grundkenntnisse über globale Finanzmärkte und aktuelle Entwicklungen in der Branche

Bildung und Erfahrung

- Relevante Ausbildung (Banklehre oder gleichwertige Ausbildung) und 3 - 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in ähnlicher Rolle im Bankensektor - Fluency in Deutsch und Englisch (verbal und schriftlich) - Bewährte Erfolgsbilanz bei der Betreuung von Bankkunden mit komplexen Bedürfnissen (Onboarding neuer, Pflege und Ausbau aktueller Beziehungen)

À propos de Julius Baer

Chez Julius Baer, nous célébrons et apprécions les qualités individuelles que vous apportez, vous permettant d'être impacté, d'être entrepreneur, d'être autonomisé et de créer une valeur au-delà de la richesse.

Le rôle

Le gestionnaire adjoint des relations (ARM) Private Banking soutient un ou plusieurs gestionnaires des relations (GR)/chef(s) d'équipe (TH) dans les opérations quotidiennes, l'administration, les soins aux clients et la gestion des relations.

En outre, l'ARM sert de modèle pour apporter la meilleure qualité de service aux RM/TH de façon rapide, professionnelle et amicale, en vivant toujours les valeurs Julius Baer (Care, Passion et Excellence) et en aidant ainsi l'équipe à gérer et à développer sa clientèle actuelle. Il canalise les commentaires des clients aux personnes/ministères concernés de la Banque pour favoriser l'amélioration continue et l'adaptation rapide des processus.

Responsabilités

Administration et gestion des clients

- Supporte les RM/TH dans l'interaction client et toutes les tâches connexes (systèmes, processus, dossiers, documents, etc.) avec une grande qualité, précision et rapidité de réponse - Personnalise les demandes des clients (rapports, statistiques, envois postaux, etc.) - Gère le calendrier des RM/TH, prépare les réunions des clients, organise les voyages d'affaires, complète le traitement post-traitement des appels des clients, des réunions des clients ou des voyages d'affaires pour les RM/TH - Compile les présentations, aide à la rédaction des propositions d'investissement et aux activités de marketing au besoin (accueil des clients, réunions, voyages d'affaires, événements, etc.) - Assure la couverture en cas de

absences personnelles

Gestion des affaires

- Collecte et échange régulièrement les renseignements pertinents nécessaires au travail - Organise lui-même de façon efficiente et conforme et assure l'information opportune et appropriée du supérieur - Effectue des examens, des plans à l'avance et documente son travail en tout temps - Appuie la RM/S dans la mise en oeuvre des projets et des initiatives - Fournit des propositions de commentaires professionnels pour les améliorations fondées sur l'expérience, l'incident ou l'observation - Gère le processus de demande de remboursement des dépenses pour les RM/S

Gestion et contrôles des risques

- Aide activement à la gestion des risques (appui à la première ligne de défense), c'est-à-dire dans la documentation des clients, en soulevant des préoccupations, en assurant le suivi des questions et en augmentant en cas de doute - Assurer le respect des règlements locaux et le respect des politiques et normes internes (par exemple,

nouvelles ouvertures de compte, instructions de paiement, examen des appels téléphoniques du client ou signature à son propre niveau de compétence, etc.) en collaboration avec les RM et TH respectifs - S'assure que les éléments en attente sont approuvés en temps opportun et que les lacunes se sont aggravées - S'assure que le comportement éthique et conforme approprié dans son domaine de responsabilité - S'assure que la documentation correcte, significative et compréhensible des interactions avec le client/commandes du client dans l'outil correspondant (p. ex. CRM, DiAS)

Besoins

Compétences personnelles et sociales

- Joueur d'équipe - Excellente capacité d'adaptation situationnelle (possible de travailler avec des RM et des clients de divers horizons) - Personnalité amicale, fiable et discrète avec un haut niveau de sensibilisation aux risques - Très orienté vers le service et passionné par le service client - Communication toujours amicale, compétente et professionnelle - Ouverte, accessible et présentant un intérêt réel pour les personnes et l'amélioration des processus - Style de travail systématique, précis et diligent et capacité à se comporter sous pression - Intégrité personnelle et comportement éthique

Compétences professionnelles

- Bonne affinité avec le ou les marchés géographiques couverts, c'est-à-dire connaissance de l'environnement juridique et réglementaire ainsi que de la sensibilisation culturelle - Bonne compréhension des produits et services pertinents dans le secteur des banques privées - Connaissance de base des marchés financiers mondiaux et de l'évolution actuelle de l'industrie

Éducation et expérience

- Enseignement (apprentissage bancaire ou équivalent) et 3 à 5 ans d'expérience professionnelle dans un rôle similaire dans le secteur bancaire - Connaissance de l'allemand et de l'anglais (verbal et écrit) - Expérience dans le service de clients bancaires ayant des besoins complexes (en embarquant de nouveaux, en maintenant et en élargissant les relations actuelles)

Demande

jobs.title: Intermediate Security Engineer Logging SIEM Data Pipelines 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

We are seeking an intermediate security data engineer with deep expertise in SIEM platforms, telemetry pipelines, and security operations tooling to join our global team in Zurich. As the ideal candidate, you combine strong security foundations with a data engineering mindset and are comfortable architecting and operating high-volume, enterprise-scale logging and analytics infrastructure in a regulated financial services environment. You are proactive, technically curious, and thrive in both independent and collaborative work settings.

Your primary responsibilities will involve designing, operating, and evolving our centralised logging and SIEM platforms, building and maintaining data pipelines for intelligent log routing and enrichment, driving SOAR automation, and contributing to the expansion of our security data ecosystem — including early-stage observability use cases. You will work closely with security operations, infrastructure, and application teams to ensure reliable, high-quality data flows from source to insight.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• As part of a dedicated team, architect, operate, and continuously improve the Bank’s centralised logging and SIEM platforms, ensuring high availability, performance, and scalability for enterprise-grade data volumes

• Design, build, and maintain telemetry and data pipelines, enabling routing, enrichment, filtering, and multi-destination delivery of security and operational log data while maintaining cost-efficiency

• Drive the development and operationalisation of SOAR workflows to accelerate incident response, automate repetitive tasks, and improve security operations efficiency

• Develop and maintain service monitoring, detection content, reports, and dashboards that provide actionable security intelligence to stakeholders across the organisation

• Collaborate with security operations, IT infrastructure, and application teams to integrate new data sources, ensure data quality, and expand platform coverage — including early-stage contributions to observability use cases

• Maintain technical documentation including architecture descriptions, runbooks, data flow diagrams, and security parameterisations

• Coordinate the mitigation or resolution of security-relevant platform incidents with internal security stakeholders and external vendors

• Contribute to the development of architecture, standards, and best practices for the centralised logging and telemetry ecosystem

• Provide 2nd and 3rd level engineering support, including participation in an on-call rotation ​

YOUR PROFILE

• Comfortable working across multiple application, infrastructure, and business teams

• Willingness and curiosity to learn new technologies and approaches in a rapidly evolving landscape Highly proactive, solution-oriented, and results-driven with strong abstract and conceptual thinking skills

• Structured and goal-oriented approach to work, with the ability to independently assess, prioritise, and resolve complex tasks and requests

• Creative problem solver who challenges the status quo and proposes innovative solutions to existing issues

• Strong communicator who can translate technical complexity into clear guidance for platform users, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams

• Contribute to the development of architecture, concepts, and processes related to the Centralised Logging and Telemetry ecosystem

• University degree or higher technical education (university of applied sciences, federal diploma) in Computer Science, Information Security, or related discipline — or equivalent practical experience

• Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience engineering and administering enterprise SIEM platforms, with experience developing detection content, correlation searches, dashboards, and CIM-normalised data models

• Strong experience designing and operating data pipelines and log routing infrastructure, ideally with Cribl Stream or comparable telemetry pipeline tools

• Practical scripting and automation skills with one or more of: Python, Bash/Shell, JavaScript

• Working experience with GIT, SQL, REST APIs, and regular expressions

• Solid understanding of SOAR platforms and security operations automation

• Experience with configuration management tools such as Ansible is an advantage

• Fluent written and spoken English (B2/C1)

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.

Come candidato ideale, si combinano solide fondazioni di sicurezza con una mentalità di ingegneria dei dati e sono confortevoli architettura e funzionamento di alta volume, di imprese di registrazione e di infrastrutture di analisi in un ambiente di servizi finanziari regolamentati. Siete proattivi, tecnicamente curioso, e prosperare in ambienti di lavoro indipendenti e collaborativi. Responsabilità - Nell'ambito di un team dedicato, architetto, opera e migliora continuamente le piattaforme di registrazione centralizzata e SIEM, garantendo elevata disponibilità, performance e possibilità di carburazione per volumi di dati di livello aziendale - Progettazione, costruzione e manutenzione di telemetrie e condotte di dati, consentendo l'instradamento, l'arricchimento, il filtraggio e la distribuzione multidestinata di dati di sicurezza e log operativi mantenendo al contempo l'efficienza in termini di costi - Guidare lo sviluppo e l'operatività dei flussi di lavoro SOAR per accelerare la risposta agli incidenti, automatizzare le attività ripetitive e migliorare le operazioni di sicurezza efficienza - Sviluppare e mantenere il monitoraggio dei servizi, i contenuti di rilevamento, i report e i dashboard che forniscono informazioni di sicurezza utilizzabili agli stakeholder in tutta l'organizzazione - Collaborare con operazioni di sicurezza, infrastruttura IT e squadre di applicazioni per integrare nuove fonti di dati, garantire la qualità dei dati e ampliare la copertura della piattaforma. incidenti relativi alla sicurezza con le parti interessate della sicurezza interna e i fornitori esterni - Contribuire allo sviluppo di architettura, standard e migliori pratiche per l'ecosistema centralizzato di registrazione e telemetria - Fornire supporto ingegneristico di secondo e terzo livello, compresa la partecipazione a una rotazione di chiamata
• Requisiti - Lavoro comodo attraverso applicazioni multiple, infrastrutture e team di business - Volontà e curiosità per imparare nuove tecnologie e approcci in un paesaggio in rapida evoluzione - Altamente proattivo, orientato alla soluzione e basato sui risultati con forte capacità di pensiero astratto e concettuale - approccio strutturato e orientato agli obiettivi al lavoro, con la capacità di valutare, dare priorità e risolvere in modo indipendente compiti e richieste complessi - risolutore di problemi creativi che sfida lo status quo e propone soluzioni innovative alle questioni esistenti - forte comunicatore che può tradurre la complessità tecnica in una guida chiara per gli utenti delle piattaforme, le parti interessate, e gruppi interfunzionali - laurea universitaria o istruzione tecnica superiore (università di scienze applicate, diploma federale) in informatica, sicurezza dell'informazione, o disciplina correlata. o esperienza pratica equivalente - Minimo 5 anni di esperienza pratica ingegneristica e gestione delle piattaforme SIEM aziendali, con esperienza nello sviluppo di contenuti di rilevamento, ricerche di correlazione, dashboard e modelli di dati normalizzati CIM - Forte esperienza nella progettazione e gestione di condotte dati e infrastruttura di routing di log, idealmente con Cribl Stream o strumenti di pipeline telemetrali comparabili - Capacità pratiche di scripting e automazione con una o più delle seguenti: Python, Bash/Shell, JavaScript - Esperienza di lavoro con GIT, SQL, REST API ed espressioni regolari - Solida comprensione di SOAR piattaforme e automazione delle operazioni di sicurezza - L'esperienza con strumenti di gestione della configurazione come Ansible è un vantaggio - Fluente scritto e parlato inglese (B2/C1) Contatto Siamo lieti di ricevere la vostra applicazione di lavoro completo attraverso il nostro strumento di applicazione online. Conception, construction et entretien de télémétrie et de pipelines de données, permettant l'acheminement, l'enrichissement, le filtrage et la livraison multidestination de données de sécurité et de journal opérationnel tout en maintenant un rapport coût-efficacité - Conduire le développement et la mise en œuvre de flux de travail SOAR pour accélérer la réponse aux incidents, automatiser les tâches répétitives et améliorer les opérations de sécurité - Élaborer et maintenir des services de surveillance, de détection, de rapports et de tableaux de bord qui fournissent des renseignements de sécurité exploitables aux parties prenantes de l'organisation - Collaborer avec les opérations de sécurité, l'infrastructure informatique et les équipes d'application pour intégrer de nouvelles sources de données, assurer la qualité des données et élargir la couverture des plates-formes - y compris les contributions en début de phase aux cas d'utilisation de la observabilité - Maintenir la documentation technique, y compris les descriptions d'architecture, les runbooks, les diagrammes de flux de données et les paramétrisations de sécurité - Coordonner l'atténuation ou la résolution des incidents liés à la sécurité avec les intervenants internes et les fournisseurs externes - Contribuer au développement de l'architecture, des normes et des meilleures pratiques pour l'écosystème centralisé de l'exploitation forestière et de la télémétrie - Fournir un soutien technique de deuxième et troisième niveaux, y compris la participation à une rotation sur appel. capacité de réflexion abstraite et conceptuelle - Approche structurée et axée sur les objectifs, avec la capacité d'évaluer de façon indépendante, de prioriser et de résoudre des tâches et des demandes complexes - Résolveur de problèmes créatif qui conteste le statu quo et propose des solutions novatrices aux problèmes existants - Un conciliateur fort qui peut traduire la complexité technique en orientations claires pour les utilisateurs de la plateforme, les intervenants et les équipes interfonctionnelles - Diplôme universitaire ou supérieur de l'enseignement technique (université des sciences appliquées, diplôme fédéral) en informatique, sécurité de l'information ou discipline connexe — ou expérience pratique équivalente - 5 ans minimum d'expérience pratique en ingénierie et en administration des plateformes SIEM d'entreprise, avec une expérience de développement de contenu de détection, de recherche de corrélation, de tableaux de bord et de modèles de données normalisés CIM - Forte expérience de conception et d'exploitation des pipelines de données et de l'infrastructure de routage des journaux, idéalement avec Cribl Stream ou des outils de pipeline de télémétrie comparables - Compétences pratiques en script et en automatisation avec un ou plusieurs des éléments suivants : Python, Bash/Shell, JavaScript - Expérience de travail avec GIT, SQL, REST APIs et expressions régulières - jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Frontend Engineer Frontend Developer to join our dynamic team at a leading financial institution in Zurich, Switzerland.

In this role, you will play a key part in the frontend migration of mission critical financial platforms, driving technical excellence.

You bring deep expertise in JavaScript/TypeScript and React, combined with strong engineering judgment, a passion for high quality user experiences, and a solid understanding of enterprise scale systems in regulated environments.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Take ownership of complex frontend solutions, ensuring scalability, performance, security, and long‑term maintainability

• Partner closely with UX/UI designers and business stakeholders to translate complex requirements into intuitive, high‑quality user experiences

• Deliver high‑quality, production‑grade React and TypeScript code for complex financial applications

• Address advanced frontend challenges such as state management, performance optimization, and integration with distributed backend systems

• Proactively refactor and modernize existing codebases where required

• Support troubleshooting and root‑cause analysis in both development and production environments

• Contribute actively in an agile, fast‑paced, and highly collaborative environment

YOUR PROFILE

• Extensive, hands‑on experience in JavaScript and TypeScript, with a strong focus on React at enterprise scale

• Deep understanding of modern frontend ecosystems, tools, and frameworks (React, Node.js, build tooling)

• Proven experience working with design systems and large, shared component libraries

• Solid understanding of Unix/Linux environments and bash scripting

• Experience in the financial services or other highly regulated industries is a plus

• Experience with cloud platforms, preferably Microsoft Azure

• Knowledge of microservices architecture and containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes)

• Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices

• Exposure to API security, OAuth2, and related standards

• Excellent analytical, decision‑making, and problem‑solving skills

• Strong communication skills, a proactive mindset, and the ability to influence technical direction

• Proven ability to thrive in agile, cross‑functional teams

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.

jobs.title: Application Integration Engineer 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

The Application Integration Engineer is responsible for the development, implementation, and operational support of FIX integration solutions and Order Trade Flows on the company’s Financial Messaging Infrastructure (BCOM). The role includes project participation, customer onboarding, monitoring and automation initiatives (meshIQ), and collaboration with both internal and external stakeholders.

YOUR CHALLENGE
Role Responsibilities:

FIX & Messaging Integration

• Develop, configure, and maintain FIX integrations using ITIVI APPIA FIX, IBM MQ, and IBM ACE

• Configure FIX sessions, protocol parameters, and connectivity for clients, brokers, and exchanges

• Develop and maintain message flows within the existing middleware architecture

• Design, coordinate, and execute FIX certification tests for onboarding clients and exchanges

Engineering & Project Support

• Support project requests from the Markets environment (Front Office, Trading, Brokerage)

• Analyze new client-specific requirements and design corresponding integration solutions

• Perform detailed root‑cause analysis in the event of production incidents

• Provide technical expertise during the client onboarding process

Operations & On‑Call Duty

• Ensure stable and continuous operation of the FIX and MQ messaging landscape

• Contribute to monitoring and automation initiatives using meshIQ products

• Participate in the team’s rotating 24/7 on‑call service

YOUR PROFILE
Education:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science (university or university of applied sciences), or equivalent proven technical expertise

Technical Skills:

• 5+ years of hands‑on experience with the FIX protocol, including deep knowledge of Order/Trade Flows, FIX-Engine and Frameworks

• Solid Linux proficiency

• Programming skills in at least one language: ESQL, Bash, Perl, Java

• Strong experience with MQ client/broker connectivity and related industry standards

• Proven expertise in developing integration solutions in a banking environment using: IBM MQ, IBM Integration Bus (IIB), IBM ACE

• Experience with client and exchange connectivity in financial markets

• Good understanding of key financial products (Equities, FX, Derivatives)

• Knowledge of SWIFT (ISO20022 / MT / MX) is considered an advantage

Soft Skills:

• Strong communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with internal and external stakeholders

• Analytical mindset with structured problem‑solving capabilities

• Ability to work independently in both project environments and 24/7 operational settings

• Service‑oriented attitude and readiness to take ownership of technical issues

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.
Is this not quite what you are looking for? Set up a job alert by creating a candidate account here.

jobs.title: Global Financial Accounting – Business Analyst 100%
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

We are seeking an experienced Business Analyst to spearhead the design, customization, and optimization of our core financial accounting processes. You will translate complex business requirements into scalable, compliant SAP solutions and ensure seamless integration with controlling (CO) and other core modules (MM, SD, FICO, RE-FX, AP, AR, ECCS) as well as several subledger own-developments.
You will support global operations over 35 entities as well as work on global projects.

YOUR CHALLENGE
Role objectives:

• Serve as the key interface between Finance Business, IT teams and other stakeholders

• Analyse and document business requirements related to SAP Finance processes

• Support the implementation and optimization of SAP solutions

• Drive process improvements and standardization across Finance functions

• Contribute to SAP S/4HANA transformation and related future initiatives

Responsibilities:

• Gather, analyze and document business and functional requirements

• Translate business needs into SAP finance solution designs and specifications

• Conduct process and gap analyses and recommend improvements

• Coordinate and support testing activities including defect resolution

• Collaborate with business stakeholders, SAP consultants and project teams throughout project lifecycles

Competencies:

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving capabilities

• Ability to bridge business requirements and technical solutions

• Strong stakeholder management and proven communication skills with the ability to decompose complex solutions into compelling storylines

• Strong understanding of key business processes related to accounting, data flows, interfaces and related configuration within SAP

• Proactive, collaborative and result-oriented mindset

YOUR PROFILE

• Education: Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Information Technology or related fields

• Experience: Minimum 3 years of experience as a Business Analyst or SAP Finance Consultant. Experience in a banking environment is an advantage

• Platform: Good knowledge of SAP R/3 or SAP S/4HANA Finance processes. SAP Finance certification is considered an advantage

• Key Skills: Deep understanding of accounting principles, record-to-report (R2R) processes, and complex financial reporting

• Soft Skills: Fluent in English and/or German (written and spoken), strong communication skills, high motivation and drive to get things done, hands-on mentality and entrepreneurial spirit, high flexibility

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.

jobs.title: Execution Management Support Specialist - Trading / Saas & Vendors 100% (f/m/d) - (Contract through our external payroll partner with immediate start for 12 months with possible extension)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

We are looking for a technically strong Execution Management Support Specialist to support our buy side trading desks. The role focuses on ensuring smooth order routing, execution workflow stability, and rapid issue resolution across multiple electronic trading platforms.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Provide real‑time support for order routing, execution issues, and trade flow across equity, fixed income, structured products, crypto and multi‑asset desks

• Troubleshoot technical problems in EMS/OMS systems including TradeSmart, MarketAxess, TSOX, Bloomberg, and TradeWeb

• Analyse FIX messages, trace order paths, and identify root‑cause issues

• Work with traders, technology teams, and external vendors to maintain stable trading connectivity

• Support basic scripting or programming tasks to automate routing, implement checks and analyse logs

YOUR PROFILE

• Bachelor’s degree or higher in computer science, Information Technology, or any related field

• Financial engineering or programming (nice to have)

• Experience in trading support or electronic execution workflows

• Strong understanding of FIX protocol and order routing mechanics

• Solid understanding of Temenos T24 is a big plus (architecture and business workflows)

• Basic programming or scripting skills (e.g., Python, SQL, Java, Bash)

• Familiarity with electronic trading platforms: TradeSmart, MarketAxess, TSOX, Bloomberg EMSX/TOMS, TradeWeb

• Good understanding of market microstructure and electronic execution workflows

• Detail-oriented, fast-thinking, and comfortable supporting traders in time-critical environments

• FIX certification and CFA or similar would be a nice-to-have

• Fluent in English (verbal and written); German would be a nice-to-have

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

How would you use data to create the bank of the future?

As Data Management Specialist, you build the foundation for the strategic transformation at Julius Baer, driving data-centricity. You will join the team for a fixed period of time to cover a maternity leave.

You are at the heart of the bank’s transformation and bring together colleagues from all units, be it Front, IT or Compliance to achieve excellence.

Are you up for the challenge? This is your opportunity to be a driver for change and take your career to the next level.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Take-up the challenge to drive the topic during the maternity period until end of March 27

• Co-design and monitor data management standards and processes

• Co-design and monitor bank-wide data product standards and processes

• Work closely with representatives from the front office business units and supporting business functions like legal, compliance, finance, operations Enterprise Architecture and IT

• Enable and co-create with business data models according to company, industry and architectural standards

YOUR PROFILE

• Earned a university degree or equivalent, preferably in science, business informatics, banking or finance

• Several years of experience in metadata management, data dictionary, information architecture, data lineage, reference data and business glossary

• Experience in the financial industry, banking industry

• Acquainted working with data modeling and data management tools in general (data dictionary, data lineage, etc.)

• Can do attitude

• Strong at collaborating and influencing, building an effective stakeholder network across divisions and regions

• Comfortable in challenging the status quo and manage escalations on every level

• Great teammate, who is fun to work with and drives the change naturally

jobs.title: Third-Party Risk Manager – CRO Non-Financial Risk 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

We are seeking a risk professional to support our Third-Party Risk Management unit. The Third Party Risk Management unit as second line of defence function maintains and develops the Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) framework, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and alignment with the Risk Management Framework. This position reports to the Head of TPRM, who  is the Global Policy Owner (GPO) of third party risk-related policies as well as the Risk Type Owner (RTO) of the risk type “Third Party Management Risk (incl. intragroup services)”.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Support the end-to-end implementation and global rollout of the Group’s third-party risk management framework in line with the defined roadmap

• Define business use cases and functional requirements for IT implementations and AI-enabled solutions; design and execute test procedures for infrastructure upgrades and system migrations

• Assist the RTO in portfolio risk assessments, operational case reviews, control monitoring, and international regulatory reporting; drive timely follow-up on action items, incidents, and escalation flags

• Compile, validate, and prepare quantitative and qualitative reporting packages for committees and key stakeholders

• Maintain and update central documentation (Wiki pages, procedures, templates, intranet), develop training materials, and deliver training sessions to ensure consistent adoption across locations

• Coordinate stakeholder meetings, track progress on framework implementation, and conduct quality checks on resolution strategies and exit plans globally

YOUR PROFILE

• University degree or equivalent (preferably in economics / law)

• Broad and practical experience in non-financial risk management, with a minimum of 3-5 years within management consulting or accounting / law firm

• Sound knowledge of outsourcing/third party risk regulations and industry best practices

• Familiarity with ServiceNow for process automation, ticketing, and IT service management workflows.

• Able to formulate clear business requirements for IT implementations and AI use cases within  the TPRM related applications, ensuring alignment with business objectives and regulatory requirements .

• Strong “hands on” analytical and project delivery capabilities, with the ability to turn concepts into practical, implementable solutions

• Excellent PowerPoint and presentation skills

• Proven ability to rapidly learn new concepts and ideas, and integrate and assimilate information of various levels of complexity and relationships across broad, multifunctional content areas

• Self-motivated, team-oriented and hands-on personality

• Strong communication, presentation and interpersonal skills

• Able to work under pressure and react positively in the face of change

• Fluency in German and English, any further language is an advantage

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.
Is this not quite what you are looking for? Set up a job alert by creating a candidate account here.

VOTRE DÉFIS
• Soutenir la mise en œuvre de bout en bout et le déploiement global du cadre de gestion des risques des tiers du Groupe conformément à la feuille de route définie
• Définir des cas d'utilisation commerciale et des exigences fonctionnelles pour les implémentations informatiques et les solutions adaptées à l'IA; concevoir et exécuter des procédures d'essai pour les mises à niveau de l'infrastructure et les migrations de systèmes
• Aider l'OTR à évaluer les risques du portefeuille, à examiner les cas opérationnels, à surveiller le contrôle et à établir des rapports réglementaires internationaux; assurer un suivi en temps opportun des mesures à prendre, des incidents et des drapeaux d'escalade
• Compiler, valider et préparer des ensembles de rapports quantitatifs et qualitatifs pour les comités et les principaux intervenants
• Tenir à jour et mettre à jour la documentation centrale (pages Web, procédures, modèles, intranet), élaborer du matériel de formation et offrir des séances de formation pour assurer une adoption uniforme dans tous les lieux d ' affectation
• Coordonner les réunions des parties prenantes, suivre les progrès accomplis dans la mise en œuvre du cadre et effectuer des vérifications de la qualité des stratégies de résolution et des plans de sortie à l ' échelle mondiale VOTRE PROFIL
• Diplôme universitaire ou équivalent (de préférence en économie / droit)
• Expérience étendue et pratique en gestion des risques non financiers, avec un minimum de 3 à 5 ans au sein du cabinet de conseil en gestion ou en comptabilité / droit
• Bonne connaissance de la réglementation en matière d ' externalisation/de risques de tiers et des meilleures pratiques de l ' industrie
• Familiarité avec ServiceNow pour l'automatisation des processus, la billetterie et les workflows de gestion des services informatiques.
• Capacité de formuler des exigences opérationnelles claires pour les mises en œuvre de TI et les cas d'utilisation d'IA dans les applications liées au GRPT, en assurant l'alignement avec les objectifs opérationnels et les exigences réglementaires .
• Fortes capacités d'analyse et de réalisation de projets, avec la capacité de transformer les concepts en solutions pratiques et réalisables
• Excellente compétence PowerPoint et présentation
• Capacité éprouvée d'apprendre rapidement de nouveaux concepts et idées, et d'intégrer et d'assimiler des informations de divers niveaux de complexité et de relations dans des domaines de contenu vastes et multifonctionnels
• Personnalité automotivée, orientée vers l'équipe et pratique
• Bonne communication, présentation et aptitudes interpersonnelles

jobs.title: T24 Application Support / Operation Engineer 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

System engineering is an interdisciplinary field of system and platform engineering, complemented with business management and operational responsibility, that centres around on how to design and manage complex systems and technology platforms over their life cycles. The system engineer can assume a pure holistic role or can be a database, system/server, virtualization or a network specialist.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Ensuring the operation of core banking applications in respect to application management (2nd level support)

• Processing of incident tickets generated by monitoring systems and the local service desk within SLAs

• Performing coordination / communication tasks between incident managers, applications service owners, 3rd-level support and other IT / Business stakeholders

• Takeover of periodical on-call duty (weekly 7x24)

• Administration of change requests, for application related process fulfillment

• Participation in periodic releases on weekends

• Engage in projects relating to operational aspects for existing or newly integrated applications

• Routine data cleansing of the systems

• Process optimization and automation of repetitive tasks including handover to L1 (Control Center)

• Keep application operation documentation (knowledge database) up to date

YOUR PROFILE

• Completed IT Education (Degree in Computer Science or other IT related field)

• Experience with Temenos T24: Proven ability to manage, monitor, and troubleshoot daily operations, including end-of-day (COB) processing. Proficient in operational tools such as JBoss, Oracle database, TAFJ, DSF, Octopus, Splunk, and Dynatrace. Familiarity with the TPH module is an advantage

• At least 5 years of professional experience in T24 support

• Good Linux know-how (shell scripting is an advantage)

• Knowledge of Java application server and AWA scheduler is an advantage

• Knowledge of ITIL Foundation

• Proven experience in banking with a strong knowledge of financial products

• Process-oriented and analytical approach

• Enthusiastic team player with strong communication skills

• Highly motivated, and proactive, with an eagerness to learn and take on new concepts

• Good written and spoken English, German is a plus

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.

jobs.title: Assistant Relationship Manager Private Banking - Germany & Austria
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

The Assistant Relationship Manager (ARM) Private Banking supports one or more Relationship Manager(s) (RM)/ Team Head(s) (TH) in daily operations, administration, client care and relationship management. The ARM interacts with internal as well as external stakeholders, provides clients with relevant information and supports the RM in implementing customized solutions. Furthermore, the ARM acts as role model in bringing the best service quality to the RMs/TH in a fast, professional and friendly manner, always living the Julius Baer values (Care, Passion and Excellence) and thus helping the team to manage and grow its current client base. He/she channels client feedback to the relevant individuals/departments within the Bank to foster continuous improvement and fast adaptation of processes. This position is the backbone of Client Relationship Management.

YOUR CHALLENGE
Client Administration & Management

• Supports RMs/TH in client interaction and all related tasks (systems, processes, files, documents etc.) with high-quality, precision and timely responsiveness

• Customizes client requests (reporting, statistics, mailings etc.)

• Manages the RM/TH’s calendar, prepares client meetings, organizes business trips, completes the post processing of client calls, client meetings or business trips for RMs/TH

• Compiles presentations, supports in drafting investment  proposals and in marketing activities if needed (client reception, meetings, business trips, events etc.)

• Ensures coverage in case of own absences

Business Management

• Regularly collects and exchanges relevant information necessary for the job

• Organises himself/herself in an efficient and compliant manner and ensures timely and appropriate information of the superior

• Conducts reviews, plans ahead and documents his/her work at all times

• Supports RM/TH in implementation of projects and initiatives

• Provides professional input proposals for improvements based on experience, incident occurrence or observation

• Manages the expense claim process for RMs/TH

Risk Management & Controls

• Actively helps managing risk (support first line of defence), i.e. in client documentation, by raising concerns, following up on issues and by escalating when in doubt

• Ensures adherence to local regulations and compliance with internal policies and standards (e.g. new account openings, payment instructions, reviewing client phone calls or signing off at own level of competence etc.) in collaboration with the respective RMs and TH

• Ensures timely clearance of pending items and escalated deficiencies

• Ensures appropriate ethical and compliant behaviour in his/her area of responsibility

• Ensures correct, meaningful and understandable documentation of client interaction/client orders in the corresponding tool (e.g. CRM, DiAS)

YOUR PROFILE
Personal & Social Skills

• Team player

• Excellent situational adaptability (able to work with RMs and clients from diverse backgrounds)

• Friendly, trustworthy and discreet personality with high level of risk awareness

• Highly service oriented and passionate about client servicing

• Always communicates in a friendly, competent and professional manner

• Open, approachable an displays genuine interest in people and in improving processes

• Systematic, precise and diligent working style and the ability to perform under pressure

• Personal integrity and ethical behaviour

Professional Skills

• Sound affinity with the geographic market(s) covered, i.e. familiar with the legal and regulatory environment as well as cultural awareness

• Good understanding of relevant products and services in Private Banking

• Basic knowledge of global financial markets and current developments in the industry

Education and Experience

• Relevant educational (bank apprenticeship or equivalent) and professional background (work experience in the financial industry)

• Good language skills (verbal and written) according to specific market requirements

• Proven track record in servicing banking clients with complex needs (onboarding of new, maintaining and extending current relationships)

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.
Is this not quite what you are looking for? Set up a job alert by creating a candidate account here.

Furthermore, the ARM acts as role model in bringing the best service quality to the RMs/TH in a fast, professional and friendly manner, always living the Julius Baer values (Care, Passion and Excellence) and thus helping the team to manage and grow its current client base. He/she channels client feedback to the relevant individuals/departments within the Bank to foster continuous improvement and fast adaptation of processes. This position is the backbone of Client Relationship Management.

YOUR CHALLENGE
Client Administration & Management

• Supports RMs/TH in client interaction and all related tasks (systems, processes, files, documents etc.) with high-quality, precision and timely responsiveness

• Customizes client requests (reporting, statistics, mailings etc.)

• Manages the RM/TH’s calendar, prepares client meetings, organizes business trips, completes the post processing of client calls, client meetings or business trips for RMs/TH

• Compiles presentations, supports in drafting investment proposals and in marketing activities if needed (client reception, meetings, business trips, events etc.)

• Ensures coverage in case of own absences

Business Management

• Regularly collects and exchanges relevant information necessary for the job

• Organises himself/herself in an efficient and compliant manner and ensures timely and appropriate information of the superior

• Conducts reviews, plans ahead and documents his/her work at all times

• Supports RM/TH in implementation of projects and initiatives

• Provides professional input proposals for improvements based on experience, incident occurrence or observation

• Manages the expense claim process for RMs/TH

Risk Management & Controls

• Actively helps managing risk (support first line of defence), i.e. in client documentation, by raising concerns, following up on issues and by escalating when in doubt

• Ensures adherence to local regulations and compliance with internal policies and standards (e.g. new account openings, payment instructions, reviewing client phone calls or signing off at own level of competence etc.) in collaboration with the respective RMs and TH

• Ensures timely clearance of pending items and escalated deficiencies

• Ensures appropriate ethical and compliant behaviour in his/her area of responsibility

• Ensures correct, meaningful and understandable documentation of client interaction/client orders in the corresponding tool (e.g. CRM, DiAS)

YOUR PROFILE
Personal & Social Skills

• Team player

• Excellent situational adaptability (able to work with RMs and clients from diverse backgrounds)

• Friendly, trustworthy and discreet personality with high level of risk awareness

• Highly service oriented and passionate about client servicing

• Always communicates in a friendly, competent and professional manner

• Open, approachable an displays genuine interest in people and in improving processes

• Systematic, precise and diligent working style and the ability to perform under pressure

• Personal integrity and ethical behaviour

Professional Skills

• Sound affinity with the geographic market(s) covered, i.e. familiar with the legal and regulatory environment as well as cultural awareness

• Good understanding of relevant products and services in Private Banking

• Basic knowledge of global financial markets and current developments in the industry

Education and Experience

• Relevant educational (bank apprenticeship or equivalent) and professional background (work experience in the financial industry)

• Good language skills (verbal and written) according to specific market requirements

• Proven track record in servicing banking clients with complex needs (onboarding of new, maintaining and extending current relationships)

jobs.description:
Bei Julius Bär Real Estate stehen Ihre Individualität und Ihre Fähigkeiten im Mittelpunkt –damit Sie Einfluss nehmen, unternehmerisch handeln und damit Mehrwert schaffen können, der über das Finanzielle hinausgeht.

At our subsidiary Julius Baer Real Estate, we value the individual qualities that you bring to the table and which enable you to make a difference, be entrepreneurial and take on responsibility. For the development and expansion in Switzerland, Julius Baer Real Estate is looking for a Senior Consultant in Real Estate Investment Brokerage.

IHRE AUFGABEN

• Acquisition, sale, and search of investment properties with a strong focus on investment properties across Switzerland

• Provide support to the Geneva-based team in executing transaction processes from the Zurich office

• Creation of pitches, contracts, and sales documentations

• Project management across entire real estate project cycle

• Market, location analysis of properties and property portfolios

• Advice and consult on project developments for real estate

• Development of marketing strategies and concepts in collaboration with our marketing department and Julius Baer

• Expansion and maintenance of client relationships as well as participation in trade fairs and client events

• Cross-selling to other departments within JBRE as well as Julius Baer

IHR PROFIL

• Above-average bachelor’s or master’s degree in the fields of economics, finance, architecture, engineering or similar

• 2-4 years of professional experience in the fields of real estate brokerage and transaction management

• Effective networker and bring along a broad preexisting professional network in the real estate industry

• Structured, have an eye for details and can think in a networked way

• Excellent team player, highly committed, and flexible

• Fluent in German and have a very good command of French and English

jobs.title: Senior Executive Assistant 60-100%, Genève (or Zurich), (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

The Executive Assistant role supporting the Market Head Intermediaries Western Switzerland & Americas is a strategic position requiring a seasoned, discreet, results-driven and very enthusiastic professional. The Senior Executive Assistant will provide comprehensive, high-calibre administrative and operational support, ensuring seamless day-to-day functioning across priorities.

The successful candidate will support the Market Head Intermediaries Western Switzerland & Americas in driving operational efficiency, strategic initiatives, and leadership coordination across the Market, as well as in the organisation and supervision of internal and external events along with our Marketing department. This role combines high-level administrative support with some core business management responsibilities, acting as a trusted partner to ensure seamless execution of priorities.

This individual will serve as a pivotal point of contact, managing complex and diverse tasks such as executive support, business management, development support and compliance related activities.

With a proactive mindset and unwavering attention to detail, the Executive Assistant will act as a trusted partner, anticipating needs, managing sensitive information with confidentiality, and contributing to enhanced executive effectiveness.

At Julius Baer, where excellence and client focus define our culture, this role demands the highest standards of professionalism, discretion, and service orientation in a fast-paced, multi-stakeholder environment.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Manage the Market Head Intermediaries Western Switzerland & Americas calendar proactively: schedule meetings, prioritise appointments, and resolve conflicts

• Prepare agendas, briefing materials, presentations (PowerPoint/Excel), and talking points for internal and external meetings

• Organise travel arrangements, including itineraries, visa requirements if applicable, accommodations, and expense reporting

• Organise internal and external top notch events, for team members and clients alike, with attention to details and outstanding professionalism

• Serve as gatekeeper by screening calls and emails, handling sensitive correspondence, and ensuring timely follow-up

• Act as liaison between headquarters and the Geneva office, ensuring alignment on policies, communications, and change initiatives

• Collaborate with all the key internal stakeholders, including Finance, HR,  Compliance and Legal departments when required, particularly regarding documentation and approvals

• Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for the Market; compile weekly/monthly reports

• Facilitate internal governance processes: organise regional management committee meetings, track action items, and maintain meeting minutes and follow-ups

• Assist in executing local growth strategies under guidance of the Market Head

• Identify opportunities for process improvements and digital transformation

• Maintain strict confidentiality of all matters

YOUR PROFILE

• Bachelor’s degree in business administration, International Relations, or a related field

• Minimum of 5 years’ experience in an executive support or business coordination role, preferably within private banking or financial services

• Ability to travel regularly between Zürich and Geneva

• Proven ability to work effectively in a senior executive environment with discretion and professionalism

• Strong understanding of wealth management business models, organisational structures, and key drivers of performance

• Fluency in English and French; Spanish and German language skills are a strong advantage

Chez Julius Baer, nous célébrons et valorisons les qualités individuelles que vous apportez, vous permettant d'avoir un impact, d'être entrepreneur, d'être autonomisé et de créer une valeur au-delà de la richesse. C'est l'avenir de la gestion des richesses.

Le rôle d'Assistant Exécutif pour les Intermédiaires Marché Suisse Occidentale & Amériques est un poste stratégique exigeant un professionnel chevronné, discret, axé sur les résultats et très enthousiaste. L'adjoint de la haute direction fournira un soutien administratif et opérationnel complet et de haut calibre, assurant un fonctionnement continu au quotidien dans toutes les priorités.

Le candidat retenu soutiendra les intermédiaires de Market Head Western Suisse & Amériques dans la conduite de l'efficacité opérationnelle, des initiatives stratégiques et de la coordination de leadership à travers le marché, ainsi que dans l'organisation et la supervision d'événements internes et externes avec notre département Marketing. Ce rôle combine un soutien administratif de haut niveau avec certaines responsabilités essentielles en matière de gestion des activités, agissant en tant que partenaire de confiance pour assurer une exécution transparente des priorités.

Cette personne servira de point de contact essentiel, gérera des tâches complexes et variées comme le soutien aux cadres supérieurs, la gestion des affaires, le soutien au développement et les activités liées à la conformité.

Avec une attitude proactive et une attention inébranlable aux détails, l'adjoint exécutif agira en tant que partenaire de confiance, anticipera les besoins, gérera l'information délicate avec confidentialité et contribuera à une efficacité accrue de la direction.

Chez Julius Baer, où l'excellence et la concentration sur le client définissent notre culture, ce rôle exige les normes les plus élevées de professionnalisme, de discrétion et d'orientation du service dans un environnement multi-intervenants à rythme rapide.

Votre défi

• Gérer les intermédiaires du marché Calendrier de la Suisse occidentale et des Amériques de manière proactive : organiser les réunions, établir les priorités et résoudre les conflits

• Préparer les ordres du jour, les documents d'information, les présentations (PowerPoint/Excel) et les points de discussion pour les réunions internes et externes

• Organiser les voyages, y compris les itinéraires, les conditions de visa, le cas échéant, l'hébergement et la déclaration des dépenses

• Organiser des événements de haut niveau internes et externes, pour les membres de l'équipe et les clients, avec une attention aux détails et au professionnalisme exceptionnel

• Servir de gardien de porte en examinant les appels et les courriels, en traitant la correspondance délicate et en assurant un suivi rapide

• Assurer la liaison entre le siège et le bureau de Genève, en veillant à l'harmonisation des politiques, des communications et des initiatives de changement

• Collaborer avec tous les principaux intervenants internes, y compris les ministères des Finances, des RH, de la Conformité et des Affaires juridiques, au besoin, particulièrement en ce qui concerne la documentation et les approbations

• Surveiller les principaux indicateurs de performance du marché; établir des rapports hebdomadaires/mensuels

• Faciliter les processus de gouvernance interne: organiser des réunions des comités de gestion régionaux, suivre les mesures à prendre et tenir des procès-verbaux de réunion et des suivis

• Aider à mettre en œuvre des stratégies de croissance locales sous la direction du chef du marché

• Identifier les possibilités d'amélioration des processus et de transformation numérique

• Maintenir une stricte confidentialité de toutes les questions

VOTRE PROFIL

• Baccalauréat en administration des affaires, relations internationales ou domaine connexe

• Au moins 5 ans d'expérience dans un rôle de soutien exécutif ou de coordination des entreprises, de préférence au sein de services bancaires ou financiers privés

• Capacité de voyager régulièrement entre Zurich et Genève

• Capacité éprouvée de travailler efficacement dans un environnement de cadres supérieurs avec discrétion et professionnalisme

• Une bonne compréhension des modèles d'entreprise, des structures organisationnelles et des principaux moteurs de performance en gestion de patrimoine

• La maîtrise de l'anglais et du français; la maîtrise de l'espagnol et de l'allemand est un atout important

• Compétences avancées en Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

• Excellence organisationnelle : Capacité de multitâcher efficacement tout en maintenant l'exactitude et l'attention aux détails

• Initiative & résolution des problèmes : Anticipe les besoins et propose des solutions sans surveillance constante

• Compétences en communication : Communication claire, concise et diplomatique entre niveaux et cultures.

• Collaboration d'équipe: fonctionne bien à la fois indépendamment et dans le cadre des équipes interfonctionnelles

• Discrétion et intégrité : gère les informations confidentielles avec la plus grande sensibilité et fiabilité
